gist: Channel disclaimer: does not promote drugs or alcohol, content is for information and education, viewers asked to watch with care.
Greeting, welcome and thanks to the audience for joining.
Announces today's class topic: marriage in jyotish, calling marriage a strange coincidence and an inseparable part of life.
Jokes that astrologers' market keeps running only because people keep marrying and keep calling them for muhurat and matching.
Jokes that a man and a woman keep trying to live together by force, and that afterwards children enter the picture.
Jokes that children get stuck between the couple like glue, daring them to leave while the couple keeps up the quarrel.
Social remark that husband and wife learn slavery, that children first take blood from the body and later money, yet one must give and take their blessings.

hindi: एक व्यक्ति अपना कार्य करता है जो उसका बिजनेस बना वह उसका पति या पत्नी बन गया यानी स्पाउस बन गया अब आपने एक दुकान खोल ली वह आपके पति या पत्नी के समान है दुकान आपको सुख नहीं दे रही क्योंकि दुकान को आप सुख नहीं दे रहे
says: Your business or shop plays the role of a spouse in your life. If the shop gives you no happiness, it is because you are not looking after it (for example you keep it dirty), the same way a neglected spouse gives no happiness.
cells_derived_method: He links business to the spouse, which is the 7th-house domain (marriage, partners, trade with the public). The kind of shop-spouse relationship then follows the sign on the 7th and its lord: movable signs on the 7th give changing or expanding business, fixed signs stable but rigid, Saturn-type signs slow and maintenance-heavy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th falls in Libra (Venus). Business success depends on pleasant dealing with customers and partners; neglecting presentation of the shop hurts most.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th falls in Capricorn (Saturn). The shop-spouse is demanding and slow to reward; steady upkeep and cleanliness are what it asks in return.

ambiguity: Business is classically 7th (trade) or 10th (profession); he only draws the spouse analogy and names no house.
classical_check: Classical texts give the 7th to partners and trade, so broadly agrees; the shop-as-spouse analogy itself is his own teaching, texts are silent.

hindi: आप जॉब कर रहे हैं जॉब में आप दुखी हैं जैसे गृहस्थ में आप दुखी हैं ऐसे ही आपका जो जॉब है वो आपको गालियां पड़वा आता है
says: Unhappiness in a job mirrors unhappiness in marriage: if the household life is painful, the job will likewise bring you abuse and humiliation. Job is treated like a spouse relationship.
cells_derived_method: He equates job with spouse, so the state of the 7th house and its lord is read for both home life and work relations. Classically the job is the 6th (service) and 10th (karma), so the reading changes with which sign lies on 6th, 7th and 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Quarrelsome, argumentative relations in both marriage and workplace partnerships.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 7th is Pisces (Jupiter). A more benevolent pattern, supportive spouse and bosses, but vague boundaries.

ambiguity: He does not say which house he means by job; classical job houses are 6th and 10th, and the 7th is only his analogy.
classical_check: Texts silent on equating job with marriage; they place service in the 6th. Differs in emphasis.

hindi: ऐसे ही पति-पत्नी जैसे दो लोगों का संबंध एक पार्टनरशिप के तौर पर काउंट किया जाता है यह पार्टनरशिप जो दो लोगों में होती है
says: Any relation between two people that works like husband and wife is counted as a partnership; marriage is one form of that partnership.
cells_derived_method: Partnership is the 7th-house topic, so any two-person bond (marriage, business partner, close associate) is read from the 7th, its lord and Venus/Jupiter as karakas. The sign on the 7th decides the temperament of the partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini (Mercury). Partnerships are talkative, trade-oriented and changeable.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Intense, possessive and secretive partnerships.

ambiguity: He does not name the 7th house in this sentence; it is inferred from the word partnership.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th house is the house of spouse and partners in Parashari texts.

hindi: इसको हम विवाह के संयोग में जोड़ केर चलते हैं शब्द देकर लीगल
says: We club such two-person partnerships into the marriage yoga, giving it the word legal, meaning the formally recognised union is the one analysed under marriage combinations.
cells_derived_method: The marriage yoga is analysed on the 7th house with its lord and karaka; business partnerships are read in the same place. The sign-nature rules for the 7th are applied the same way to both.
ambiguity: The caption 'शब्द देकर लीगल' is garbled; I read it as 'giving the word legal' and the meaning is a medium-certainty reading.
classical_check: Silent on this exact grouping; the 7th covering both spouse and partner is classical.

hindi: विवाह कई प्रकार के होते हैं हमारे शास्त्रों में पिशाच विवाह तक का उल्लेख किया गया है यानी कि अलाउड किया गया है
says: The scriptures describe several types of marriage and even mention the pishacha vivah (marriage by deceit or force), which he says shows even that form was acknowledged.
ambiguity: None significant.
classical_check: Agrees: Manusmriti and Dharmashastra list eight marriage forms (Brahma to Paishacha). Calling the last one 'allowed' is his reading; texts call it the lowest and condemned.

gist: Says such a woman, even one abducted and forced to bear children, was also given respect and accepted by society.
Praises the beauty of Sanatan that such a woman is not outcast, and criticises those who said she is defiled and should be thrown away.

hindi: ऐसी स्त्री का क्या दोष कैसे ही गृह दोष के कारण भाग्य दोष के कारण पुरुष ने या स्त्री ने किसी प्रकार से मान मर्यादा तोड़ करके कुछ खराबी करी तो एक्सेप्ट तो उसे भी करना है
says: When a man or woman crosses limits of propriety, he attributes it to graha dosha (planetary affliction) and bhagya dosha (fate) rather than personal fault, so the person should still be accepted.
ambiguity: The sentence is a social argument; the astrology part is only the cause attribution to graha and bhagya dosha, no specific yoga named.
classical_check: Texts attribute conduct to karma and planetary influences, but do not use this to absolve conduct; his emphasis on acceptance is his own.

gist: Argues that one negative combination should not ruin a whole life; society created forgiveness so the rest of life can be lived.

hindi: कुछ ग्रह संयोग ऐसे होते हैं कि हमारे साथ नाजायज होना ही है और वह नाजायज ही हमारे भाग्य का जायज है
says: Some planetary combinations are such that something improper is bound to happen to a person, and that improper event is exactly what is proper (lawful) according to that person's destiny.
ambiguity: No yoga or planet named, so it cannot be turned into a testable rule.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical view of prarabdha karma shown by yogas; texts silent on this phrasing.

gist: Philosophical aside that there is really no good or bad karma, as we usually label them.
Story begins: a boy goes to play in the mountains with his father, hurts his foot and cries out an exclamation, and the echo returns it.
In the story the boy asks who is there, the echo repeats it, he calls the unseen one a coward and abuses him, and the echo abuses back.
The boy gets scared and asks his father who this is; the father tells him to say he is the voice's friend.
The boy says he is a friend and hears it back, laughs, says I love you many times and hears I love you in reply.

hindi: आपने अपने जीवन में जो अंदर महसूस कर डाला उसकी प्रतिध्वनि पहाड़ देते हैं यह मेनिफेस्टेशन का रूल है
says: Whatever you feel inside returns to you as an echo, like mountains returning your voice; this is the rule of manifestation, so inner feeling shapes what life gives back.
ambiguity: Law-of-attraction style claim, not a Jyotish rule; used here as the base for his Vastu and remedy arguments.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish statement; texts are silent. It resembles the karma-phala idea only loosely.

hindi: आपके अंतर मन में चेतना में गलगल घूम रहा बहुत तेजी से और वो प्रतिध्वनि आ रही है एनर्जी इक्वल ट एमसी स्क्वायर मास चिजी के रूप में आपने ग्रहण की
says: The feeling circulates very fast in the subconscious, and its echo comes back; using E = mc2 he says energy is received by us in the form of mass, that is physical things, while the echo keeps running inside.
ambiguity: Caption is noisy around 'गलगल' and 'चिजी' (probably 'cheezein', things); the physics reference is loose.
classical_check: No classical basis; modern analogy by the speaker.

hindi: वेस्ट का डायरेक्शन शनि महाराज को दिया जाता है और शनि ही चिजी देने वाला देवता है
says: The west direction belongs to Saturn, and Saturn is the deity who gives material things.
ambiguity: None; Saturn-west is the standard direction lordship.
classical_check: Agrees: Vastu and Jyotish give the west to Saturn.

hindi: सारी चीजें पेट्रोल सोना चांदी गहना ए टू जेड टीवी तक हर चीज कपड़े लते सब शनि धरती के अंदर से निकले और यह वेस्ट का स्थान है इसका
says: All things that come out of the earth, such as petrol, gold, silver, ornaments, even TVs and clothes, are under Saturn, and the west is its place.
ambiguity: Clothes and TV are a stretch; he treats anything extracted from earth or manufactured from it as Saturn's.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical Saturn karakatva covers oil, iron and minerals, but gold belongs to Jupiter or Sun and silver to Moon or Venus.

hindi: आपके वेस्ट में ही आपके देवता का स्थान होता है
says: In the west part of your plot or house lies the seat of your deity, meaning the west is where the presiding devatas of that zone reside.
ambiguity: Sentence runs over into the next timestamp chunk; the zone-devata claim is Vastu, not Jyotish.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vastu Purusha mandala, which places the west devatas in the western band.

hindi: स्थान होता है वहीं पुष्पदंत है वहीं डड फ वहीं वरुण है
says: The devatas of that west zone are Pushpadanta and Varuna, plus one more name the caption garbles; he is listing the Vastu mandala gods there.
ambiguity: 'डड फ' is unreadable; likely another mandala deity of the west. Varuna is mapped to Neptune in his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Agrees: Pushpadanta and Varuna both occupy the west band of the 45-devata Vastu mandala.

hindi: वरुण जैसा समुद्र जो हृदय चक्र पर रहता है यहीं से इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक पल्स जाती है आपकी अंतरिक्ष में
says: Varuna is like the ocean and sits at the heart chakra; from there an electromagnetic pulse of your feelings goes out into space.
ambiguity: Varuna as Neptune is his own scheme; the heart-chakra link is not from a classical source.
classical_check: Silent on Varuna at the heart chakra; classical texts link Varuna to water and the west, not to chakras.

hindi: मेनिफेस्टेशन के लिए बहुत जरूरी है कि आपको इको क्या आ रहा है आपके अंदर जो इको आपने किया है और प्रकृति ने वापस लौटाया है वही मेनिफेस्ट होगा
says: For manifestation, what matters is the echo you receive: only what you sent out inside and nature has returned will actually manifest in your life.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; silent in texts.

hindi: अगर आपकी लाइफ में नेगेटिव आ रहा है तो यह गांठ बांध लो आप गालियां बक रहे हो
says: If negativity is coming into your life, tie this knot in memory: you yourself are sending out abuse inside, which is why negativity returns.
ambiguity: Rhetorical, 'abuse' means negative inner feeling and speech, not literal.
classical_check: Not classical; texts say suffering comes from karma, not specifically from inner speech.

hindi: घर के अंदर अपने जीवन को बेहतर करना हो तो वेस्ट डायरेक्शन में पहाड़ की फोटोग्राफ लगाई जाती है वास्तु के अंतर्गत
says: Remedy under Vastu: to improve life, hang a photograph of a mountain on the west wall inside the house so that the echo returns good things.
ambiguity: Planet tie is inferred from west being Saturn and Varuna; he does not name them here.
classical_check: Mountain picture in the west is a popular Vastu practice; the classical Vastu texts favour heavy objects in the south and west, which is consistent but not explicit.

hindi: गुंजायमान होकर के चीज वापस लौटकर प्रतिध्वनि होकर आए हमने गलत लगा रखा है तो गलत वापस लौट कर आ जाएगा
says: The echo returns whatever was sent; if we have placed the wrong thing in the west (a wrong picture or object), the wrong will come back to us.
ambiguity: Does not say what counts as a wrong item; implied negative pictures or clutter.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; consistent with general Vastu advice on placement.

hindi: पति और पत्नी के रिश्ते को लंबे समय तक चलाने के लिए हम जो अपने अंदर इको ले रहे हैं वही इको लौट कर आएगा और कुछ नहीं आता
says: To keep the husband-wife relation lasting, remember that the echo you carry inside is the only thing that returns; nothing else comes, so the marriage reflects your inner state.
cells_derived_method: He is tying the manifestation rule to marriage, a 7th-house matter. The sign and lord of the 7th decide which inner trait is mirrored back.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 7th is Cancer (Moon). A partner who mirrors your emotional state, so inner mood swings come back as marital mood swings.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Partner mirrors your beliefs and ideals, so cynicism returns as a preachy or distant partner.

ambiguity: The 7th house is inferred from marriage; he names no house.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; they read marriage from the chart, not from inner echo.

gist: Spiritual advice to observe what is running inside (sakshi bhav) and notice that you create your own trouble in life; sentence cuts off at the end of the chunk.

hindi: जो बीज लगाया वही तो बनेगा तो जो फल आया समझ लो उसी का बीज लगाया था
says: The fruit you got is the fruit of the seed you planted, so whatever result is now in your life was seeded earlier by you; he uses this as the karma-phala principle.
ambiguity: The beginning of the sentence is cut off from the previous chunk; the seed-and-fruit meaning is clear.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical karma-phala doctrine behind Jyotish; no specific yoga is named.

gist: Says people plant seeds unconsciously, half asleep, and then wonder when the plant grew or when the child got spoiled; calls this foolishness.
Announces that to get out of this foolishness today's topic is the 7th house of the kundli.

hindi: जन्म पत्रिका में इन 12 भावों में पहला भाव जो प्रथम भाव होता है यहां पर मैं होता हूं और यहां होता है मेरा साथी यह साथी मेरा जीवन साथी है
says: Of the 12 houses, the first is me (the self) and the house opposite it, the seventh, is my companion, the life partner.
cells_derived_method: Self is read from the 1st and the partner from the 7th. The sign on the 7th and its lord describe the partner; the lagna sign is simply the 7th sign shifted by six places.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra (Venus). Partner is pleasing, relationship-minded, diplomatic.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 7th is Cancer (Moon). Partner is nurturing and moody, home-centred.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Partner is assertive, independent and quick-tempered.

ambiguity: None; houses here are bhava numbers counted from lagna.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is the house of spouse in all Parashari texts.

hindi: कई लोग तो जीवन साथी नहीं बन पाते बना भी नहीं पाते कुछ कवारे रह जाते हैं
says: Many people never manage to form a life-partner bond and some remain unmarried; the 7th house is where this failure shows in a chart.
cells_derived_method: Non-marriage is read from afflictions to the 7th, its lord and Venus/Jupiter. Saturn-ruled 7th signs delay, fiery or Mars-ruled ones give conflict and separation, so the sign on the 7th changes the pattern of unmarried or partnerless life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Delay and late or no marriage is a typical pattern.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Intense bonds, separation or refusal to settle.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 7th is Pisces (Jupiter). Marriage possible but with idealised expectations leading to dissatisfaction.

ambiguity: He gives no cause or yoga; the 7th is inferred from the topic.
classical_check: Texts list yogas for non-marriage (e.g. Saturn or Mars on the 7th); he names none here.

hindi: इन द सेंस लीगल मैरिज नहीं मिलती इलीगल मैरिज मिल जाती है
says: Some people do not get a legal marriage but do get an illegal (informal, unrecognised) union instead; the 7th-house reading must count such partners too.
cells_derived_method: Formal versus informal unions depend on how the 7th and its lord relate to the 5th, 8th and 12th houses; unconventional signs (Aquarius, Scorpio) on the 7th lean to informal relations, fixed or earth signs to formal ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 7th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Unconventional or live-in type of union is likelier than a standard marriage.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus (Venus). Settled, traditional and legal union is favoured.

ambiguity: 'Legal' and 'illegal' are his own usage; no classical term maps directly.
classical_check: Texts are silent on this legal/illegal split; they only speak of types of partners.

hindi: मैरिज की संज्ञा बनी कि आपके जीवन में शरीर की जरूरत एक मुन्ना है मन 12 पर एक शरीर है 72 पर यानी शरीर की जरूरत
says: He defines marriage as the fulfilment of the body's need; as the caption reads, one need (of the mind) is placed at the 12th and the body's need at the 7th.
cells_derived_method: The 7th is read for the body's companionship need and the 12th for bed pleasures and mental release. Sign nature on each modifies how that need is expressed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 12th is Pisces (Jupiter). Bed pleasures and mental release come gently and spiritually.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus (Venus). Strong sensual, physical need of companionship.

ambiguity: The caption 'मन 12 पर एक शरीर है 72 पर' is garbled; '72' probably means 7 par, and 'मुन्ना' is unreadable. Meaning is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees partly: classical texts give the 12th to bed pleasures (shayya sukha) and the 7th to sexual union; the mind-body split is his.

hindi: शरीर की जरूरत क्या है मेरे को गाड़ी सपनों में आई चिजी चिजी के भोग भोगना है
says: The body's need is to enjoy worldly pleasures (cars and objects seen in dreams); the body wants material enjoyment, which is the base of the companion need.
cells_derived_method: Enjoyment of material comforts is the 7th and Venus domain in his framing. A 7th in an earth or Venus sign emphasises material pleasure, an air or water sign emphasises company and feeling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus. Strong desire for comfort and possessions through partnership.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini. Enjoyment is in talk, travel and variety, less in possessions.

ambiguity: Caption is noisy ('मुन्ना की बनी हुई गाड़ी' is garbled); the dream-car image stands for material enjoyment. Venus is my inference, he does not name it here.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus as karaka of pleasures and vehicles; the link to the 7th is his.

hindi: मैं गाड़ी चला रहा हूं यार साथ में कोई है ही नहीं अच्छा यार उसी साथी के साथ मुझे प्रेम भी मिल जाए
says: Enjoyment alone feels empty (driving the car with nobody beside you), so a person wants a companion to share it with, and the same companion should also give love; this need is the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: The 7th shows whether a shared life is available. Its sign shows whether it comes easily (air, water) or with difficulty (Saturn, Mars signs).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra. Companionship is a strong need and usually found.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn. Companion comes later and with duty attached.

ambiguity: Continues the sentence from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: 7th as house of kama and companionship.

hindi: शरीर का सहवास भी मिल जाए संभोग उसी से बच्चे भी हो जाए जो प्रकृति चाहती है
says: A person wants love, physical union and children from the same partner, which is what nature itself intends from the pairing.
cells_derived_method: Union is the 7th and children are the 5th, so both houses and their lords should connect for this to materialise. Sign pairings decide the ease.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 5th is Leo (Sun), with the 7th Libra. Children and partner link through Sun and Venus, pride in children.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 5th is Scorpio (Mars), with the 7th Capricorn. Children come with effort; union and children are separated by Mars and Saturn.

ambiguity: Houses 5 and 7 inferred from the content, he names the 5th a few sentences later.
classical_check: Agrees: 7th for union and 5th for progeny are classical.

gist: Biological explanation: ovulation every month and sperm production are beyond our control, the ovum waits for sperm.

hindi: सेक्स एक ऐसी क्रिया है जो एक भूख की तरह वासना बनके तंग ना करे इसलिए कहते हैं उचित आयु आ गई
says: Sex is like hunger and should not torment as uncontrolled lust, so marriage is prescribed at the proper age to meet this need in a regulated way.
cells_derived_method: The 7th shows how this need is expressed and met in marriage; Mars or Venus signs on the 7th raise intensity, Saturn or Jupiter signs temper it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Strong, impatient desire needing early outlet.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Desire is moderated by ideals and dharma.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the dharmashastra view of marriage as the regulated outlet of kama.

hindi: अब स्त्री रजस्वला है पुरुष भी लड़का भी बड़ा हो गया सयाना कहते हैं शादी कर दो
says: Once the girl has begun menstruation and the boy has matured, elders say to get them married, so marriage timing follows physical maturity.
cells_derived_method: Marriage timing is read from the 7th and its lord's dasha, usually after maturity; Saturn-influenced signs delay it past the social norm, Venus or Mars signs bring it early.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn. Marriage tends to come after the normal age.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus. Early or on-time marriage is likelier.

ambiguity: He gives social custom, not a Jyotish timing rule; no age is stated.
classical_check: Texts prescribe marriage after maturity; no chart-based rule here.

hindi: यह संभोग की क्रिया की संतुष्टि का कार्यक्रम भी यहीं से आता है
says: The programme of sexual satisfaction comes from the 7th house too, so the quality of sexual contentment in marriage is read from this house.
cells_derived_method: Sexual satisfaction is read from the 7th, its lord, Venus and Mars. Watery and earthy signs on the 7th give sensual fulfilment, mutable and air signs give variety but less depth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Intense but possessive intimacy.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 7th is Virgo (Mercury). Critical or reserved intimacy, satisfaction depends on cleanliness and routine.

ambiguity: 'यहीं से' points to the 7th, he has just been speaking of it.
classical_check: Agrees: 7th is the house of sexual union; 8th is also used for sexual vitality.

hindi: पति और पत्नी मिल जाने के कारण से जीवन को आगे चलाकर अपना डीएनए ट्रांसफर ये आपका पांचवा घर हो गया
says: Through husband and wife the line is carried forward by transferring your DNA to the next generation, and that function is the fifth house.
cells_derived_method: Children and lineage are read from the 5th, its lord and Jupiter. Fire and water signs on the 5th favour children, Saturn or Mercury signs reduce or delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 5th is Cancer (Moon). Nurturing, emotionally bound children.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Children come late or few, with responsibility.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of progeny.

hindi: प्रकृति को आप संतान दे सके हम प्रकृति को क्या देते हैं एक मकान बनाते हैं वो हमारा बच्चा है
says: Nature expects progeny from us; what we also give back is a house we build, and he calls that house our child, treating property as a kind of offspring.
cells_derived_method: If property is a form of child, the house-building function links the 5th with the 4th (home). A 4th-5th connection shows property and children in one theme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 4th is Taurus (Venus). Comfortable home built with care.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 4th is Aries (Mars). Property comes through effort, builds, but with disputes.

ambiguity: Saturn is added from the west-house link he draws next; he does not name it here. The 4th is my inference.
classical_check: Silent; houses are the 4th, not the 5th, in classical texts.

hindi: शनि के स्थान वेस्ट में बहुत बढ़िया इको हुआ है तो यह एक प्रकार का मानसिक संभोग है हमें उस देवता ने कृपा करके साथी के तौर पर एक मकान दे दिया
says: If a very good echo has been made in the west, Saturn's place, it is a kind of mental union, and the deity of that place graces us with a house as our partner.
ambiguity: The beginning of the sentence is from the previous chunk; 'प्रसाद इको' is noisy.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; Vastu-style claim.

hindi: परेशानी के समय हमारे पास उस मकान ने हमें बचाया उस पर हमें लोन मिल गया उस मकान के द्वारा बिजनेस किया
says: In hard times the house itself rescued us, since we could take a loan against it and run business through it, which is why he calls the house a real partner.
cells_derived_method: A property as saving partner is a 4th-house matter, and its use for finance and business links the 4th to the 2nd and 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 4th is Capricorn (Saturn). Property comes slowly through effort and works as a lasting asset that can be mortgaged in hard times.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 4th is Cancer (Moon). The home is an emotional anchor and a place of refuge, more than a financial lever.

ambiguity: He does not name the 4th; it is inferred from the house-as-asset image.
classical_check: Silent; the 4th as house of property is classical.

hindi: मैंने मोटरसाइकिल खरीदी है कार खरीदी वो साथी है उसमें एक्सीडेंट नहीं हुआ कभी भी पत्नी ने पति का पति ने पत्नी का साथ दिया
says: A bike, a car or a house that served you without accident is a loyal companion in the same sense as a spouse who stood by you in hard times.
cells_derived_method: Loyal companions in a chart are shown by a strong 7th (people) and 4th (vehicles, home). A malefic on either would reverse the pattern.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 4th is Gemini (Mercury). Vehicles are changed often; reliable through service and upkeep.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra. Spouse supportive and loyal in a crisis.

ambiguity: Rhetorical; there is no direct rule, houses are inferred.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the 4th as vehicles and 7th as spouse.

hindi: बुरे समय के साथी ही प्रेमी माने जाते हैं अच्छे समय के सब साथी हैं
says: A true partner is one who stays in bad times; in good times everyone is a companion, so loyalty can only be judged during adversity.
cells_derived_method: Loyalty in hard times shows in how the 7th lord behaves in dashas of malefics; supportive in Jupiter or Venus signs, deserting in Rahu or Mars signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius. Partner stands by on principle even in adversity.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini. Partner is changeable and may drift away when conditions turn bad.

ambiguity: This is a general life remark, linked to the 7th only by inference.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Remarks that girlfriend and boyfriend love each other, but if they stay when bad time comes they are true partners and the rest are only party-goers.

hindi: बुरा समय ही आपको शिक्षित करता है बुरा समय ही आपको ज्ञानी बनाएगा अच्छा समय आपको गधा बनाता है क्योंकि आप जीवन से भूल भाल के वासनाओं में लिपट हो जाते हैं
says: Bad times educate and make you wise, while good times make you a donkey since you forget life and sink into desires.
ambiguity: Saturn is not named; the idea matches the classical role of Saturn as teacher and is my inference.
classical_check: Agrees with the general view that malefic periods teach and benefic periods relax; no specific rule named.

gist: Mimics the party-party mood and says such parties do not last long.
Says the partnership may be legal or illegal and he will discuss it, but in Sanatan strictly there is no legal or illegal.

hindi: जहां-जहां संभोग बन जाता है उतने आपके साथी काउंट होते हैं सप्तम भाव के और पंचम भाव के
says: Every person with whom intercourse takes place is counted as a partner under the 7th and 5th houses, whether the union was formal or not.
cells_derived_method: The number and nature of partners is read from the 7th, its lord and the 5th. Dual signs on the 7th suggest multiple partners; fixed signs suggest one steady partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini (dual). More than one partner is likelier.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 7th is Leo (fixed). One dominant partner is likelier.

ambiguity: He means all sexual partners count, not just marital ones; the count method is not given.
classical_check: Texts treat the 7th as spouse and also as any sexual partner, so partly agrees; the 5th link is his emphasis.

hindi: ये प्रेम का खाना है डीएनए हमारे पितरों की कृपा और ये हमारे साथी का खाना है पुरुष के लिए स्त्री स्त्री के लिए पुरुष सातवां
says: The 5th box is the house of love, DNA and grace of the ancestors, and the 7th box is the partner's house, a woman for a man and a man for a woman.
cells_derived_method: Love and lineage are read from the 5th and its sign; partner from the 7th and its sign. Pairs of signs (5th and 7th) six apart or trine decide how love and marriage relate.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 5th is Aries (Mars) and the 7th Gemini. Love is bold and quick, partner mentally agile.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 5th is Pisces (Jupiter) and the 7th Taurus (Venus). Love is romantic and idealised, partner sensual and steady.

ambiguity: 'खाना' means a house box in a kundli diagram (North Indian style).
classical_check: Agrees: 5th for love and children, 7th for spouse; the DNA and pitri framing is modern with pitri link classical via the 5th and 9th.

hindi: यानी मेरे एग्जैक्ट सामने यह मेरा चेहरा हो गया यह गुप्तांग हो गए
says: The 7th is exactly opposite me: the 1st is my face and the 7th represents the private parts.
cells_derived_method: In the body mapping the 1st is head and face and the 7th is genitals and lower abdomen; sign on each assigns the part with its natural zodiac organ.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio, the natural sign of the genitals. Strong association with reproductive matters.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra, a sign of the kidneys and lower back. Waist and kidney themes are shown by the 7th.

ambiguity: Note: 'सामने' means directly opposite on the chart.
classical_check: Differs slightly: Kalapurusha gives the 8th to the genitals and Scorpio; the 7th covers lower abdomen and the sex act.

hindi: पेट भी यही है उधर पेट की खराबी भी यहीं से होंगे गुप्त अंग भी यहीं से होंगे आपके यह कमर का हिस्सा है और ये आपका एनल एरिया जहां आपको मल का त्याग करना है
says: The 7th also stands for the stomach, waist and anal area; he says stomach disorders and troubles of the private parts and the excretory region are read from here. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The 7th as lower abdomen, waist and excretory zone means afflicted signs in the 7th are watched for these areas, using the sign's natural body part.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 7th is Virgo, the sign of the intestines. Digestive and bowel matters are emphasised.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra. Lower back, waist and kidney region.

ambiguity: A medical claim; flagged. Classical texts also use the 6th for digestion and the 8th for anal and genital parts.
classical_check: Partly differs: texts assign the 7th to lower abdomen and the 8th to the anus and genitals.

hindi: जितने भी आपके गुप्त रोग इत्यादि होते हैं उसमें यह और यह खाना कुछ हद तक इवॉल्व होता है मुख्य तौर पर ये साथी का खाना
says: Secret (sexual) diseases involve this house and an adjoining one to some extent, but mainly this box is the partner's house. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Hidden sexual health is read from the 7th and a second house he does not name (likely 8th or 6th) using afflictions by Mars, Rahu and Saturn on those signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio. Rahu or Mars here would be the usual flag for hidden health issues.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 8th is Aries (Mars) and the 7th Pisces. Hidden complaints connect to Mars on the 8th.

ambiguity: 'यह और यह खाना' is unspecified: probably the 7th with the 8th or 6th.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: classical texts link venereal disease to the 7th, 8th and 6th with Venus or Mars afflictions.

hindi: यहीं से आपका मैरिज का हिसाब है यहीं से आपका लव का हिसाब है लव एंड मैरिज
says: The account of both marriage and love is read from this same box, the 5th and 7th together.
cells_derived_method: Love is read from the 5th and marriage from the 7th. If the lords of 5th and 7th link, love and marriage coincide; if not, they separate.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 5th is Gemini and the 7th Leo. Love is light and talkative; marriage proud and loyal.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus and the 5th is Pisces. Love is idealistic and tender, marriage sensual and stable.

ambiguity: 'यहीं' covers both 5th and 7th.
classical_check: Agrees: 5th for love and 7th for marriage are classical.

hindi: कई बार मैरिज जैसी होती उसमें लव नहीं होता कई बार लव ऐसा होता है मैरिज नहीं होती
says: Sometimes a marriage happens without love in it, and sometimes there is love but it never turns into marriage, which shows the 5th and 7th need not work together.
cells_derived_method: If the 5th and 7th lords are unconnected or in mutual affliction, love and marriage separate; a 6/8 or 2/12 relation between the lords is typical.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 5th is Leo (Sun) and the 7th Libra (Venus). Sun and Venus are enemies, so love may not become marriage.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 5th is Sagittarius (Jupiter) and the 7th Aquarius (Saturn). Love is idealistic and marriage is cool and delayed, so the two are separate affairs.

ambiguity: Sentence ends in the next chunk; no yoga is named.
classical_check: Texts say love marriage yogas need the 5th and 7th lords connected; this inverse is consistent.

hindi: पांचवें और सातवें घर यह घर है भाव तो फिक्स है ये एक चार पांच सात छ यहां है यहीं से देखेंगे जितना भी लव देखना है शादी जितनी देखनी है
says: The 5th and 7th houses are the fixed places to look at for all questions of love and marriage; he lists some house numbers around them but the caption is garbled.
cells_derived_method: All love questions go to the 5th and marriage to the 7th, so a person's love and marriage profile is the sign, lord and occupants of these two houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 5th is Libra (Venus) and the 7th Sagittarius. Love is harmonious and romantic; marriage philosophical.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 7th is Pisces and the 5th Capricorn. Love is serious, marriage compassionate but idealising.

ambiguity: 'एक चार पाच सात छ' is garbled; possibly the houses 1, 4, 5, 7 and 6 that he regards as relevant. Not used here.
classical_check: Agrees on 5th and 7th; classical texts also add the 2nd, 4th, 8th and 12th.

hindi: चार बार लव हो गया शादी एक बार भी नहीं हुई यह खाना दूषित है
says: If someone falls in love four times and never marries once, that house (the 5th and 7th) is afflicted, according to him.
cells_derived_method: Repeated love without marriage points to an affliction to the 7th (or the 7th lord) while the 5th stays active; Saturn or Rahu on the 7th, or malefic aspect on its lord, are the usual signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Saturn blocks commitment even while love keeps happening.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Love starts quickly but breaks before marriage.

ambiguity: 'यह खाना' is not specified: either the 5th or the 7th.
classical_check: Texts connect broken engagements to malefics on the 7th; the numeric test is his own.

hindi: शादी दो बार हुई प्यार होता ही नहीं तलाक हो रहा है यानी के आपका यह खाना दूषित है
says: If someone marries twice yet never experiences love and ends up divorced, that house is also afflicted; this is the reverse pattern of the previous case.
cells_derived_method: Multiple marriages without love and divorce points to affliction of the 5th (love) and a changing 7th. Dual signs on the 7th and a weak 5th lord are typical.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini (dual). Repeated marriages are likelier.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 5th is Virgo (Mercury) and the 7th Scorpio (Mars). Love is analytical and cold while marriage is intense, which suits a pattern of loveless marriages.

ambiguity: As above, 'this box' is unspecified.
classical_check: Classical texts attribute multiple marriages to dual signs and malefics on the 7th; no love criterion is given there.

hindi: अब ऐसी चॉइस गलत होती है चॉइस क्यों गलत होती है अरे यही लिखा है जो लिखा है वो होके रहेगा
says: People make wrong choices of partner because that is what is written in the chart, and what is written will happen regardless.
ambiguity: Fatalistic claim; he does not mention free will here, though he later stresses consciousness.
classical_check: Agrees with the prarabdha view; texts also allow remedies, which he returns to later.

hindi: यही 12 प्र है आपको संतान सुख नहीं लिखा नहीं लिखा आपका एक्सीडेंट लिखा हो गया
says: All 12 houses together carry what is written: if no child happiness is written you do not get it, and if an accident is written it happens.
cells_derived_method: Child-happiness is the 5th; accidents are read from the 8th and 6th and from the lagna lord, so the sign on those houses decides the type.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Children delayed or limited.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 8th is Aries (Mars). Accidents involving fire, cuts or speed are the typical theme.

ambiguity: '12 प्र' is garbled, probably 12 bhava; it reads as a general claim.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: 5th for children, 8th for accidents; no yoga named.

gist: Rhetorical questions: nobody wishes for an accident, death, failure in studies or betrayal, so who is giving them; someone must be.

hindi: ये हमारे पास्ट लाइफ कर्म होंगे ऐसे कह के बहाना बनाया जाता है कि ठीक है भाई ऐसा ही होता होगा गारंटी कुछ नहीं लेकिन होता तो होगा ना
says: Such events are blamed on past-life karma as an excuse; he admits there is no guarantee of this but says some cause must exist.
ambiguity: He calls it an excuse and not a certainty, so it is a tentative claim.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical ground of purva-janma karma, but the hedge 'no guarantee' is his own.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के लिए ही हमारे को सबसे पहले समझना है कि ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस सर्वोपरि है मनुष्य की कॉन्शियस मींस मेरी चेतना
says: For such situations first understand that human consciousness (my own awareness) is supreme, above the chart's fixed promise.
ambiguity: He sets consciousness above fate here, which sits against his fatalism a few lines earlier.
classical_check: Differs from a strictly fatalistic reading; texts allow purushartha and remedies, so partially agrees.

hindi: यह मैं हूं यहीं से सारा का सारा एक विस्फोट होता है और मैं और मेरा जीवन फिर मेरा जीवन साथी यह बन जाता है
says: Consciousness is the I (the first house), and from it everything explodes outward: first I, then my life, then my life partner, so the partner is born out of the self.
cells_derived_method: The partner (7th) is a projection of the self (1st), so the lagna sign and its lord colour the partner's nature through the 7th. Same-element or opposite signs show similarity or complement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries gives the 7th as Libra. A self-driven person projects a partner who is relational and balancing.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer gives the 7th as Capricorn. An emotional self projects a disciplined, reserved partner.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent on this projection idea; the 1st-7th axis is classical.

hindi: प्रेम एक ऐसी ऊर्जा है जिस ऊर्जा की भूख के लिए एनर्जी बॉडी रोती है एक एनर्जी बॉडी है एक फिजिकल बॉडी है
says: Love is an energy that the energy body hungers for and cries out for; a person has an energy body and a physical body, and they want different things.
ambiguity: Esoteric framing, not Jyotish.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; resembles the pranamaya kosha idea from Vedanta.

hindi: फिजिकल बॉडी सेक्स करती है एनर्जी बॉडी प्रेम करती है फिजिकल बॉडी प्रेम प्रूम नहीं करती
says: The physical body only does sex and the energy body does love; the physical body by itself does not love, so lust and love are separate functions.
cells_derived_method: Body desire is the 7th (and 8th) and love is the 5th, so the split between sex and love shows in different house conditions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio. Strong physical need that can run separately from love.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 5th is Pisces (Jupiter). Love is idealistic and emotional, separate from bodily need.

ambiguity: The link to 5th and 7th is mine; he is speaking generally.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कई बार थप्पड़ भी मारते हैं लड़ते भी हम एनर्जी बॉडी नफरत भी कर सकते ये फीलिंग्लेस को ब्लेस भी करते हैं
says: The energy body can hate as well, so couples slap and fight; the end of the sentence is garbled but he seems to add that even those who seem feelingless can bless.
ambiguity: The last clause 'फीलिंग्लेस को ब्लेस भी करते हैं' is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: संतान भी होती है संतान कभी ऐसी होती है ओहो अपंग हो गई मानसिक विकलांगता आ गई ऑटिस्टिक बच्चे हो जाते हैं
says: Children are also born in this union, and sometimes a child is born disabled or with mental disability or autism; this is recorded as his remark on the range of outcomes in the 5th house, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Children's condition is read from the 5th, its lord and Jupiter; affliction by Saturn, Rahu or Mars on these gives difficult outcomes by sign nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 5th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme) and the 7th Aries. Unusual or atypical children are the theme, tied to Saturn and Pluto.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 5th is Virgo (Mercury). Mercury affliction would connect to speech and nervous-system themes.

ambiguity: Medical terms are his own; a flagged claim, not to be used as a diagnosis.
classical_check: Texts connect afflicted 5th with children's troubles; specific conditions are not named.

hindi: कभी ऐसे बच्चे होते हैं भाई साइंटिस्ट पैदा हो गए ओशो भी पैदा ही हुआ था रजनीश एलन मस्क जैसे बंदे मोदी जैसे
says: On the other side, children can also be born as scientists or extraordinary people like Osho, Elon Musk or Modi; the 5th house outcome ranges from handicap to brilliance (sentence cuts off).
cells_derived_method: Gifted children come with strong 5th house, strong Jupiter and Mercury, and benefic aspects; sign matters for the type of gift.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 5th is Aquarius. Innovative, scientific children.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 5th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Philosophic, guru-like children.

ambiguity: Jupiter added by me; he names only examples of people. Sentence ends at the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: strong 5th and Jupiter give gifted children.

hindi: लोग कैसे पैदा हुए ये ऐसे विचित्र और प्रेम से भरे संयोग यानी संभोग की संतान है कि कमाल की आत्मा बुलाई गई है
says: People are born out of a union, and when the union is a strange, love-filled one, a remarkable soul is called into it; the state of mind at conception decides which kind of soul arrives as the child.
cells_derived_method: Children and the soul that comes are read from the 5th, its sign and lord (with Jupiter). Fire and spiritual signs on the 5th favour high-purpose souls, earthy signs practical ones, so the sign shifts the type of child the union draws.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 5th is Leo (Sun). Children with leadership and a strong sense of self.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 5th is Pisces (Jupiter). Spiritual, imaginative children who seem to come from somewhere else.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 5th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Unusual, detached or inventive children.

ambiguity: He does not name the 5th house here; it is inferred from the subject of children.
classical_check: Silent on mental state at conception calling a soul; classical texts do link a strong 5th and Jupiter with gifted children and garbhadhana rites with the mind at conception.

hindi: इसलिए विरले आत्मा होते हैं विचित्र किस्म के होते हैं इन सबके माता-पिता का हिसाब किताब बड़ा विचित्र होता है क्योंकि यह उनकी संतान नहीं होते
says: Rare and strange souls are born this way, and the accounts of their parents are also strange because such children are not really theirs; they are given to the parents from elsewhere.
cells_derived_method: Unusual children and odd parent-child bonds come from a 5th influenced by Rahu, Ketu, Saturn or the outer planets. The sign on the 5th shapes whether the oddness is spiritual, intellectual or material.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 5th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Teacher or guru-type child whose path differs from the parents.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 5th is Scorpio (Mars, Uranus in his scheme). Intense, secretive child with a dramatic early life and a break from the parents.

ambiguity: No specific combination is named; the 5th is inferred.
classical_check: Silent on this idea of borrowed children; texts speak only of afflicted or strong 5th for children.

hindi: राम का जन्म हुआ है यह भी नियोग द्वारा पैदा किए गए यानी ऋषि मुनियों के द्वारा हवन इत्यादि की बात कर करा के दशरथ के स्वयं के वीर्य के द्वारा स्थिति ना बने ऐसे कहानियां है
says: He cites Rama as an example: the birth was arranged through sages and a havan (niyoga type) rather than from Dasharatha's own seed, and says the stories tell it so. He says he will not discuss authenticity as it is a matter of faith.
ambiguity: Garbled in places ('करा के जिस प्रकार कहा जाए'); the claim that it was niyoga is his reading, he himself says he will not defend its authenticity.
classical_check: Differs: Valmiki Ramayana describes a putrakameshti yagna and a payasa given to the queens, not niyoga by the sages.

gist: Jokes that Brajesh Gautam will be hit with 315 stones for saying this; says it is a matter of religion, not of proof.

hindi: कृष्ण का देख के चले आप जन्म कहीं हुआ मृत्यु के लिए हुआ उड़ाकर ग्रह ले गए यशोदा माता गोद लिए माता-पिता मिले ग्रह कहीं के कहीं लेकर के चले गए
says: His second example is Krishna: born in one place, in a danger of death, carried elsewhere and raised by Yashoda as an adopted mother, so the child ended up far from the birth parents, as though the planets carried him away.
ambiguity: 'उड़ाकर ग्रह ले गए' is garbled; 'graha' here seems to mean fate or the planets moving the child, not a specific planet.
classical_check: Agrees with the Bhagavata story of Krishna carried to Gokul; no chart rule is stated.

hindi: ऐसे ही एलन मस्क है उसके भी माता-पिता की यही स्टोरी रही बेचारा बड़ा संघर्ष किया बचपन पैदाइशी में बड़ी अजीबोगरीब कहानियां
says: A third example is Elon Musk, whose parents' story is also strange and whose childhood and early life involved a lot of struggle, as in the other extraordinary-birth cases.
ambiguity: Biographical claim made loosely, with no birth chart cited.
classical_check: Silent; a modern example from a lecture, not a classical statement.

hindi: जहां जहां ये स्थिति होती है वो बच्चे छीन के लिए जाता
says: Wherever such an extraordinary-birth situation occurs, the child is snatched away from the parents, so these children get separated from their birth family.
cells_derived_method: Separation of child from parents is read from the 5th (and 4th, 9th, 10th) with Saturn, Rahu or Ketu. A 5th in a Saturn sign points to distance and duty, a Rahu or Uranus sign to sudden separation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Child grows far from or apart from parents because of duty, work or hardship.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 5th is Aquarius. A sudden or unusual separation, child lives away or is raised by others.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk end; 'छीन के लिए जाता' is read as 'is taken away'.
classical_check: Silent on a rule; classical texts connect separation from children to afflictions of the 5th.

hindi: कुछ कृपा से ही पैदा होते हैं उनका कोई पता ही नहीं होता क्या कहां चले जाएंगे
says: Some are born only by grace and nobody can tell what they will become or where they will end up.
cells_derived_method: Grace-born children are read from the 5th with Jupiter and the 9th; a strong, unafflicted Jupiter or the 9th lord linked to the 5th supports this. Sign of the 5th decides how it shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 5th is Cancer (Moon, Jupiter exalted here). Child comes through blessing and has a nurturing, intuitive path.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 5th is Aries (Mars). A bold, independent child whose path is not predictable.

ambiguity: Jupiter and the 5th are my inference; he names no planet.
classical_check: Silent on grace-born children; Jupiter as putra karaka is classical.

hindi: ऐसे कई बच्चे परमानंद योगानंद जैसे बाहर भाग जाते हैं घर से बुद्ध जैसे घर छोड़कर चले जाते हैं
says: Many such children run away from home, like Yogananda and Paramananda, or leave home like the Buddha; renunciation of the family is a mark of this type of child.
cells_derived_method: Leaving home and renunciation are read from the 12th, 4th and 9th houses and Ketu or Saturn. A 12th in a watery or Jupiter sign gives spiritual wandering; a Saturn sign gives austerity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 12th is Pisces (Jupiter). Spiritual search and leaving home for moksha.

Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 12th is Capricorn (Saturn). Austere, duty-bound detachment; the person leaves home for renunciation or work abroad rather than through sudden impulse.

ambiguity: No house is named by him; the 12th is my inference for leaving home.
classical_check: Texts give the 12th and Ketu for renunciation and leaving home; consistent.

hindi: वो अपने माता-पिता को छोड़कर एक अदृश्य माता-पिता उनकी कृपा लेकर चलते हैं क्योंकि वह ऐसे संभोग की संतान है जिस संभोग के दौरान मानसिक स्थिति देवतुल्य किसी आत्मा को बुला लेती है
says: These children leave the visible parents and walk with the grace of unseen parents, because they came from a union in which the parents' mind was so elevated that it called in a godlike soul.
ambiguity: The claim rests on the mental state at conception; there is no chart condition.
classical_check: Silent on this mechanism; texts do prescribe a pure state of mind at garbhadhana, which is broadly similar.

hindi: ऐसे ही दानव तुल्य भी होते हैं हिटलर की माता का रेप हुआ था और वो राक्षस पैदा कर डाला जिसने पूरी दुनिया में कतल नर संघार किया
says: In the same way demon-like souls are called by a union with a violent or tormented state of mind; he claims Hitler's mother was raped and the child grew into the tyrant who killed millions. This is his claim, not verified here.
ambiguity: The historical claim about Hitler's mother is not established history; I record only that he said it.
classical_check: Silent in texts; asura-type children are described in the Puranas from union at an inauspicious time.

hindi: यह आपके सप्तम भाव के लिए आपका प्रथम भाव सेट होना बहुत जरूरी है
says: For the 7th house to work well your 1st house must be set (sound), because the self must be settled before the partner can be.
cells_derived_method: Marriage outcomes depend first on lagna and lagna lord strength, then on the 7th. The lagna sign sets the nature of the self that the 7th must complement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus gives the 7th as Scorpio. A steady, comfort-seeking self meets an intense partner; the self needs to be settled to bear the intensity.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo gives the 7th as Pisces. A self-critical person meets an idealising partner; self-acceptance has to come first.

ambiguity: 'सेट' is loose; it can mean strong lagna lord or inner stability, or both.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: texts say the lagna and its lord must be sound for the results of any house to come.

hindi: मेरे जीवन में मुझे मैरिज के द्वारा क्या सुख क्या दुख मिलेगा क्योंकि उसके साथ मेरे जीवन साथी के साथ जुड़ा हुआ सुनहरे सुंदर पल है
says: The 7th shows what happiness and sorrow marriage will bring me, since the golden and beautiful moments of life are tied to the life partner.
cells_derived_method: Happiness from marriage is read from the 7th sign, its lord and its occupants; benefic signs and aspects raise it, malefic ones reduce it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 7th is Leo (Sun). Warm, proud partner; joy through admiration but friction over ego.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 7th is Pisces (Jupiter). Compassionate and devoted partner; joy is spiritual, sorrow from unreal expectations.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: texts read marital happiness from the 7th, its lord and Venus.

gist: Philosophical aside: all life we collect money and build property, but in the end the earth takes everything back.

hindi: 40 से 50 साल की उम्र के बीच हर मनुष्य को यह बुद्धि ऑन कर लेनी चाहिए यार अब जाने की तैयारी करेंगे
says: Between the ages of 40 and 50 every person should switch on the understanding that it is time to start preparing for departure from this world; recorded as advice only, not a prediction of any date.
ambiguity: It is a spiritual instruction on life stage, not a death prediction; it must not be used as one.
classical_check: Consistent with the ashrama scheme (vanaprastha after about 50), though texts put it at later ages.

gist: Lists life preparations: educating the child, planning the 20-year-old's wedding, godbharai rite, building a house, and finally preparing to leave.
Says that in the 20, 40 or 50 years we still live we should prepare to go, because the earth will snatch everything.

hindi: पैसा आए जा रहा है काम आए जा रहा है अगर आशीर्वाद नहीं लिया तो धक्के खा रहे हैं अभी भी कृपा की कमी से अगर ले लिया और चीजें बन रही है तो सब फालतू प्रॉपर्टी बन रही है
says: Even when money and work keep coming, a person who has not taken blessings (of elders) is still struggling for lack of grace; one who has taken them and builds property will find it largely worthless unless it is used with understanding.
ambiguity: The second half ('सब फालतू प्रॉपर्टी') is garbled; I read it as property being useless without the right attitude.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical advice to honour elders and gurus; no chart rule is given.

gist: Social remark that older people with much money walk dogs, have no wife or husband, burn money on luxuries and find no one to share love with.

hindi: प्रेम प्रेम एनर्जी का खेल है शरीर का सेक्स वासना यह एनर्जी का नहीं यह शरीर का चीजों का खेल है
says: Love is a game of energy, while bodily sex and lust are not energy matters but a game of the body and of things.
cells_derived_method: Love is read from the 5th and lust from the 7th and 8th; the sign type on each houses shows whether the person's need is more emotional (water signs) or physical (earth, fire).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 5th is Cancer (Moon). Love is emotional and nurturing, driven by feeling.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Strong bodily desire may run separately from love.

ambiguity: He does not name the houses here; they are inferred from the love and sex topics.
classical_check: Silent on energy versus body; classical texts treat the 5th as love and the 7th, 8th as sexual union.

hindi: प्रेम बड़ी विचित्र चीज है प्रेम आधारभूत सत्य है वासना सत्य नहीं क्योंकि वो तो समाप्त हो जाती है प्रेम लंबे समय चलता है
says: Love is a fundamental truth that lasts long, while lust is not a truth because it comes to an end.
ambiguity: Philosophical rather than a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the view that Venus-Jupiter bonds last longer than Mars-Rahu bonds, but he does not say so.

hindi: प्रेम ही नफरत बन सकता है वासना तो आप ऐसे रख सकते हैं नफरत करने वाले से भी रख सकते हैं क्योंकि वासना एक शरीर का अंग का शरीर की क्रिया है
says: Love can turn into hatred, but lust can be kept up even with someone you hate, because lust is only an act of the body and its organs.
ambiguity: Sentence runs across the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो हुई समाप्त हुई तो कूड़ा ककट जैसे बच्चे पैदा नहीं होने चाहिए वासना से प्रॉपर्टी बनाई नहीं
says: Lust happens and is finished and leaves behind rubbish, so children should not be born from lust, and property should not be built from it.
ambiguity: The caption 'कूड़ा ककट जैसे बच्चे' is crude; he means children conceived without love.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition that conception should be a conscious rite (garbhadhana), though the wording is his own.

gist: Exhorts the audience to prepare to leave and give back to the world, telling Mother Earth she will take everything anyway.
Says a spouse dies first, then the children and our bodies are kept by earth; nothing of the life partner or children is retained.

hindi: धरती ने तो सब ले ही लेना है शनि ने देना है शनि ने लेना है
says: The earth takes back everything, and it is Saturn who gives and Saturn who takes; he treats Saturn as the lord of all material gain and loss.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Saturn is karaka of loss, longevity and lasting material, though he gives and takes as a karmic agent rather than as a general giver.

hindi: उसी के पास प्लूटो पड़ा है यमराज भाई यम का द्वार उठा के ले लेता है इधर को आ समेट ले भाई
says: Pluto, who is Yamraj and Saturn's brother, lies with Saturn's portfolio; Yama opens his door and gathers in what is left, so Pluto carries death and final collection.
ambiguity: 'ए5 का यम का द्वार' is garbled; Pluto equals Yama in his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Yama is Saturn's brother in the Puranas; Pluto is not used in classical Jyotish.

gist: Says nothing stays in life, so be ready first-class for leaving; the class on preparation for departure will be given another time.

hindi: यह सप्तम भाव आपके विवाह का है और यहां से आपका जीवन साथी का हिसाब किताब है
says: The 7th house is the house of marriage, and the account of the life partner is read from it.
cells_derived_method: The 7th sign, its lord and its occupants describe the spouse and the marriage; the sign gives the partner's temperament.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra (Venus). Gracious, relationship-focused partner.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Serious, older or reserved partner.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is the house of spouse in all classical texts.

hindi: जीवन साथी के साथ बेड कंफर्ट क्या होंगे यह बारहवें भाव से बेड कंफर्ट
says: The comforts of the bed shared with the partner are read from the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: Bed pleasure and sleep are the 12th-house domain; the sign on the 12th and its lord show how pleasant or disturbed the bed life is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 12th is Taurus (Venus). Sensual and comfortable bed life.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 12th is Cancer (Moon). Emotional, moody bed life; sleep depends on peace of mind.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 12th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Bed life is moral and restrained, with good sleep.

ambiguity: The caption 'य बवे भाव' is garbled; I read it as the 12th house.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give the 12th to shayya sukha (bed pleasures) and sleep.

hindi: बेड मींस सोना जहां नींद आए बहुत अच्छी नींद आनी चाहिए
says: Bed means a place of sleep: the 12th stands for deep sleep, and good sleep is the first test of bed comfort.
cells_derived_method: Sleep is judged from the 12th sign and lord; a water or earth sign gives deep, easy sleep, an air or fire sign makes it light and disturbed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 12th is Gemini (Mercury). Restless mind, light or broken sleep.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 12th is Pisces (Jupiter). Deep sleep and rich dream life.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: sleep belongs to the 12th and to Moon and Venus.

hindi: सारी समस्याए खत्म है काम की चीजों की पैसे की अपने जीवन के अंदर थके रात को नींद आना चाहिए
says: If you tire out in the day and sleep well at night, it is a sign that your problems of work, things and money are settled; good sleep reflects resolved worries.
cells_derived_method: Good sleep shows a stable 12th and 6th (worries); troubled sleep appears when malefics occupy the 12th or its lord is afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 12th is Libra (Venus). Easy, pleasurable sleep when lagna and Venus are sound.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 12th is Aries (Mars). Restless sleep, anger and anxiety wake the person.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; consistent with the 12th for sleep.

hindi: नींद का मतलब क्या है स्वयं न है हम पैदा हुए पहला क्या लिया सांस मरे अंत में क्या लिया सांस
says: He says sleep means being with the self, as when we are born our first act is a breath and our last act is a breath; the caption is garbled but the point is that sleep returns the person to the self.
ambiguity: 'स्वयं न है' is unclear and could mean 'is the self' or 'is a state of self'.
classical_check: Silent; links with the 12th as moksha house but he does not make that link.

gist: Says breath accompanies us all life yet we do not value it, and instead spend our time wanting things and mourning what was lost.
Says the mind dies and revives hundreds of times, neither ages nor is young, recites the proverb that victory and defeat are of the mind.

hindi: ये मन का खेला है आपका यह मन अगर सेट है सब कुछ सेट है ये बैड कंफर्ट
says: Bed comfort is a game of the mind: if your mind is settled, everything is settled, including the comfort of the bed.
cells_derived_method: Mind is the Moon's domain; sleep and bed comfort depend on the 12th with the Moon's condition. A Moon in a water or earth sign gives settled mind, a Moon in air or fire signs a restless one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 12th is Cancer (Moon). The 12th house is ruled by the Moon itself; mind and sleep are tied tightly together.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 12th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). The mind is detached and sleep is irregular, tending to long spells of wakefulness.

ambiguity: He does not name the Moon; it is my inference from the word mind.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Moon is karaka of mind and sleep.

hindi: यहीं से संभोग होता है कि सेक्स की क्रिया कैसी रहेगी कि पति और पत्नी के बीच भोग कैसा रहेगा
says: From this house the sexual act itself is judged, namely how union and enjoyment between husband and wife will be.
cells_derived_method: The quality of sexual enjoyment is read from the 12th sign and lord with Venus. Water and earth signs give richer enjoyment, mutable air signs lighter, fire signs more intense.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 12th is Scorpio (Mars). Intense, passionate union.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 12th is Virgo (Mercury). Reserved, analytic enjoyment, more talk than passion.

ambiguity: The 12th is inferred from the previous sentence about bed comfort.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th, together with the 7th and 8th, shows bed pleasure.

hindi: यह उनके धन का खाना है पत्नी का धन यह ससुराल होता है वैसे पुरुष के लिए या स्त्री के लिए
says: This box is the spouse's wealth, which also stands for the in-laws, whether one is a man or a woman; he points to the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: The 8th is second from the 7th, so it shows the partner's wealth and the in-laws' house. Its sign shows how that wealth flows: earthy signs steady, watery signs through inheritance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 8th is Scorpio (Mars). In-laws' wealth is secretive and tied to inheritance or disputes.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 8th is Gemini (Mercury). Partner's wealth comes through trade and communication, and fluctuates.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 8th is Capricorn (Saturn). In-laws are rich in stable assets but slow to share.

ambiguity: The number 8 is stated only in the next sentence; here he points at the box.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th from lagna is the 2nd from the 7th, wealth of the spouse; texts also call the 8th the in-laws' house.

gist: Jokes about mother-in-law arriving with a gun and the daughter-in-law threatening to eat her up.

hindi: यह आठवां घर है लेकिन यह पत्नी से या पति से दूसरा है लड़की की कुंडली का पति यह बन गया पति का दूसरा घर उसका धन
says: It is the 8th house, but counted from the spouse it is the 2nd; in a girl's chart the husband is the 7th and his 2nd is his wealth, so the 8th shows his money.
cells_derived_method: The 8th (second from the 7th) reads the partner's income. Its sign and lord decide the level: Venus, Jupiter or Moon signs give richer in-laws, Mars or Saturn signs give strained finances.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 8th is Taurus (Venus). Husband's family wealth is comfortable and visible.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 8th is Virgo (Mercury). Husband's wealth comes from service or trade and is modest and careful.

ambiguity: None; this is the derived-house (bhavat bhavam) method.
classical_check: Agrees: classical bhavat bhavam gives the 8th as the 2nd from the 7th.

hindi: तो धनवान घर में जाएगी या गरीब घर में जाएगी ऐसे ही लड़का पत्नी को देखता है ससुराल बहुत बढ़िया ग्रह यहां बैठे हैं तो बहुत पैसे वाले घर की लड़की आएगी
says: From this house you tell whether a bride will go to a rich or poor home, and for a boy, if good planets sit in this house he will get a wife from a very rich family.
cells_derived_method: Benefic planets in or aspecting the 8th raise the wealth of the in-laws; malefics reduce it. The sign nature of the 8th adds to this: a Venus or Jupiter sign works well even without occupants.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 8th is Libra (Venus). Wife or husband from a refined and well-off family.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 8th is Cancer (Moon). In-laws' wealth is rooted in property and family business, and tied to mother figures.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: classical texts use the 8th and 2nd from the 7th for the in-laws' wealth.

gist: Jokes about becoming a ghar jamai (live-in son-in-law), eating free and enjoying parties.

hindi: यह आपका पत्नी से बारहवां घर यह मेरे से बारहवां हो गया यह मेरे साथी से बारहवां हो गया यह शत्रु यह मेरा शत्रु है लेकिन पत्नी का बेड कंफर्ट है
says: The house twelfth from the spouse's house, the 6th, is my enemy house but it is the partner's bed comfort; the 12th from the 7th is the partner's own 12th, so bed comfort of the partner is read from my 6th.
cells_derived_method: By bhavat bhavam the 12th from the 7th is the 6th, so the partner's bed comfort is read from the 6th (my enemies and illness). Its sign shows what the partner finds disturbing or pleasing in bed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 6th is Virgo (Mercury). Partner's bed life is shaped by anxiety, health worries and routine.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 6th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Partner's bed comfort is cool, detached or irregular.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 6th is Aries (Mars). Partner's bed life is tense and quarrelsome.

ambiguity: Wording 'यह मेरे से बारहवां' is garbled and cannot be 12th from me; I read it as the 6th from me and 12th from the partner.
classical_check: Agrees with bhavat bhavam: 12th from the 7th is the 6th. Classical texts do not label the 6th as partner's bed comfort, so the application is his.

gist: Sentence breaks off at the chunk end: 'यह शत्रु इसका यह मृत्यु', probably pointing from the enemy house to the death house, but unreadable.

hindi: यह छ आठ 12 यह तीन खाने बड़े खतरनाक है और यही अच्छा भी दे सकते हैं अगर यह बढ़िया है
says: The 6th, 8th and 12th houses are three very dangerous boxes for marriage, but if they are strong and well placed the same houses can give good results too.
cells_derived_method: The dusthana houses carry both risk and reward depending on sign, lord and aspects. Benefic signs (Jupiter, Venus, Moon) soften them and give gains, Mars or Saturn signs sharpen the risk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 6th is Capricorn (Saturn). Enmity and ailments are met with discipline; service and routine become a strength.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 8th is Taurus (Venus). In-laws' wealth and secrets are gentle and comfort-oriented, so the house can give.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 12th is Scorpio (Mars). Intense bed life and heavy spending, either passionate fulfilment or loss of control.

ambiguity: 'छ आठ 12' is read as houses 6, 8 and 12. Sentence begins with the previous chunk's mention of enjoyment and luxury.
classical_check: Agrees: texts call 6, 8 and 12 dusthanas, and say a strong dusthana lord can give good (viparita-type) results.

hindi: यानी शत्रुता हुई पति-पत्नी में नहीं हुई क्या पता
says: The 6th house shows whether enmity arises between husband and wife or not.
cells_derived_method: Enmity between spouses is read from the 6th (enemies, disputes) with its sign and lord. Fire signs and Mars give open quarrels, air signs verbal disputes, water signs hidden resentment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 6th is Aries (Mars). Open, heated quarrels between the couple.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 6th is Libra (Venus). Disputes are polite, argued through fairness and compromise, and cool off quickly.

ambiguity: The 6th is not numbered in the sentence; I read it from the list of three dangerous houses (6, 8, 12) and from the topic of enmity.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th is the house of enemies and disputes, though texts apply it to the 7th via a 6/8 or 2/12 relation, not the plain 6th.

hindi: बैड कंफर्ट्स कैसे हैं क्या भोग विलास बढ़िया इकट्ठा पार्टी कर रहे हैं कि क्या कर रहे हैं
says: The 12th house shows how the bed comforts are, whether the couple enjoy luxury and indulgence together, and whether they party together or not.
cells_derived_method: Pleasure and luxury shared as a couple are read from the 12th sign and lord with Venus. Venus and water signs favour shared enjoyment, Saturn signs reduce it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 12th is Taurus (Venus). Luxury, good food and sensual bed life shared with the partner.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 12th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Pleasure is restrained and detached; the couple is more likely to share ideas than parties.

ambiguity: The 12th is inferred from the previous point and the earlier statement that bed comfort is the 12th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of bed pleasure and expenditure.

hindi: या फिर मृत्यु संबंध धन धन भी यही है
says: The 8th house also covers death, relations and wealth; the wealth of the partner's side is found in this same house.
cells_derived_method: The 8th gives longevity, inheritance and in-laws' wealth. The sign decides the source: fixed water signs bring sudden or inherited money, earth signs steady holdings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 8th is Scorpio (Mars). Inheritance, secrets and deep crisis.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 8th is Pisces (Jupiter). Wealth and legacy come through trust, spirituality or the family of the spouse.

ambiguity: The 8th is inferred from the list of three houses and from death and wealth.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th covers death, longevity, inheritance and spouse's wealth.

hindi: ज्ञान ज्ञान आ जाता ना ससुराल मिलते ही पत्नी के
says: Knowledge also arrives through this house: once you get your in-laws, a wife (or husband) enters your life and brings new learning.
cells_derived_method: Knowledge from the in-laws and spouse is read from the 8th and 7th. Jupiter or Mercury signs on the 8th give learning and research, fiery ones daring knowledge.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 8th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Learning of religion or philosophy comes through the spouse's family.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 8th is Virgo (Mercury). Practical or technical skills come through the in-laws.

ambiguity: He does not number the house; I read it as the 8th in sequence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: texts give the 8th occult and hidden knowledge; the link to learning through in-laws is his.

hindi: पत्नी हमारी प्रथम गुरु होती है पति हमारा प्रथम गुरु होता है बाद की डेट में विवाह के बाद जीवन भर गुरु मिलते हैं
says: A wife is a person's first guru and a husband is a woman's first guru after marriage, and later, throughout life, other gurus are found.
cells_derived_method: The spouse as teacher is read from the 7th and from Jupiter in the 7th or aspecting it. A 7th in a Jupiter or Saturn sign shows a spouse who teaches discipline or wisdom.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). The spouse is also a teacher and moral guide.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). The spouse teaches through hardship and duty.

ambiguity: Jupiter is added from the guru word; he does not name it. 'बाद की डेट' is a loose phrase for 'later'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts say Jupiter is the guru, not the spouse, so this is his teaching.

gist: Says wife and children teach us in turn and that studentship never ends, we never know when we graduate or become scholars.

hindi: यह हमारे तीन मुख्य खाने हैं जिनकी डिस्टरबेंस से हमारे जीवन के अंदर पति पत्नी का लफड़ा होता
says: These three main boxes (6th, 8th and 12th), when disturbed, cause trouble and scandal between husband and wife in life.
cells_derived_method: Marital disturbance is read from afflictions to these three houses or their lords; malefics in them, or their lords in the 7th, are the usual triggers. The sign shows the style of trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 8th is Capricorn (Saturn). Cold, secretive distance and delays in the marriage.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 12th is Libra (Venus). Pleasure-seeking outside the marriage and bed troubles.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 6th is Gemini (Mercury). Sharp, nagging verbal quarrels and mutual criticism.

ambiguity: 'तीन मुख्य खाने' is taken as 6th, 8th and 12th.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: afflicted 6th, 8th, 12th or their lords on the 7th harm marriage; the 6th is not usually named for marital trouble but it is for disputes.

gist: Says husband and wife want to party together, enjoy life and hide nothing from each other, leading into the next topic of secrets.

hindi: सारे सीक्रेट का खाना ये है
says: This box is the house of all secrets, meaning the 8th, where the hidden matters of the couple are kept.
cells_derived_method: Secrets are read from the 8th sign and lord. Water signs hide deep emotions, fixed signs hide stubbornly, air signs conceal through words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 8th is Scorpio (Mars). Strong secrecy, hidden affairs or finances.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 8th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Secrets kept coldly and logically; a cool reserve about the past.

ambiguity: The 8th is inferred from the preceding list of houses.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the house of secrets and hidden matters.

hindi: अब सीक्रेट तब खुलेंगे जब पति और पत्नी में मैत्री होगी नहीं तो वो सीक्रेट रखेंगे 100%
says: Secrets are shared only when there is friendship between husband and wife, otherwise each will keep secrets for sure; friendship between the spouses decides openness.
cells_derived_method: Friendship between spouses is read from the 7th and 11th and the lords' mutual dignity. Friendly sign relations between the 7th lord and the lagna lord give openness, enemy relations give secrecy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 7th is Gemini (Mercury). Talkative, friendly bond; sharing is easy as long as Mercury and Jupiter are not afflicted.
