Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Both partners keep secrets, friendship is intense and guarded.

ambiguity: He says 'मित्र' without a house; the 7th and 11th are my inference.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; lord-friendship between lagna and the 7th is classical.

hindi: मित्र होते हैं सेवक भी यहां होते हैं सेवक यहां भी होते हैं अब अगर यह खाने भी ठीक है तो पति और पत्नी में मित्रता और सेवा भाव यह भी रहेगा
says: Friends come from one house and servants from two houses; if these boxes are in order, then friendship and a spirit of service will also exist between husband and wife.
cells_derived_method: Friends are the 11th; servants and service are the 6th. A good 6th and 11th give friendship and willing service in the marriage; the signs show the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 11th is Aquarius (Saturn). Friendship in marriage is cool, loyal and intellectual.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 6th is Pisces (Jupiter). Service is gentle and devoted, a spirit of helping each other.

ambiguity: He points at boxes without numbering them; the houses are my inference (friends 11th, service 6th, second box unclear).
classical_check: Agrees on 11th for friends and 6th for servants; the use for marital friendship is his.

gist: Says it is becoming too complicated and multiple, so the class will concentrate on the 7th house and put the other houses aside, mentioned only for information.

hindi: यह सप्तम भाव की डिस्टरबेंस अगर है तो आपकी तो पहले शादी नहीं होती फिर शादी के लिए तड़प रहे
says: If the 7th house is disturbed, first of all the marriage does not happen, and then you keep yearning for marriage.
cells_derived_method: An afflicted 7th (malefics in or aspecting it, or a weak 7th lord) delays or denies marriage. Saturn, Rahu or Mars signs on the 7th make delay likelier.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Late marriage with long waiting.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 7th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Marriage delayed, with a detached or older partner.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: texts connect delay or denial of marriage with afflictions to the 7th and its lord.

hindi: मेरा साथी मेरा प्रेमी ऐसा होना चाहिए यह वाली फोटो होनी चाहिए उसकी वो मिलती नहीं
says: When the 7th is disturbed a person wants a partner of a very specific imagined type (even a particular photograph), but such a person is never found.
cells_derived_method: Idealised expectations come with Venus or Neptune influence on the 7th, perfectionism with Virgo, so unmet ideal partner is likelier with these signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 7th is Virgo (Mercury). Partner has to meet a long list of criteria; faultfinding delays commitment.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra (Venus). Romantic image of the ideal partner and the wish for harmony that real people cannot match.

ambiguity: A general description of mismatch between wish and reality; no specific yoga.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अच्छा ऐसा वाला मिल गया बहुत पैसे वाले घर में शादी हुई है जी लड़की बड़ी सुंदर आई या लड़का बहुत अमीर करोड़पति बीवी को तरसा दिया
says: Sometimes the match looks perfect, marriage into a very rich family, a beautiful bride or a rich groom who is a millionaire, yet the wife is left starving for affection or attention; wealth does not bring marital fulfilment.
cells_derived_method: Rich partner with missing affection appears when the 8th (spouse's wealth) is strong but the 7th lord or Venus is weak. The signs show which is strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). The partner is respected and affluent but absorbed in beliefs and work, leaving the other lonely.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 8th is Taurus (Venus). In-laws are wealthy and comfortable while the 7th Aries side shows impatient emotional demands.

ambiguity: Caption 'रप के लिए' is garbled; I read 'बीवी को तरसा दिया' as wife left longing.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; wealth through the 8th and fulfilment through the 7th are classical.

hindi: ऐसा होता है बहुत बढ़िया हिसाब जगह किताब है जी बाद में तलाक हो रहा है
says: Everything seems to line up beautifully on paper, place and accounts all good, and then divorce happens later; good-looking matches can still end in divorce.
cells_derived_method: Late divorce after a good start comes from a hidden affliction to the 7th lord or the navamsha 7th. Dual and watery signs or Rahu hide the problem initially.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Quick, hot start followed by sharp falling out.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 7th is Cancer (Moon). Warm start; moods and family interference lead to a slow break later.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent on the sequence; classical texts give divorce yogas through the 7th lord and malefics.

hindi: बहुत शानदार शरीर है बहुत ताकतवर है बहुत बढ़िया खाते पीते घर संतान नहीं हो रही मेनी कॉम्प्लिकेशन
says: A partner may have a fine physique, great strength and a well-off family and still have no children, with many complications; looks and wealth do not guarantee progeny.
cells_derived_method: Childlessness in a seemingly good match is read from the 5th, its lord and Jupiter; Saturn, Rahu or Mars on these block it regardless of the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Children delayed or absent despite a robust partner.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Pisces the 5th is Cancer (Moon). Conception depends on emotional and hormonal conditions; mind and body need to settle first.

ambiguity: The 5th is inferred from children.
classical_check: Agrees: texts say a good 7th does not give children if the 5th and Jupiter are afflicted.

gist: Says such strange issues arise that the couple live together like rubbish, with no warmth, and wonders what is going on.

hindi: सेपरेशन को भी ज्योतिष में डाइवोर्स ही माना जाता है क्योंकि कई लोग डाइवोर्स लेते ही नहीं
says: In Jyotish separation is counted as divorce too, because many couples never take a legal divorce due to social pressure but still live apart.
cells_derived_method: Separation and divorce yogas are one category: afflicted 7th, 7th lord in dusthanas, malefics in the 7th or aspecting it. Sign on the 7th decides whether break comes through anger, distance or detachment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 7th is Scorpio (Mars). Break through bitterness or secrecy; couple may stay legally married but emotionally parted.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Separation through duty, work or distance, often without a legal divorce.

ambiguity: He applies the same yoga to separation and divorce; the legal status is ignored.
classical_check: Silent on legal divorce, which did not exist classically; texts speak of separation (viyoga) through the same yogas, so it is consistent.

gist: Mock dialogue about society: elders will not allow divorce, the girl has nowhere to go, and the boy asks her to stay as a goddess so his reputation in society survives.

hindi: नपुंसकता पुरुष की नपुंसकता हो जाती है यह बहुत बड़ी बात है स्त्री को शारीरिक सुख नहीं दे पाता
says: Another disturbance of the 7th is a man's impotence, a serious matter, since he cannot give the wife physical pleasure. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Sexual incapacity is read from the 7th, the 8th and Venus and Mars, with malefic influence from Saturn or Rahu. Saturn and water signs on the 7th make it a more likely theme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 7th is Capricorn (Saturn). Cold, inhibited intimacy is the associated theme.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 7th is Aquarius (Saturn, Pluto in his scheme). Detached and delayed physical bond.

ambiguity: Medical term used loosely, flagged; no diagnosis is to be drawn from the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: texts mention Saturn, Mercury and weak Mars or Venus on the 7th for sexual incapacity.

hindi: संतान नहीं हो पाती संतान होती है तो ऐसी हो जाती है कि बीमार है कष्ट है शायद मानसिक रूप से विकसित नहीं कोई विकलांगता
says: Either no child is born, or the child born is ill, in pain, mentally undeveloped or disabled; recorded as his claim about 5th-house trouble, not as a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The health of children is read from the 5th, its lord and Jupiter. Afflicting planets by Saturn, Rahu, Ketu or Mars on the 5th give the above themes depending on sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 5th is Scorpio (Mars). Issues around children's health and traumatic events.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Delays and chronic issues in children.

ambiguity: Medical language is his own and non-specific; flagged.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: afflicted 5th and Jupiter give childlessness or troubled children.

hindi: यह सब मैचिंग मिसमैचिंग बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी देखनी है विवाह से पहले
says: All of this matching and mismatching must be examined very carefully before marriage, since these troubles show up in the charts of the couple.
cells_derived_method: Compatibility is checked by comparing the 7th, its lord, Venus or Jupiter, the 5th, and the navamsha of both charts, not by points alone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Capricorn the 7th is Cancer (Moon). Check the Moon-sign compatibility and the partner's emotional needs.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus (Venus). Check Venus strength in both charts and the compatibility of values and money habits.

ambiguity: Starts in the previous chunk with 'यह सब'; 'matching' means kundli milan, no method is given.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts prescribe kundli milan before marriage.

hindi: अब ग्रह कहता है मैं तो कराऊंगा ही ल मैरिज तेरी ऐसी की तैसी
says: The planet, in his joking voice, says it will make you do a love marriage regardless of your wishes or social objections.
cells_derived_method: A love marriage is forced when the 5th and 7th lords connect or exchange signs. The sign on each shows how strong the pull is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 5th is Leo (Sun) and the 7th Libra (Venus). Sun-Venus link gives a love marriage that the family may resist.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 7th is Sagittarius and the 5th Libra. Venus (5th lord) and Jupiter (7th lord) connection supports a love marriage.

ambiguity: The caption is truncated ('ल मैरिज'); 'love marriage' is my reading; no planet is named.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 5th-7th lord link is the classical love-marriage yoga.

hindi: अब करें क्या यार तो अब हमारे को ग्रहों के हाथों 12 पर तो मजबूरी है
says: Humans seem helpless in the hands of the planets; he states that at the level of the chart we are forced by the planets.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is a caption slip and not used.
classical_check: Agrees with the deterministic view; texts also teach remedies.

gist: Poses the question of what can be done at the level of human consciousness so that suffering does not come automatically and blessings flow, a sort of autopilot setting.

hindi: यूजुअली हम एक टोटका मारते हैं घर के नॉर्थ ईस्ट में एक ईवी लाई लगा दो
says: Usually we do a quick fix: plant or place an ivy-type creeper in the north-east corner of the house.
ambiguity: 'ईवी लाई' is garbled, probably 'ivy' (a creeper); Jupiter is my inference from the north-east, the direction of Jupiter and Ketu.
classical_check: Vastu gives the north-east to Ishanya and Jupiter, and plants there are widely advised; he calls it a tona (quick trick), not a deeper cure.

hindi: जो जो उपाय कर रहे हो घर के वास्तु के समय तो वो घर फिर खुद को भी ठीक करता है कि मैं अभी देख रहा हूं
says: Whatever remedies you do for the house through Vastu, the house in turn corrects itself and the people living in it.
ambiguity: The end 'कि मैं अभी देख रहा हूं' is a filler remark.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; consistent with Vastu texts that the home influences its residents.

gist: Mentions putting a door phone in such cases, then says they will not go into Vastu here and that the subject keeps changing, comparing it to chemistry not entering physics.
Asks again what we should do to receive blessings, and introduces a story to answer.
Story begins: a very small cute baby used to pluck small ber (jujube) from the garden, climbing trees nimbly with tiny hands.
The baby filled a basket with his younger brother, both carried it to different houses and sold ber; the whole village knew the sweet little boys.
Each buyer weighs the ber in the home, holds the basket and pays the boys whatever he feels like, so the boys' payment is arbitrary.
The villagers feel wrong is being done and think of giving the boys a scale; boys also do household chores such as washing the car and cleaning floors with no fixed pay.
152 village elders gather, call the boys and point out that people take ber without weighing and use their labour, asking whether they never feel cheated.
The boys answer that it is fine and explain with a simple example that if someone steals ten of their ber they can pluck more.

hindi: दूसरे व्यक्ति के अंदर से चेतना जाएगी मेरा लॉस जो है वह चीजों पर है इनका लॉस एनर्जी बॉडी पर है तो इनकी कॉन्शसनेस खराब होगी
says: Through the boys he says that when someone cheats you, your loss is only in things, but the cheat suffers a loss on the energy body, so the cheater's consciousness is spoiled.
ambiguity: A karma teaching in story form, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the karma doctrine that the wrongdoer bears the effect; texts say nothing about the energy body.

hindi: इनके अंतर मन में चोरी आ गई इससे उनके डीएनए क्रोमोजोम के ऊपर एक लाइन पड़ेगी दोष कट कट का निशान पड़ गया चेतना पर कट लग रहा है लगातार
says: Theft enters the thief's subconscious and leaves a line or cut mark on his DNA and chromosomes, and repeated cuts keep marking the consciousness; he treats wrongdoing as a dosha inscribed in the genes.
ambiguity: Biological claim made loosely; not a Jyotish rule and not supported by genetics.
classical_check: Silent; the notion of papa-samskara accumulating is Vedantic, but its DNA form is his own.

gist: Sentence breaks off at the chunk end: when the cuts add up, the consciousness that runs them will (...) us; the rest is cut.
Asks who runs us and answers that the Self does, which controls the first and last breath; we never took a breath ourselves and do not forget breathing in sleep.

hindi: वो चेतना पे जो स्कार्स लगते हैं वो डीएनए पे स्कार्स है
says: The scars that are made on consciousness by wrong acts are at the same time scars on the DNA, so wrongdoing is inherited in the genes.
ambiguity: A biological claim made as an analogy; not backed by genetics.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of papa-samskara and pitri-rina (debt to ancestors) but not of scars on DNA.

hindi: वो डीएनए एक तो इनको सोने रोने और जीवन में सुख नहीं लेने देगा क्योंकि कटा हुआ है स्कार्स पढ़ रहे हैं एनर्जी के प्रहार पड़ते हैं
says: A scarred DNA does not let those who carry it sleep, cry or take happiness in life because it is cut and gets struck by energy blows.
ambiguity: Caption 'सोने रोने' is read as sleeping and crying (the ability to rest and to release).
classical_check: Silent; the link of ancestral karma to descendants' unhappiness is the classical pitri-dosha idea in general terms.

hindi: उसी स्कार के मरे पर जब ये चेतना लेकर जाएंगे तो यही पितृ दोष बनाकर बच्चों को तंग करेंगे
says: When a person dies carrying those scars in his consciousness, they become a pitru dosha that troubles his descendants.
cells_derived_method: Pitru dosha is read in the chart from the 9th (father, ancestors), the 5th (lineage) and the Sun, with Rahu or Saturn afflicting them. The sign sets the nature of the ancestral trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 9th is Leo (Sun). Sun with Rahu or Saturn here marks a pride-linked ancestral dosha involving father or authority figures.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Saturn or Rahu here shows ancestral burden passing into children, delay and hardship.

ambiguity: He names no planet or house in this sentence; Sun and Rahu are classical pitru dosha markers and are added by me.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: classical pitru dosha uses the Sun and 9th house afflicted by Rahu or Saturn.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं ना हमारे ताऊ जी का दोष लगा हुआ है मामा जी का लगा कौन से पितर का लगा है
says: This is why people say a particular relative's dosha has stuck to the family, an uncle's or a maternal uncle's, and ask which ancestor's it is.
ambiguity: Descriptive of common usage; no method to identify the ancestor is given.
classical_check: Classical texts distinguish paternal and maternal lineage by 9th and 4th houses, so partly consistent; he gives no such rule.

hindi: एनर्जी बॉडी में आ गए चीजी वाली बॉडी तो निकल गई अब रिलाइज हो रहा है भाई हमारे तो बहुत निशान है
says: After death the person is in the energy body, the physical body has gone, and only then does he realise how many marks he carries on his consciousness.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the Garuda Purana and general beliefs about the soul reviewing its deeds.

hindi: जब व्यक्ति मरता है तो चित्रगुप्त उसकी चेतना में मरते समय सारी जिंदगी की पिक्चर घुमा देता है उसको अपने सारे पाप पुण्य गंदे कर्म अन्याय अत्याचार सब ज्ञान हो जाता है
says: It is said that at death Chitragupta runs the picture of the whole life through the dying person's consciousness, who then knows all his sins, merits, bad deeds and injustices.
ambiguity: He says 'कहा जाता है', so he reports a tradition and does not claim first-hand knowledge.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic role of Chitragupta as keeper of deeds; Jyotish texts are silent.

gist: Says people who lie in ICU and return after touching death gain knowledge of their deeds, and after great shocks people change remarkably.

hindi: फिर वह भीख मांगते पितर अपने बाकी के बच्चों से कि मुझे रिलीज करो मेरे लिए श्राद्ध करो मेरे लिए पूजा पाठ मेरे लिए भोजन मेरा कुछ करो
says: Once the ancestors realise their wrongs they beg their living children to release them: perform shraddha, puja, food offerings and other rites on their behalf.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the Shraddha tradition (pitri-karma) in Dharmashastra and Garuda Purana.

hindi: एक ताई जी आई सपनों में उन्होंने बोला बेटा मैं भूखी हूं लोग कह रहे सपना आया रात को ताई जी आई थी
says: People report dreams in which a departed aunt appears and says she is hungry; he takes such dreams as a request from the ancestor for food.
ambiguity: Dream interpretation, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; dreams of ancestors asking for food are a folk belief, consistent with the shraddha tradition.

hindi: ताई जी की जो अवस्था थी मृत्यु के समय पति नहीं था तो कोई विधवा स्त्री ढूंढो पति था तो सुहागन स्त्री उसको खाना खिलाओ यह टोटका है
says: Remedy for such a dream: if the aunt died without her husband alive, feed a widow; if her husband was alive at her death, feed a married woman; he calls this a tona (folk remedy).
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition of feeding suhagin women for departed married women; not found in the classical Jyotish texts.

hindi: अगर वो ऐसे ही दर्शन देने आए हैं यूं ही आ गए तो आप बिल्कुल अनजान लोगों के बीच भोजन दे दो कपड़ा दो चीज दो जल जरूर देना है गाय कुत्ता कौआ सिंबॉलिक
says: If ancestors simply appear to you without a particular request, give food, cloth and water to complete strangers, and feed cow, dog and crow as symbols.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard pitri-tarpana practice of water, and food to cow, dog and crow.

gist: Claims that there is science behind these rites and not belief, and that Sanatan religion is 100 percent science and not a belief system; says he will discuss this later.

hindi: यह जो स्कार्स पड़ जाते हैं पित्रों के इस पितृ दोष के कारण आपके जीवन के अंदर आगे की सेक्स लाइफ को गवर्न नहीं होने देते
says: The ancestral scars of pitru dosha stop your future sex life from running normally, so they impair intimacy in marriage.
cells_derived_method: Marital intimacy is read from the 7th and 12th; pitru dosha through the Sun or Rahu in or aspecting these houses disturbs it. The sign shows the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Sagittarius the 12th is Scorpio. Rahu or Saturn here brings tension, secrecy and strain in bed life.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 7th is Leo (Sun). Sun with Rahu in the 7th is the pitru-dosha reading for the partner relationship, pride and ego clashes.

ambiguity: The house numbers are my inference from sex life and bed comfort; he names none in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; classical texts link pitru dosha to the 5th and 9th and to delay of marriage and children, not directly to sex life.

hindi: जितने भी जोड़े इस चीज से परेशान है कि मेरे पति-पत्नी के बीच सेक्स लाइफ खराब है हमारा बेड कंफर्ट नींद खराब है हम बेड पर ही लड़ते हैं
says: Couples troubled by a bad sex life, poor bed comfort, disturbed sleep and constant fights in the bed are the ones he ties to this ancestral scar.
cells_derived_method: Bed comfort and sleep are the 12th; an afflicted 12th (Rahu, Saturn, Mars) with pitru dosha gives these complaints. The sign determines whether it appears as quarrels, restlessness or coldness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 12th is Aries (Mars). Quarrelsome, restless bed life and broken sleep.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 12th is Cancer (Moon). Moody, emotionally driven bed life with disturbed sleep.

ambiguity: 12th inferred, since he identified bed comfort with the 12th earlier.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th governs bed pleasures and sleep; the pitru dosha cause is his.

gist: Jokes that couples have set up a four-by-four wrestling arena on their bed where they fight and then curse each other.

hindi: अब यह सारे जो विचार आते हैं यह स्कार्स है पित कृपा चाहिए
says: The hostile thoughts that arise between the couple are also scars, and what is needed is the grace of the ancestors to heal them.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent; pitri-prasad is a classical remedy for pitru dosha.

hindi: पित्र कौन है यहां संभोग के द्वारा संतान प्राप्ति यानी कि पित्र डीएनए जुड़ने दे रहे हैं
says: The pitras are the ancestors who allow your DNA to join with another's through intercourse and thereby give you children; they are the link in the chain of progeny.
cells_derived_method: Lineage and progeny are the 5th and the 9th. The ancestors' grace is judged by how these houses and their lords are placed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 5th is Pisces (Jupiter). Ancestral grace and children come easily when Jupiter is sound.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 9th is Aquarius (Saturn). Ancestral grace is conditional; discipline in rites matters.

ambiguity: House 5 is inferred from progeny; the 9th is my addition from the classical view of ancestors.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is progeny and the 9th ancestors and the father.

hindi: आपके खानदान में कोई दोष है इसलिए आपको पहले तो अच्छा रिश्ता ही नहीं मिलेगा फिर उसके बाद आपका अच्छा सेक्स लाइफ नहीं हो फिर उसके पश्चात आपको संतान नहीं मिलेगी
says: A fault in the family line means you will first not get a good marriage match, then not have a good sex life, and then not get children.
cells_derived_method: Marriage, intimacy and children are the 7th, 12th and 5th; ancestral affliction hits them in that sequence. The sign of each shows the style of the block.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Proposals fail or break quickly; the match is found with difficulty.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 5th is Capricorn (Saturn). Children delayed after marriage.

ambiguity: Houses are inferred; the sequence of blocks is his own.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: pitru dosha is held to cause delay in marriage and childlessness; the sex-life link is his own.

hindi: नींद खराब होगी फालतू के खर्चे होंगे व्यर्थ की शत्रुता फैलेगी और हर चीज की प्रेम की मौत होगी
says: Further results of ancestral affliction are poor sleep, wasteful expenses, spreading pointless enmity and the death of love in everything.
cells_derived_method: Sleep and expenses are the 12th and enmity the 6th, so ancestral affliction of these houses gives the list. Sign nature shows what dominates.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Taurus the 12th is Aries (Mars). Impulsive spending and restless sleep.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 12th is Gemini (Mercury). Spending on talk, travel and gadgets, and a mind that will not switch off at night.

ambiguity: The 6th is my inference for enmity; the 12th is inferred for sleep and expenses.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th governs sleep and expenses and the 6th enmity.

hindi: कहीं ना कहीं पितरों ने अपनी चेतना के द्वारा स्कार्स डाल रखे निशान कट लगे हुए हैं उस चेतना जिससे आप पैदा हुए हो अब उनकी सजा आप भुगत रहे हो
says: Anyone living such a life should know that the ancestors have left scars on the consciousness you were born from, and you are suffering their punishment.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of pitri-rina and inherited karma; the DNA scar language is his own.

hindi: तो उनके यह प्रणाम बहुत जरूरी है
says: Saluting and bowing to the ancestors is very important as the first step of a remedy.
ambiguity: Sentence is short and begins with 'तो उनके', so the remedy is only 'pranam' in general.
classical_check: Agrees with pitri-tarpana and veneration of ancestors as a standard remedy.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा कार्यक्रम राहु महाराज के पास है
says: The whole programme of ancestors, DNA and lineage scars is under the control of Rahu.
ambiguity: He means the pitru-dosha programme; Rahu is not named as the reason in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is classically a marker of pitru dosha (with Sun), and of ancestral karma.

hindi: राहु की पावर समझ ले आज संसार में राहु इतनी पावर फुली चल रहा है सारा सोशल मीडिया इज राहु
says: Rahu is extremely powerful in the world today, and all social media is Rahu.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical Rahu karakatva covers foreign, illusion and technology in modern readings, so social media is a modern extension.

hindi: राहु क्या है इत्ता केतु धड़ हां एआई आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस राहु है सारे काम अपने आप कर रहा है
says: Rahu is only the head (a small part) while Ketu is the trunk; artificial intelligence is Rahu, doing all the work by itself.
ambiguity: 'इत्ता' means 'this much' and he gestures at the head, which a caption cannot show.
classical_check: Agrees with the myth of Rahu as head and Ketu as headless body; AI as Rahu is a modern extension.

hindi: ये जो बकड़ बकड़ चल रही है बॉडी में कुछ नहीं कर रहा मैं सिर्फ यहीं से कर रहा हूं देख रहे हैं सुन रहे हैं सोच सकते हैं
says: As a head-only Rahu, he explains that he talks and does nothing with the body and acts only from the head: seeing, hearing and thinking are all Rahu's functions.
ambiguity: A spoken demonstration with gestures; captions are noisy.
classical_check: Silent; classically Rahu is mind-related illusion, but sense functions are normally given to Mercury and the Moon.

hindi: जितने लड़के लड़कियां शादी के बाद बेबस है लड़का बेबस है मम्मी बीवी से लड़ती रहती है या बीवी बोलती रहती है कर कुछ नहीं सकते यह राहु है ये पिटा हुआ राहु है और जगा हुआ राहु
says: Young men and women who feel helpless after marriage, with a mother and wife fighting each other and the man unable to act, are showing a beaten Rahu; the opposite is an awakened Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Helplessness in marriage is read from Rahu in or aspecting the 7th or 4th, where Rahu confuses family roles. The sign of the 7th shows how the helplessness appears.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Scorpio the 7th is Taurus. Rahu here shows family-driven pressure on the spouse and divided loyalties.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Libra the 7th is Aries (Mars). Rahu here gives impulsive, interfering spouse and conflict that cannot be resolved by the man.

ambiguity: He names no house; the 7th is inferred from marriage, and the awakened Rahu is only named, not described, in this chunk.
classical_check: Silent as stated; Rahu in the 7th is classically linked to unusual or troubled marriage.

gist: Jokes that he says the awakened Rahu is such that when the uncle arrives, with just one look, everything is fixed.

hindi: ऐसे आपका राहु यदि बढ़िया है तो आपको पित्रों की कृपा है
says: If your Rahu is well placed and strong, you have the grace of the ancestors.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Rahu is read by sign, house and lord. Rahu in the 9th or 5th in a sign ruled by a strong friend lord shows ancestral grace; afflicted by Sun or Saturn it reverses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Virgo the 9th is Taurus (Venus). Rahu here with a strong Venus gives protected ancestry and fortunate father's line.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aquarius the 5th is Gemini (Mercury). Rahu here with a strong Mercury supports clever and fortunate children.

ambiguity: 'बढ़िया' is not defined; strength is not measured.
classical_check: Differs from classical views, where Rahu is generally a malefic; a well-placed Rahu is possible but pitru dosha is judged from the Sun.

hindi: साउथ वेस्ट में पित नाम का देवता होता है डब्लू व में उसकी कृपा बहुत जरूरी है
says: In the south-west of the home there is a deity named Pitra, and his grace in that zone is very important for the family.
ambiguity: Caption 'डब्लू व' is garbled and probably means 'south-west'. Rahu is my link, as the south-west is Rahu's direction.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vastu mandala, where Pitra (and Dauvarika) occupy the south-west band; the south-west is the direction of Nirriti and Rahu.

hindi: सारा खेल वेस्ट का ही है आकाश तत्व है सब वहीं वहीं घूम रहे सारे भगवान कृपा देने वाले
says: The whole game is that of the west, which he links to the space element, where all the grace-giving gods move around.
ambiguity: West is normally the water or air element in Vastu, and space is the centre; his link is unclear.
classical_check: Differs: classical Vastu assigns space to the Brahmasthan (centre) and the west to water or air.

hindi: उस तरफ के देवता में पितृ जो है वो संतुष्ट हो गए तो आपके पास घर चलकर शादी का रिश्ता आता है बहुत बढ़िया आपका संभोग लाइफ होती है बहुत प्रेम से भरे बच्चे पैदा होते हैं
says: If the ancestors in that part of the house are satisfied, marriage proposals come to your door, your sex life is very good and loving children are born.
cells_derived_method: Marriage proposals, intimacy and children are the 7th, 12th and 5th. When pitru grace is present these houses behave well; the sign shows the type of blessing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Aries the 7th is Libra (Venus). Proposals come easily and the match is harmonious.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Gemini the 12th is Taurus (Venus). A pleasurable, sensual bed life.

ambiguity: Houses are inferred from topics.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; classical texts say pitri-tushti brings progeny and good marriage.

hindi: ऐसे आज्ञाकारी पूत पैदा होते हैं इनके एडमिशन भी अपने आप हो रहे हैं इनकी यात्राएं भी अपने आप इनकी शादियां भी अपने आप
says: With ancestral grace obedient sons are born, and their admissions, travels and marriages happen of their own accord, which the parents see as a sign of past merit.
cells_derived_method: Obedient and fortunate children are read from the 5th and 9th; a strong lord and Jupiter bring effortless success. Signs shape the field (education, travel, marriage).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with lagna Leo the 5th is Sagittarius (Jupiter). Children succeed in studies and travel with little push.
Derived, not said by him: with lagna Cancer the 9th is Pisces (Jupiter). Fortunate father's line and grace leading to smooth education and marriages.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: strong 5th and 9th lords with Jupiter give fortunate children.

hindi: जब आपने किसी के बेर का मोल सही ही दिया है तो याद रखें आपको शुरुआत से यह संस्कार लेना ही है कि भैया बेर का मोल तो पूरा देंगे गलती से कुछ पैसे किसी के मार लिए तो उसे फ्री में माफी मांग लो
says: When you have paid a fair price for someone's goods, ancestral grace follows, so adopt the habit of paying the full price; if you wrongly kept someone's money, ask their forgiveness freely.
ambiguity: Ties back to the ber story; the 'ber' is a stand-in for any fair dealing.
classical_check: Agrees with the general dharmic rule of honest dealing and making amends; no chart rule.

hindi: आपने इको किया ना पहाड़ों में जाकर अच्छा माफ कर दो उधर से भी आएगा माफ कर दो माफ कर दो आई लव यू आई लव यू
says: Linking back to the echo story: if you shout forgiveness and love into the mountain, the echo returns forgiveness and love, so offering forgiveness brings it back to you.
ambiguity: Uses the earlier echo image; the sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; resembles forgiveness-based remedies in Vedanta traditions.

hindi: इसे होपो नोपो बोलते हैं होपो नोपो नाम की चीज क्या है अपने आप से बोलना कि भाई अच्छा मुझे आई एम सॉरी
says: This practice is called Ho'oponopono: you speak to yourself and say I am sorry, as a way of cleaning inner scars.
ambiguity: 'होपो नोपो' is Ho'oponopono; the caption splits it.
classical_check: Not classical Jyotish: Ho'oponopono is a Hawaiian reconciliation practice, so it is silent in classical texts.

hindi: सबसे पहले माफी मांगी आपके गले में दर्द है गले से माफी मांग ली यार मैंने क्या खाया था बस माफी मांग लो आई एम सॉरी

ambiguity: A body-wise remedy for an ailment; flagged as not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; folk-psychological practice.

gist: Asks an audience member to write down the phrase and checks whether someone knows Ho'oponopono; asks whether anyone will name the steps and agrees to start with I am sorry.

hindi: आई एम सॉरी अपने गले को बोल दिया अपने आई एम सॉरी हृदय से बोल रहे हैं मुंह से शब्द नहीं लेंगे मानसिक बोला नहीं जा रहा मुंह से बोल लो प्रैक्टिस बिना आवाज निकाले आई एम सॉरी मन में बोला
says: Say I am sorry to your throat, speaking from the heart and silently in the mind without words from the mouth; if that is hard, first say it aloud and then practise saying it with no sound.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; a practice from Ho'oponopono, adapted.

hindi: ठीक है जी ये करना है आगे प्लीज प्लीज फॉरगिव
says: The next phrase in the practice is please forgive me, said after I am sorry, repeated in the same inner way.
ambiguity: Only the second phrase is heard in this chunk; the remaining steps are cut.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; the full Ho'oponopono set also has thank you and I love you.

gist: Sentence breaks off at the chunk end: 'अच्छा इसके साथ आपने क्या', unclear what he asks next.

hindi: करना है क्षमा भी मांगनी है देखो भाई मैं क्षमा हूं मैं गलती मानता हूं या मानती हूं उसके बाद आपने क्या बोलना है मुझे माफ भी कर दो
says: Step one of repairing a strained relationship: admit your own fault and ask forgiveness, then add the request 'please forgive me'. Acceptance of one's part comes before any other repair.
ambiguity: The caption 'मैं क्षमा हूं' is garbled; reads as 'I am sorry / I accept my mistake'.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish remedy; the sequence resembles the Hawaiian ho'oponopono practice that he names later.

hindi: मेरी गलती मैंने आज रिलाइज की लेकिन मुझे माफ कर दो उस व्यक्ति से बोलने की जरूरत नहीं है चालाकी से धो वशीकरण प्लीज फॉरगिव मी
says: The apology lines are said inwardly; the other person does not need to hear them. He calls it a clever or subtle way of influencing the person's mind (the word 'vashikaran' is in the caption), and the key phrase is 'please forgive me'.
ambiguity: 'चालाकी से धो वशीकरण' is garbled; the vashikaran meaning is a guess from one word.
classical_check: Silent; not from a classical text.

hindi: उसके बाद आपने स्वीकारोक्ति भी ले ली अब आपने उसको धन्यवाद दिया प्रथम आपने बोला क्षमा है ... आई एम सॉरी ... फिर धन्यवाद एक लाइन में चलेगा उसके बाद आई लव यू
says: The order of the inner phrases is: forgive me, I am sorry, please give me forgiveness, thank you, then I love you. They can be said in a single line. This ends in accepting the other person.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; same four-phrase pattern as ho'oponopono.

hindi: अब आपने रिप्लेस कर दिया कि ठीक है अब मैं आपको प्रेम भी करता हूं या करती हूं यह करने मात्र से आपने अपने अंदर के पहाड़ों के बीच नकत किया अभी अभी कि पुनः गठजोड़ कर लिया जाए
says: Saying 'I love you' replaces the old resentment. By doing just this, the person has opened a passage between the inner mountains of hurt and re-joined the link with the other party.
ambiguity: 'नकत किया' is garbled; likely 'a tunnel was dug' or 'a road was cut' between the mountains.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप अपने सिर दर्द से आपके बाल झड़ रहे हैं विटामिन डी की कमी है इसको छोड़ देते हैं
says: He mentions in passing that headache, hair fall or a vitamin D shortage may be present in someone, then sets that aside. This is a health remark only; no diagnosis is taken from it, and he does not link it to a planet here.
ambiguity: Caption mixes the apology topic with health complaints; the link is only made in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; health claim not recorded as a rule.

hindi: लेकिन आपको उसके लिए भी सॉरी बोलना है कहीं ना कहीं आपने कबाड़ किया है और इसी के बाद में आप उससे मुक्त हुए
says: Even for such physical complaints you should say sorry, because somewhere you have spoiled something yourself; after the apology you become free of the problem. This is his tradition claim that an apology releases the complaint.
classical_check: Silent; no classical Jyotish basis.

hindi: पितरों की श्रद्धांजलि देते हैं हम श्राद्ध करते हैं श्रद्धा यह आपके मन में श्रद्धा है यही श्रद्धांजलि है इसी का श्राद्ध किया जाता उत्तम फीलिंग के साथ
says: Shraddha (the ancestor rite) is defined as faith in the mind. The feeling itself is the tribute, and it should be done with a good feeling when approaching the ancestors.
classical_check: Agrees with the word's root (shraddha = faith); classical texts also stress ritual form, which he plays down.

hindi: गया यहीं बैठ के नाभी पर 10 उंगली लगाकर कहते हैं पितरों मुझे क्षमा करो मुझ पर कृपा करो
says: At Gaya, or just sitting where you are, put all ten fingers on the navel and say 'ancestors, forgive me and bless me'. A simple home version of the ancestor remedy.
ambiguity: '10 उंगली' read as both hands, all ten fingers.
classical_check: Gaya is the classical shraddha site; the navel-touch version is his own, not in classical texts.

hindi: भीख मांगते हैं भगवान से पत्थर की मूर्ति हे पत्थर की मूर्ति मुझे यह दे दे वो दे दे अंदर जाओ अंदर चिजी वाले से चिजी मिलेगी
says: People beg the stone idol for this and that. He says what you get that way is only material things, because you are asking the deity of material things inside the temple.
ambiguity: 'चिजी' is a garbled coined word, probably 'cheezein' (things, matter), set against 'energy' later.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Rhetorical question about why temple worship of God is not bad; caption is broken.

hindi: एडमिशन करा दे बच्चे का हो गया मुझे शांति दिला दे वो अंदर मिलेगी वो एनर्जी वाले देवता से मांगनी है
says: Asking for a child's admission gets you a material result from the material-level deity. Peace of mind must instead be asked from the energy-level deity inside.
ambiguity: Which deity he means by the 'energy' one is not named; it is the inner, subconscious self (his 'Munna').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो मुन्ना मांगेगा एनर्जी की बॉडी से हमारे बीच प्रेम हो आप बोल रहे हम हमारे बीच लड़ाई ना हो उसे नहीं पता सबकॉन्शियस को मुन्ना
says: The inner child he calls Munna, the subconscious, does the asking through the energy body. If you word the wish as 'let there be no fight between us', the subconscious cannot read the negation.
classical_check: Silent; this is a modern mind-model, not classical.

hindi: सिर्फ इतना कगा लड़ाई वर्ड सुनाई दिया है इको इको इको ये शब्द बोलना ही नहीं उसको बोलो प्रेम प्रेम स्थापित हो जाएगा संबंध अच्छा हो जाएगा
says: The subconscious hears only the word 'fight' and echoes it, so never use that word. Say 'love' instead; love gets established and the relationship becomes good. A rule for phrasing wishes in positive words.
classical_check: Silent; same idea as modern affirmation practice.

gist: Question put to the guru: if people do shraddha only as a formality, will the result be the same?

hindi: वो फॉर्मेलिटी के लिए करेंगे तब भी इसके रिजल्ट वही आएंगे या आपको जबरदस्ती मुंह बिचका के दवाई डाली होगी मम्मी ने बचपन में
says: Even when done only as a formality, the rite still gives the same result, just as a mother's forced dose of medicine in childhood worked although the child did not want it.
ambiguity: The caption is a run-on from the audience question into the answer; the 'same result' answer is inferred from the next lines.
classical_check: Differs from texts that make the rite's fruit depend on proper mantra and bhava; he says intention is not essential.

gist: Anecdote of a mother forcing a bitter pill, the child refusing, a slap, mouth opens and medicine goes in.

hindi: उसका असर तो होएगा आप रो पिट के करो भाव से करो असर तो होएगा
says: The effect will come whether you do the remedy grudgingly or with feeling. Sincere feeling is not a precondition for some effect.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चिजी प अगर एनर्जी बॉडी पर करना है तो श्रद्धा लाओ इसी श्रद्धा के कारण है इन्होने पैर छुए
says: If you want the action to reach the energy body instead of staying at the material level, bring shraddha. He then points to touching feet as a gesture that carries it.
ambiguity: Slight tension with the previous line, where he says the effect comes even without feeling; he separates material result from energy-body result.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Example: a son touches a relative's feet while cursing him inwardly.

hindi: बॉडी तो झुकी अब बॉडी का ब्रेन 6 12 12 पर है 12 पर मुन्ना गाली बकी 72 पर बॉडी झुकी 1/6 हिस्सा तो इसको चेंज कर देगा मुन्ना को
says: Even if only the body bows and the inner mind is cursing, the bowing is a small part (he gives a fraction like one-sixth) and still starts changing the subconscious. The exact numbers are not clear.
ambiguity: '6 12 12', '12' and '72' are garbled numbers; they may be a ratio of body to mind but the meaning cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सिर्फ झुकने से ही तो छह बार पैर छूते ही गाली बंद पांच रह गए बेटा रिश्तेदार पैर छुआ तो छू लो
says: Bowing alone reduces the inner abuse a little each time: touch the feet six times and the cursing drops, one count at a time. So just bow when a relative's feet are offered.
ambiguity: The counting (six, five left) is a joke-like illustration, not a stated rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बोलो यार तू खुश रह तू खुश रह भाई हमारे अंदर नफरत है साले तेरे पैर नहीं छूने बॉडी झुका देते हैं उसकी फॉर्मेलिटी के लिए
says: Even if hatred is present, just bend the body as a formality and say 'be happy'. The gesture is done without inner love.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर यह फॉर्मेलिटी भी पति पत्नी कर ले और प्रेम नहीं भी आता तो नफरत तो नहीं होगी ना
says: If husband and wife keep up even a formal courtesy, love may not come but hatred will not build up. The goal is no hatred first.
ambiguity: 7th house only inferred from 'husband and wife'; he does not name the house here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारी लड़ाई इसमें नहीं है कि पति पत्नी में प्रेम है प्रेम बहुत विरले लोग कर पाते हैं नफरत ना हो प्रेम होता है स्वीकारोक्ति
says: The target in marriage is not passionate love, because very few people achieve it. The target is no hatred, and love here means acceptance of the other.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: प्रेम का ये मतलब नहीं तू मुझे प्यार दे प्रेम मतलब स्वीकार
says: Love does not mean demanding 'you must give me love'; it means accepting the other person as they are.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Skit: husband smoking, wife scolding again and again.
Skit continues: wife offers to bring the lighter, husband calls her his life and offers to bring the moon.
Skit about tea and sugar, the wife saying he will go mad hammering for sugar, joking about whose father's money.

hindi: मेरे बाप की नहीं तेरी कृपा से ही भोजन आ रहा है तू ही तो अन्नदाती नहीं है हमारी तू ही तो इस समय घर की कृपा देने वाली है मेरे को भोजन खिला रही है
says: The husband should acknowledge that his food comes by the wife's grace; she is the household's giver of food and grace. This is a gratitude attitude that supports acceptance in marriage.
ambiguity: Said inside a humorous skit, so the tone is partly joking; the gratitude point itself is stated plainly.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Praise for wives who work all day with no weekend off, bowing to all wives.

hindi: यह आपका होपो नोपो है यह सर्वप्रथम है पितरों की कृपा लेनी है ताकि ऑटोमेटिक आपकी लाइफ के अंदर सही शब्द गुंजा मानो और भैया कृपा हो जाए
says: He names the apology, forgiveness, thanks and love sequence as ho'oponopono, and calls it the first step before any chart work: win the ancestors' grace so that the right words and events come into your life on their own.
ambiguity: 'होपो नोपो' read as ho'oponopono.
classical_check: Ho'oponopono is Hawaiian, not Vedic; pitru grace as a first step is a Vedic idea, but the pairing is his own.

hindi: उसके पश्चात हमारे ग्रह गोचर में इस सप्तम भाव में इस भाव में स्थापित ग्रहों की या दृष्टि देने वाले ग्रहों की वजह से जो लिखा है वो होता है
says: After the ancestors are pleased, what happens in marriage is decided by the planets placed in the 7th house or aspecting it. The 7th house is the spouse and marriage house.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house's result depends on which planets sit in it or aspect it and on the sign on its cusp. A friendly or exalted occupant helps; an enemy, debilitated or malefic occupant harms. Which sign holds the 7th changes with the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Aries lagna, Libra falls on the 7th, ruled by Venus, a natural spouse planet; occupants here are judged by their friendship with Venus.
Derived: with Cancer lagna, Capricorn is the 7th, ruled by Saturn; spouse matters run slow, serious and with delay.
Derived: with Virgo lagna, Pisces is the 7th, ruled by Jupiter; the spouse tone is learned and kind, and Venus is exalted here.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is the marriage house and its occupants and aspects matter.

hindi: अब यहां पर हमारा सूर्य यदि बैठा है या सूर्य की दृष्टि है सूर्य की दृष्टि और सूर्य बैठा का मतलब यह हुआ कि सूरज देवता या तो यहां [35:08] है या सूरज देवता यहां है
says: If the Sun is in the 7th house or aspects the 7th, it matters for marriage. The Sun being 'seated' or 'aspecting' means the Sun is either in the 7th or in the opposite house (the 1st), which looks at the 7th.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's effect on the 7th depends on its sign and degree: strong in Aries or Leo, weak in Libra, and mild in friendly signs. A house-by-sign view changes the flavour: Sun in the 7th in a fire sign is proud and dominant; in a water sign it is moody; in Libra it is debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th (Aries lagna) is debilitated, so the spouse area is lit by a weak Sun and the marriage tone suffers.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th (Libra lagna) is exalted and strong, but is the 11th lord in the 7th; strong, proud spouse and gains through partners.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 1st (Leo lagna) is in its own sign and aspects the 7th Aquarius, a Saturn sign; the aspect is firm but strained by Saturn's sign.

ambiguity: 'यहां' with no board is ambiguous; read as 7th house or the 1st house opposite.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun aspects the 7th from the 1st by full 7th aspect; the Sun in the 7th is classically seen as harmful to marriage.

hindi: सूर्य आपका यहां है या यहां है दोनों में से तो ये सातवें घर को इन्फ्लुएंस कर रहा है यानी कि इसके अंदर कार्यक्रम जारी है
says: Whether the Sun is in the 7th or in the 1st looking across, in both cases it is influencing the 7th house, so its programme is running inside that house.
cells_derived_method: Same as the previous statement: the sign decides how strong or harsh the influence is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Cancer in the 7th (Capricorn lagna) is a friend sign of the Moon; the influence is warm but clingy.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 1st aspects the 7th Taurus, Venus's sign (Sun and Venus are enemies), a friction aspect.

classical_check: Agrees in outline.

gist: Reassurance to the class that everything will come in time, slowly.
Says there was a question last class and he is adding a point on Sun and Saturn that he forgot to say.

hindi: सूर्य शनि साथ बैठा हो तो शत्रुता होती है बाप बेटे में इसकी एडिशनल है ये अलग टॉपिक है लेकिन जरूरी है
says: When Sun and Saturn sit together there is enmity between father and son. He flags this as an extra topic outside the marriage discussion.
cells_derived_method: The father-son strain shows where the Sun-Saturn pair falls by house: in the 9th or 4th it touches the father-line directly; in the 5th it touches the child line; in the 10th it touches work authority. The sign changes how it looks: in Capricorn or Aquarius Saturn is at home and the Sun is the weaker party.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun-Saturn together in Capricorn in the 9th (Taurus lagna) puts the father house in Saturn's own sign; father is stern and distant from the son.
Derived: together in Leo in the 5th (Aries lagna), the Sun is at home and Saturn is the guest; the strain falls on a child and the son's own authority.
Derived: together in Libra in the 10th (Capricorn lagna), the Sun is debilitated and Saturn exalted, so Saturn dominates and the father's name at work is eclipsed.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun-Saturn conjunction is widely called a father-son conflict combination.

hindi: मान लो सूर्य शनि यहां साथ बैठे हैं कहीं भी बैठे हैं तो सूर्य और शनि के बीच दुश्मनी होनी चाहिए लेकिन कहीं कहीं केस में ऐसा है बड़ा प्रेम है यार बाप बेटे में
says: A Sun-Saturn conjunction anywhere should give enmity, but in some charts the father and son are in fact very affectionate, so there must be conditions that cancel the enmity.
classical_check: Agrees that cancellation conditions exist; the specific ones follow in the next lines.

hindi: वो इसलिए क्योंकि सूर्य ने चार पांच डिग्री तक का ही सफर तय किया है सुबह सुबह का तीन चार डिग्री दो डिग्री का सूरज है जीरो डिग्री का है वो सूरज अभी गर्म हुआ नहीं वो इतना मीठा सूरज है
says: First reason: the Sun is only at 0 to 4 or 5 degrees of its sign, like a sunrise sun that has not warmed up. A Sun this young is sweet and does not fight with Saturn.
cells_derived_method: The degree rule is independent of house, so it applies equally in every sign and house. Where it matters is where the Sun-Saturn pair falls: in the 4th (home, mother) or 10th (work) house the softened pair gives a calm father-son link in domestic or career matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at 3 degrees Aries with Saturn in the 4th (Capricorn lagna); Sun is exalted and young, a gentle father bond at home despite Saturn.
Derived: Sun at 2 degrees Taurus with Saturn in the 10th (Leo lagna); the young Sun is mild and the career relationship with the father is smooth.

classical_check: Classical texts give balabala (infant/young/old) states by degree; this early-degree softening matches that idea, but the 4-5 degree cut is his.

gist: Poetic aside on the morning sun, the red glow of dawn that people greet with good morning.

hindi: या वो ढलता हुआ शाम का डस्क टाइम का सूरज है जो 24 डिग्री से क्रॉस कर चुका है तो यह जवान नहीं हुआ और यह बूढ़ा हो चुका है तो सूर्य लड़ेगा ही नहीं
says: Second reason: the Sun is past about 24 degrees, a setting evening sun that has become old. It will not fight Saturn at all.
cells_derived_method: The 24-degree-plus condition is not house-dependent. It matters most where the father or authority matter lies, such as the 9th and 10th houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at 26 degrees Leo with Saturn in the 9th (Sagittarius lagna); the Sun is old in its own sign, Saturn present; the father is aged and quiet, not hostile.
Derived: Sun at 27 degrees Gemini with Saturn in the 10th (Virgo lagna); the old Sun is spent and the pair does not clash at work.

classical_check: Matches the classical 'old age' (vriddha) degree band for the Sun, roughly 24 to 30.

hindi: शनि खुद वृद्ध अवस्था में है 29 30 डिग्री का है दो चार डिग्री का है यह लड़ेगा ही नहीं
says: Saturn can also be in old age at 29 to 30 degrees, or at only two to four degrees (very young); in either case Saturn will not fight the Sun.
ambiguity: The two-to-four degree case reads as 'infant' Saturn; the caption jumps between the old and young end.
classical_check: Partly agrees with the bala-avastha idea; classical bands are 0-6 infant, 24-30 old.

hindi: फिर तीसरी सिचुएशन के सूर्य पता लगा 5 डिग्री का है ये 25 है कायदे से शनि ये नहीं कर रहा ये अगले घर में जा चुका है और सूर्य यहां काम नहीं कर रहा
says: Third case: the two planets are far apart in degree, for example Sun at 5 and Saturn at 25. Properly they are not working together; Saturn is near the end of the sign, close to the next house, so the shared effect is not really operating.
ambiguity: Garbled; the 'next house' remark may point to bhava chalit shifting Saturn into the next house, which would make them not in the same house.
classical_check: Agrees that a wide-orb conjunction is weak; bhava-chalit shifting is an accepted idea.

hindi: ये यही है तो ये गलत फहमी में सूर्य शनि साथ बैठे हैं अगर यह साथ है तो लड़ाई तो होएगी पिता पुत्र में यह बैठे ही नहीं डिग्री का फर्क होएगा ही नहीं
says: People wrongly think the two are together just because they share a sign; if they are truly together there will be a fight between father and son, but a large degree gap means they are not really sitting together.
ambiguity: Final clause 'डिग्री का फर्क होएगा ही नहीं' is garbled and may be the reverse (a gap exists, so no conjunction).
classical_check: Agrees that conjunction strength depends on degree orb.

hindi: सूर्य 20 डिग्री का है शनि 20 डिग्री का है अंदाजा पासपास है 10 डिग्री के फेर में सूर्य के अंतर्गत जो होगा उसे सूर्य अस्त कर देगा अस्त मींस खत्म
says: Case of real closeness: Sun and Saturn both near 20 degrees, within about 10 degrees of each other. Any planet within 10 degrees of the Sun is made combust by the Sun, and combust means finished.
cells_derived_method: Combustion applies in any house or sign. Its effect on Saturn shows in house topics Saturn signifies: in the 7th it hurts delay-based marriage stability; in the 10th it weakens career structure; in the 6th it weakens service and discipline.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (Aries lagna) but combust by a Sun also at the same degrees (Sun is debilitated there); Saturn's strength is damaged.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th (Cancer lagna) and combust by the exalted Sun; Saturn is almost powerless there.

classical_check: Differs from the classical Saturn combustion orb, which is about 15 degrees; he uses about 10.

hindi: बिल्कुल वक्री जैसे हालात हैं तो शनि की औकात ही नहीं रहेगी सूर्य के आगे कुछ करे अंधेरा क्या कर लेगा इतने बड़े टॉर्च के
says: A combust Saturn is in a state like being retrograde; it loses its standing before the Sun, as darkness can do nothing against a huge torch. So Saturn cannot hurt the Sun or the father in that situation.
ambiguity: 'वक्री जैसे हालात' is loose; combustion and retrograde are different states, he is only comparing the weakening.
classical_check: Classical texts do say combust planets are weakened, but also say retrograde planets are strong, so the comparison conflicts with them.

gist: Carry-on remark that the Sun-Saturn addition was only a small extra because of last class's question.

hindi: अब सूर्य देवता यहां है अब सूर्य की डिग्री कितनी है कितना गर्म है भभक रहा है अगर थोड़ा सा सूरज है कोई दिक्कत नहीं है यानी कि दो चार पांच डिग्री का है
says: For a Sun in the 7th house, first check its degree, which tells how hot it is. A Sun of only about 2 to 5 degrees is a mild sun and causes no trouble.
cells_derived_method: The low-degree softening applies in every sign. Its meaning changes with the sign: in a friendly sign the mild Sun is pleasant, in an enemy sign it is merely quiet rather than harmful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at 3 degrees Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius); own sign and young, so the spouse area is warm without heat.
Derived: Sun at 4 degrees Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer); a Saturn sign, but the young Sun does not flare up.

classical_check: Classical infant-degree rule (0 to 6 degrees, bala avastha) also gives a weak result for a young planet; his 2-5 cut is approximate.

hindi: यह सूर्य पति-पत्नी के बीच गरमाई नहीं देगा फ्रिक्शन पति और पत्नी में होती है अगर सातवें घर पर सूर्य की इवॉल्वमेंट हो जाए
says: A low-degree Sun will not create heat between husband and wife. The friction between spouses arises when the Sun gets involved with the 7th house at a real degree strength.
ambiguity: This sentence splits across a thought; it sets up the next line about divorce.
classical_check: Agrees that a Sun in the 7th is a classical marriage-harming placement.

hindi: और तलाक करा के छोड़ता है इतना लड़ते हैं इतना लड़ते हैं बेकार की बात होती है बहस बहस फ्रिक्शन घर्षण सूर्य गर्मी
says: A hot Sun in the 7th ends in divorce: the couple fight over trifles, argument after argument. He reads the friction as the Sun's heat.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the divorce effect depends on the Sun's sign (see next rows) and on whether other planets support or aspect the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) is debilitated, so heat without dignity gives arguments and a high divorce pull.
Derived: Sun in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini) is in Jupiter's friendly sign, so friction is present but softened by shared values.

classical_check: Agrees in outline: Sun in the 7th is called a marriage-delaying or strained placement, but not a guaranteed divorce.

gist: Repeats 'they fight so much' several times for effect and jokes about saying it once more.

hindi: ये ठंड लग रही है गर्मी आ गई इस गर्मी का मतलब सूर्य को आपने एक्टिवेट किया अभी अभी ये सूर्य यहां होने से तलाक कराता है डाइवोर्स
says: A passing quip that 'the room just got warm' because he mentioned the Sun means the Sun has been activated; the claim itself is that the Sun placed in the 7th gives divorce.
ambiguity: The 'cold/heat' quip is a joke about speaking the Sun's name; only the last clause is the claim.
classical_check: Classical texts say Sun in the 7th harms the spouse or delays marriage; they do not say divorce flatly.

hindi: अब डाइवोर्स की स्थिति के अंदर क्या होगा अगर ये सूर्य अच्छी राशि का है एक नंबर का है आठ नंबर का है ऐसी कोई बढ़िया राशि है
says: Whether the Sun's divorce effect is mild depends on its sign. Signs numbered 1 and 8 (Aries and Scorpio, signs of Mars) are the good signs he lists for the Sun, so the damage is less there.
cells_derived_method: Sign grading is for a Sun in the 7th (or aspecting it). The same sign sits at a different house for other lagnas, so a good-sign Sun in other houses is not graded by this sentence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is the best case, strong and giving status to the spouse though pride may clash.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is in a friend's sign, Mars, so the spouse is firm and intense, with less damage.

ambiguity: He says 'number 1 and 8' for signs; read as Aries and Scorpio by the confirmed numbering.
classical_check: Aries is the Sun's exaltation, Scorpio its friend sign; matches.

hindi: या डल राशि का है 10 नंबर का डल है 11 नंबर का डल है दो का है तो
says: The Sun is dull in the signs numbered 10 and 11 (Capricorn and Aquarius, Saturn's signs) and also in 2 (Taurus). The sentence continues into the next line with the result.
cells_derived_method: The dull-sign grading is read for a Sun in the 7th. The house topics of the other lagnas change what the dullness touches.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) is in an enemy's sign; the spouse is cold or duty-bound and the Sun's warmth is missing.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) is in Saturn's sign opposite its own Leo lagna, so spouse relations feel detached.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) is in Venus's sign, an enemy; the spouse is sensual and the Sun's pride is blunted.

ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk boundary and continues at the next row.
classical_check: Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's enemy signs for the Sun; Taurus is Venus's sign, also an enemy; matches.

hindi: कबाड़ा सात का है बर्बाद तबाही यह सबसे खराब है
says: The worst Sun sign is number 7, Libra: it is ruin and devastation for marriage. This is the Sun's debilitation sign.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Libra can fall in any house, but for the 7th house he calls it the worst. In other houses the Sun in Libra is still debilitated, but this sentence gives no verdict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) is debilitated and sits on its own natural house of partnership, the worst case he names.

ambiguity: The 'कबाड़ा' belongs to the sign 2 line in the previous chunk; here 7 is called the worst, so the first word may be a leftover.
classical_check: Agrees: Libra is the Sun's debilitation sign, and Libra is the sign of the 7th natural house.

hindi: आपका तीन नंबर का सुस्त है छ का भी सुस्त है वो तो ढीले ढल है बुध की राशि है डिटेलिंग नहीं क्योंकि वह आती नहीं
says: The Sun in signs 3 and 6 (Gemini and Virgo, both Mercury's) is sluggish and slack, neither good nor very bad. He gives no more detail on them.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's signs are neutral-to-friendly for the Sun, so the result is lukewarm in the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) is in a neutral sign; the spouse is talkative and the Sun's heat is moderate.
Derived: Sun in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces) is in a neutral sign; the spouse is analytic, and the Sun's presence is mild criticism more than fire.

ambiguity: 'ढीले ढल' is loose; read as slack.
classical_check: Mercury is Sun's friend classically; he treats the signs as dull, which differs slightly.

hindi: तो सूर्य जो है यहां डिवास्टिंग इफेक्ट देगा ऐसी स्थिति में एक तलाक होना ही होना है अगर आपके सूर्य की राशि खराब है और दृष्टि भी अगर यहां से दे रहा है तो भी
says: A Sun in a bad sign gives a devastating effect on the 7th: divorce is certain. The same holds if the Sun is in a bad sign and only aspects the 7th from where it sits.
cells_derived_method: For the aspect case the Sun sits in the 1st house and looks at the 7th by its 7th aspect. The sign of the 1st-house Sun decides the harshness: bad signs make the aspect harsh.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st (lagna Libra) is debilitated and aspects the 7th Aries, Mars's sign; the spouse faces a weak Sun's hostile aspect.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 7th Cancer, the Moon's sign, an enemy of Saturn's lagna lord; cold hot clash.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) is in Saturn's sign; divorce pull by his rule, with the spouse being detached and rule-bound.

ambiguity: 'यहां से' means from the Sun's seat; read as the 1st house (opposite). 'तलाक होना ही होना' is his absolute claim, flagged as tradition, not measured.
classical_check: Classical texts do not make divorce certain from sign alone; he overstates.

hindi: अब यह मजे की बात सूरज की दृष्टि नहीं है बाकी जगह दृष्टि इसकी 12 की 12 जगह है लेकिन फोकस इसका सामने है सारा
says: Every planet actually looks at all 12 houses, but its focus is only on the house directly in front of it, the 7th from itself.
ambiguity: 'सूरज की दृष्टि नहीं है' may mean 'not only the 7th'; the line is a little broken.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish gives specific full aspects, not a vision on all 12 houses; he uses a focus idea to rank them.

hindi: किसी भी ग्रह का ऐसा नहीं है कि सातवें घर के अलावा दृष्टि नहीं है दृष्टियां है लेकिन फोकस कहां का है जैसे शनि की दृष्टि तीन सा 10 में होती है फोकस उसका तीन जगह है
says: No planet looks only at the 7th; it has views of other houses too. The question is where its focus lies. Saturn's focus is on three places, the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's special aspect houses are 3, 7 and 10 from its seat, so its focus falls on different houses and signs depending on where it sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) focuses on the 3rd (Pisces), 7th (Cancer) and 10th (Libra) houses of the chart.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) focuses on the 9th (Sagittarius), 1st (Aries) and 4th (Cancer), counting 3, 7 and 10 from itself.

ambiguity: 'तीन सा 10' read as 3, 7, 10.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th special aspects.

hindi: बाकी जगह तो देख जरूर रहा है लेकिन नजर नहीं पेरिफेरल विजन है वो साइड की चित्रगुप्त वाली
says: On the remaining houses the planet does see, but only as peripheral side vision (he links it to Chitragupta's all-seeing record), not as a strong look.
ambiguity: The Chitragupta reference is a loose metaphor for 'sees everything'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts have no 'peripheral aspect'.

hindi: इसलिए यहां पर सूर्य ने फ्रिक्शन घर्षण देना है अब किसी की कुंडली में यह स्थिति है पति पत्नी में लड़ाई होगी बेकार दोष दे रहे हो एक दूसरे को
says: Since the Sun's focus is on the 7th, it will give friction there. If this sits in a chart, husband and wife will fight and needlessly blame each other.
classical_check: Consistent with the Sun's aspect on the 7th being harsh for the spouse.

hindi: सूर्य का इलाज करो यार सूर्य का इलाज कर करने से ही होगा
says: The cure is to treat the Sun: only a Sun remedy will fix the couple's friction, not blaming each other.
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea of propitiating the afflicting planet.

hindi: आपके घर के अंदर e5 के अंदर सूर्य का स्थान होता है अबे बहुत टेक्निकल चीज है e5 के अंदर ध्यान से देखो घर का द्वार ना हो कोई सीलन नहीं हो खराबी नहीं हो
says: In the house plan, the Sun's place is zone E5 on the east side. Check there that there is no house door, no dampness and no defect.
ambiguity: 'e5' is the east-5 pada of the 32-zone vastu grid; he calls it technical and does not define it here.
classical_check: Agrees with the 32-pada vastu grid, where E5 is the Surya pada.

hindi: जिनके घरों में e5 में खराबी होती है वो अक्सर यही रोते रहते हैं बैठ कर के मेरे को सुनता ही नहीं मेरी को सुनता ही नहीं तो पति-पत्नी की यही लड़ाई होती है
says: Where E5 has a defect, couples keep complaining that the other 'does not listen to me', and this is the typical husband-wife fight. He links a vastu defect to the same quarrel.
classical_check: Silent; this vastu-marriage link is his own.

gist: Mock dialogue of spouses saying 'you never listen to me' to each other.

hindi: आप दोनों व्यर्थ लड़ रहे हो दोष कुछ और है
says: The couple is fighting in vain, because the real cause lies elsewhere, in the Sun or vastu cause, not in each other.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब इसके लिए क्या होगा एक्सीडेंट से पहले हेलमेट पहना जाता है इसके लिए पहले ही शुरुआत में विष्णु विवाह होगा लड़की का
says: The remedy is done in advance, like wearing a helmet before an accident: before the marriage a symbolic Vishnu marriage is performed for the girl.
ambiguity: He shifts between girl and boy; this line names the girl first.
classical_check: Vishnu vivah (marriage to a Shaligram or peepal) is a recognised classical remedy for marriage delays or afflictions.

hindi: अब सूर्य होता है अर्क यानी अर्क आग का पौधा होता है उसके पत्ते तोड़ो तो सफेद सफेद पानी निकलता है जैसे दूध की तरह तो अर्क देवी मानी जाती है
says: The Sun is called Arka, and the arka (madar) plant is a plant of fire whose broken leaves ooze a milky sap. It is treated as a goddess, tied to the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Arka is a Sun name and the madar plant is a classical Sun plant.

hindi: तो पुरुष की कुंडली में सूर्य हो यहां दोष हो तो क्या करना है लड़के का अर्क विवाह करा दो एक शादी करा दी पहले वो शादी काउंट हो गई क्योंकि शादी की सेरेमनी है
says: If a man has a Sun defect in the 7th, perform an Arka vivah, a symbolic marriage to the arka plant, before the real wedding. It counts as one marriage because the ceremony is done.
ambiguity: He says 'पुरुष की कुंडली' here but calls it the boy's remedy; the girl's Vishnu vivah follows for her chart.
classical_check: Arka vivah is a classical remedy, often prescribed before a third marriage; he uses it for a Sun defect.

hindi: जैसे हम खून का फया सड़क पर गिरवा देते हैं आपके गाड़ी के अंदर चोट लगी तो आपकी हड्डी बचेगी हम रिपेयर नहीं करने देते सूचक होता प्लेनेट
says: By analogy: letting a drop of blood fall on the road or letting the car take the knock saves your bone. A planet is only an indicator and accepts a symbolic payment instead of the real damage.
ambiguity: 'खून का फया' is garbled, possibly a drop or cotton swab of blood.
classical_check: Silent; the substitution idea is traditional but this wording is his.

gist: Advance-tax analogy: the planet says the ticket is already issued, like paying income tax in advance to avoid a penalty.

hindi: ऐसे ही आपका पेनल्टी नहीं लगने देता तो अर्क विवाह हो गया लड़के का तो उसने एक विवाह लड़की से कर लिया है
says: Once the Arka vivah is done, the penalty is not imposed. The boy has already used up one marriage on the plant, so the real marriage to the girl is effectively his second.
ambiguity: The final clause, 'he has done one marriage with the girl', is garbled and may mean the plant marriage is counted as the first.
classical_check: Matches the classical logic that a prior symbolic marriage clears the second-marriage or divorce yoga.

hindi: तुलसी विवाह सुना होगा आपने कृष्ण जी का शालिग्राम का किया जाता है ऐसे लड़की का होता है इसका विष्णु विवाह
says: Tulsi vivah, the marriage of Tulsi to Krishna as Shaligram, is a known rite. A girl's equivalent is the Vishnu vivah.
classical_check: Agrees: Tulsi vivah is a Hindu rite.

hindi: विष्णु विवाह के रूप है शालिग्राम विवाह पीपल के पेड़ से विवाह
says: The Vishnu vivah can take two forms: marriage to a Shaligram stone, or marriage to a peepal tree.
classical_check: Agrees; both are named forms in popular texts.

hindi: गीता में कृष्ण ने कहा है कि पेड़ों में मैं पीपल हूं सर्वोत्तम पूर्ण और पीपल अपने आप बकता है पीपल काटने का दोष कई चीजें आती है
says: Krishna says in the Gita that among trees he is the peepal. Cutting a peepal brings faults, which is why marrying it is a respected remedy.
ambiguity: 'पीपल अपने आप बकता है' is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: Gita 10.26 names Krishna as the ashvattha among trees.

hindi: यह विष्णु विवाह पीपल से विवाह आप घड़े से विवाह मंगल में होता है वो अलग है लेते हैं
says: Marriage to a pot (kumbh vivah) is a different rite, done for Mars affliction; it is separate from the peepal and Vishnu marriage and will be taken up later.
classical_check: Agrees: kumbh vivah is the classical remedy for manglik dosha.

hindi: शालिग्राम विवाह भी कर सकते हैं शालिग्राम अपने आप कटे हुए पत्थर है गोलगोल मिल जाएंगे पंडित जी के पास होते है वो लाकर कर सकते हैं घर में नहीं तो पीपल के पेड़ के पास जाकर
says: A Shaligram marriage is also fine; Shaligram are naturally cut round stones, available with priests. Do it at home or go to a peepal tree.
classical_check: Agrees that Shaligram is a naturally formed stone of Vishnu.

gist: Remark that these days hardly anyone performs this rite.

hindi: यह लड़की का लिखा है यहां ग्रह तो लड़की के लिए विष्णु विवाह लड़के का यहां सूर्य का दोष है तो उसका अर्क विवाह होगा
says: For the girl with such a chart, the remedy is Vishnu vivah; for the boy who has the Sun fault, it is the Arka vivah.
ambiguity: Which rite goes to which sex was blurred earlier; here the girl gets Vishnu vivah and the boy Arka vivah.
classical_check: Silent on sex-wise assignment.

hindi: तो एक-एक शादी हो चुकी अक्सर ऐसा होगा अगर लड़के या लड़की में दोष है तो ग्रह चाहेगा कि ऐसी जगह शादी कराऊं जो तलाक हो
says: After one symbolic marriage each, the damage is spent. Otherwise, if boy or girl has the fault, the planet will arrange a marriage that ends in divorce.
classical_check: Silent on this phrasing.

hindi: आप हो सकता है यदि लव मैरिज के योग हैं बृहस्पति वगैरह की वजह से होते हैं तो आप पीछे पड़ जाओगे लव मैरिज मुझे तो करनी है
says: If the chart has love marriage yogas, for example from Jupiter, the person will insist on the love match regardless of warnings.
ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति वगैरह' leaves the other planets unnamed.
classical_check: Jupiter is the usual spouse-karaka for women, but love marriage is classically linked to Venus, Rahu and the 5th-7th link; he names Jupiter.

hindi: तो जिससे हो रही है उसकी भी दो लिखी होंगी अगर लड़के की जिद है कि मुझे तो इसी लड़की से प्यार है मैं तो शादी इससे करूंगा और सूर्य का दोष है तो लड़की की कुंडली में भी चाहे मंगल बुध कोई दोष हो लेकिन उसके भी दो शादी होंगी ही
says: If the boy insists on this girl and has the Sun fault, the girl's chart will carry a matching fault (Mars, Mercury or another) and she too will have two marriages. The partner's chart mirrors the problem.
classical_check: Classical matching texts check dosha balance; the claim that a mirror fault is guaranteed is his own.

hindi: अब ग्रह कहेगा शादी करा दो इनकी फटाफट शादी होते ही तलाक कराएंगे दोनों दोनों की तलाक लिखा है भाई
says: The planets will push for a quick wedding and then arrange the divorce, since divorce is written for both.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और आप मरते मर जाओगे उनकी शादी होके रहेगी और फिर आप कहेंगे हमने पंडित जी से भी मिला लिया था हमने दक्षिणा भी दे दी थी पार्टी भी करा दी थी यह तलाक क्यों हो गया वो तलाक के लिए ही शादी हो रही है
says: Even if the family opposes, the wedding will happen. Matching with a pandit, dakshina and a party will not prevent the divorce, because the marriage itself is happening for the purpose of divorce.
classical_check: Differs from classical guidance, which says matching and muhurta reduce risk; he says they do not help here.

hindi: इसलिए उस शादी से पहले आपको यह उपाय करने ही पड़ेंगे यह पूजा बहुत जरूरी है इसके दान करो दक्षिणा करो
says: So the remedies must be done before the wedding: this puja is very necessary, along with charity and dakshina.
classical_check: Agrees with the general rule of doing remedies before marriage.

hindi: नहीं तो कोर्ट कचहरी में 4 साल में वकील इतना पैसा ले लेंगे और आत्मा इतनी सूख जाएगी कि आपके भी डीएनए के स्कार्ज लग जाएंगे पितरों के पितर बनने पे आप भी रोगे और तंग करोगे
says: Without the remedy, four years of court cases will cost heavy lawyers' fees and drain the soul, leaving scars on your own DNA, which you will carry to the ancestor state and trouble others with.
ambiguity: The DNA-scar claim is a loose metaphor about legal strain; the ancestor part is garbled at the end of the line.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Quip about money money money, pay in advance or the lawyers charge a penalty.
Says there is a class on this topic; the word before it is garbled.
Moves on to the Moon in the 7th, saying the sign-by-sign accounts were already discussed earlier so he will not repeat them.

hindi: चंद्रमा यहां है या चंद्रमा का यहां लिंक है यह लिंक कैसे है कभी-कभी होता क्या चंद्रमा यहां बैठा है और मूव करके यहां आ गया है
says: The Moon can be linked to the 7th by sitting in it, or by sitting in another house and moving to the 7th in a different chart view. The Moon is not always in the same house across all charts.
cells_derived_method: The link depends on the chart type. The Moon at a house boundary in D1 can fall in the next house in a bhava or other chart, so the house and sign cell shifts by one between chart views.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon at the very end of Gemini in the 6th (lagna Capricorn) can count as being in the 7th house, Cancer, in a bhava-based view.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) is in its own sign and gives the loving-spouse reading he describes.

ambiguity: The 'यहां' of each seat is not named; he draws on a board.
classical_check: Agrees that bhava chalit can move a planet to the next house.

hindi: चंद्रमा यहां बैठ के भी यहां मूव कर सकता है यहां से भी यह आ सकता है ऐसा भी होता है क्योंकि यह एक अलग कुंडली देखेंगे आज समय मिला तो उसकी बात होगी उस कुंडली का कोई नामकरण करना पड़ेगा
says: The Moon seated in one house may count in another in a separate kind of chart. He says he will look at that separate chart today if time permits and needs to name it.
ambiguity: The 'separate chart' is unnamed; it may be Moon-lagna, bhava chalit, or his own chart; unclear.
classical_check: Silent on which chart he means.

hindi: अबे चचंदा मामा जो है यहां बैठा है तो यह मन कहां है मन खुद में है लेकिन पत्नी को या पति को देख रहा है अगर मन यहीं बैठा है तो
says: The Moon is the mind. With the Moon in the 7th, the mind itself stays in the person but its attention is on the wife or husband. The effect of this follows in the next lines.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's sign sets how the mind attends to the spouse: in Cancer or Taurus it is caring and stable, in Scorpio it is intense and suspicious, in Capricorn it is reserved.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives a steady, devoted mind toward the spouse.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) makes the mind anxious and doubting about the spouse.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the mind karaka; Moon in the 7th is often read as a mind drawn to partnerships.

hindi: बहुत आपके प्रति प्रेम रखने वाली स्त्री मिलेगी बहुत आपके मन आपके प्रति प्रेम रखने वाला पति मिलेगा आपका मन वही है
says: With the Moon (mind) in the 7th, a man gets a wife who loves him deeply, and a woman gets a loving husband, because the mind is placed on the spouse.
cells_derived_method: The warmth of this love reading depends on the Moon's sign: in Cancer or Taurus it is full, in Capricorn it is reserved, in Scorpio it is intense and watchful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) is in its own sign; devoted, caring spouse.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) is in Saturn's sign; the spouse's love is steady but undemonstrative.

classical_check: Agrees in outline: Moon in the 7th gives an affectionate, emotional spouse, though classical texts also warn of changeable moods.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा कुंडली में कहीं भी है और चंद्रमा अच्छी राशि का बैठा है चंद्रमा चार नंबर अपनी राशि होती है इसकी दो नंबर बढ़िया होता है
says: With the Moon anywhere in the chart, the good signs are number 4 (Cancer, its own sign) and number 2 (Taurus, its exaltation), which he calls excellent.
cells_derived_method: The sign grade is house-independent, but the house decides which life area the good Moon helps. In the 4th it helps home and mother, in the 10th the public name, in the 7th the spouse.
