derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) gives deep home peace and a strong mother bond.
Derived: Moon in its own Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) gives a public, caring career with popularity.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives a stable, comfort-loving spouse.

classical_check: Agrees: Cancer is the Moon's own sign and Taurus its exaltation.

hindi: इसका एक नंबर बहुत गंदा है आठ नंबर बहुत गंदा है नेगेटिव है अगर चंद्रमा की यहां पर एक या आठ नंबर राशि एक्टिवेटेड है तो भी डाइवोर्स है तलाक होएगा ही होएगा किसी भी हालत में छूटेगा ही नहीं
says: For the Moon, signs 1 (Aries) and 8 (Scorpio) are very bad. If the Moon's sign linked to the 7th is Aries or Scorpio, divorce is certain whatever else is there.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house is touched by Aries or Scorpio for two lagnas: Libra lagna (Aries as the 7th) and Taurus lagna (Scorpio as the 7th). Moon sitting in those signs outside the 7th carries the weaker reading from the earlier lines.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is his worst case: suspicion, hurt and divorce pull.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is hasty and combative, with quarrels, in his view a divorce yoga.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is read as the 7th. 'Certain divorce' is his absolute claim; flagged as tradition.
classical_check: Scorpio is the Moon's debilitation; Aries is not, classically a neutral sign for the Moon, so his grading differs.

hindi: आपका चंद्रमा दो चार का कहीं पर भी कुंडली में बैठा है सौम्य राशि में है सात नंबर का चंद्रमा बहुत अच्छा होता है तीन और छह नंबर एवरेज है
says: The Moon in 2 or 4 anywhere is in a gentle sign; in 7 (Libra) it is very good; in 3 and 6 (Gemini and Virgo) it is average.
cells_derived_method: These grades are by sign only; the house shows which area is soft or average.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in the 1st (lagna Libra) is a very good, balanced mind and a charming self-image.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius) is average: a changeable mind in matters of children and study.
Derived: Moon in Virgo in the 8th (lagna Aquarius) is average: the mind is analytical about hidden matters.

classical_check: Libra is a neutral-to-friendly sign for the Moon classically; calling it 'very good' is his own grading.

hindi: हिसाब किताब में इस प्रकार लेकिन चंद्रमा में दोष एक और आठ का ही है मुख्य 10 और 11 नंबर है तो दबा हुआ चंद्रमा है
says: In this grading, the real faults of the Moon come only from signs 1 and 8. The signs 10 and 11 (Saturn's signs) give a suppressed, held-down Moon, which is a lesser issue.
cells_derived_method: The house sets which area is suppressed: in the 4th the Moon feels pressed at home, in the 7th the spouse bond feels restrained.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) is suppressed at home, with a restrained mother and a cold emotional climate.
Derived: Moon in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) is detached; the spouse bond is controlled rather than fought.

classical_check: Silent on the 'suppressed' term; Saturn's signs are neutral-to-enemy for the Moon in classical lists.

gist: Tells the class that clarity will come as they keep attending the classes.
Analogy of a child in 10th class wondering why calculus and physics are taught.
Analogy continues: only a few become scientists at NASA who use the basics; few polish a diamond.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा कहीं भी अच्छा बैठा है आपका य कहीं भी अच्छा बैठा है आपको पत्नी अच्छी ही मिलेगी पति आपको ठीक ही मिलेगा
says: A well-placed Moon in any house gives a good wife, or a decent husband, as marriage result.
cells_derived_method: The strength of this shows in the Moon's sign dignity and house. The 'good' here is by the sign grading earlier: Cancer, Taurus, Libra are well-placed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) gives luck and a supportive wife through dharma.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) gives a family-minded, comforting spouse and a rich home.

ambiguity: 'अच्छा बैठा' is only loosely defined; read via his sign grading.
classical_check: Partly agrees; a strong Moon helps, but classical texts judge the 7th house and Venus for the spouse too.

hindi: लेकिन चंद्रमा स्त्री ग्रह है इसलिए पुरुष के लिए तो चंद्रमा गारंटी देता है कि पत्नी का सुख तो मिलेगा भाई स्त्री के लिए बृहस्पति कार्य करेगा इसमें कि कितना ज्यादा उसके लिए प्रेमी रहेगा
says: The Moon is a feminine planet, so for a man it guarantees wife's happiness. For a woman, Jupiter does this work and shows how much of a lover the husband will be.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the husband karaka for a woman; for a man Venus is the usual wife karaka, and the Moon is a secondary one, so naming the Moon is his own emphasis.

hindi: सूर्य अच्छा होगा उसूल वाला पति मिलेगा बहुत उसूल वाला ऑटोमेटिक पुरुष और स्त्री ग्रह होते हैं
says: For a woman, a good Sun gives a husband of firm principles. He also notes planets are masculine or feminine by nature.
ambiguity: The 'male and female planets' tail is a loose aside.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun can signify a husband of authority in a woman's chart.

hindi: लेकिन चंद्रमा पुरुष का भी अच्छा है तो इसका मतलब वो स्त्री के साथ सच्चा ही है गुड ही रहेगा कभी भी ऐसा नहीं करेगा उसका अहित चाहे उसका बुरा
says: If a man's Moon is good, he stays true and good to women and will never wish harm to his wife or do wrong to her.
classical_check: Silent; his own character inference.

hindi: अब यही चंद्रमा खराब है मान लो चंद्रमा यहां हो गया नीच का एक आठ नंबर का यहां हो गया नीच का एक आठ का यहां हो गया नीच का एक आठ
says: Now the bad Moon: he calls the Moon in signs 1 and 8 'debilitated' in several houses he draws on the board. Only Scorpio is the real debilitation; Aries is not.
cells_derived_method: The result varies with the house the bad-sign Moon sits in; the 7th is treated separately in the next lines.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) is debilitated; courage and siblings suffer emotionally.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) is restless and quarrelsome in public life, though not truly debilitated.

ambiguity: The board houses are not named in the caption.
classical_check: Differs: only Scorpio is the Moon's debilitation sign; he lumps Aries in with it.

hindi: का और यहां हो गया तो इसकी एक अलग कहानी बन जाती है चूंकि यह चंद्रमा नहीं फिथ का बुरा है तो बुरा ही होगा
says: A fourth seat for the bad-sign Moon makes a separate story, and because the Moon's sign is bad it will give bad results in that seat.
ambiguity: 'नहीं फिथ का' is garbled; the meaning 'bad in sign, so bad' is a best guess.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यह चंद्रमा यहां के अलावा इस राशि में कहीं भी बैठ गया तो सत्यानाश और बर्बादी कर देगा खत्म करके नाश कर देगा पर यहां बैठा है तो ये ऑलरेडी खराब योग है यह कम खराब वाला है य बहुत ज्यादा खराब वाला है
says: A bad-sign Moon in other houses will ruin and destroy. In the seat he is pointing at, it is already a bad yoga; he contrasts the less bad seat with the very bad one.
ambiguity: Which houses are 'here' and 'there' is not recoverable from the caption; he is pointing at a board.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसका फायदा क्या है यहां पर यहां पर ये चंद्रमा दो या सात नंबर राशि को उठाएगा तो भाग्य को बड़ा भयंकर उठा देता है ऐसे आदमी को भाग्य से ही काम हो जाते हैं कृपा से
says: The benefit he sees: when the Moon is here and raises sign 2 or 7 (Taurus or Libra), fortune rises very strongly, and such a person's work is done through luck and grace.
cells_derived_method: Sign 2 or 7 on the 9th-house side raises fortune; which houses are in play is not stated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) lifts fortune through balanced dealings and partnerships.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 9th (lagna Virgo) gives luck, grace and support from elders.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर यहां पर' refer to board seats; which house 'raises' the sign is not stated. The 9th is only my guess for fortune.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए यह वाला हमारे पास ओके है एक और आठ यह बैड स्थान में बैड हो के ग्रह बैठ जाए तो उसके बैड इफेक्ट डेड खत्म हो गए
says: So that one is acceptable: a bad planet (the Moon in sign 1 or 8) sitting in a bad house kills its own bad effect, the bad cancels the bad.
cells_derived_method: A house counted bad is a dusthana (6, 8, 12), where negative on negative cancels. A bad-sign Moon in those houses is partly rescued.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) is debilitated in a dusthana, so the damage is partly self-cancelled.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) sits in a dusthana, the loss area, and the harsh sign effect is softened.

ambiguity: His 'bad place' is not defined; read as dusthana.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with viparita-style cancelling, but classical rules apply this to dusthana lords, not planets in sign.

hindi: इसलिए ऐसे पति या पत्नी जिनका सातवें घर से लिंक है और चंद्रमा अच्छा है वो एक दूसरे के बहुत स होते हैं जिसका हो यानी उसको साथी का तो प्रेम मिलेगा ही मिलेगा सत्य है जिनका चंद्रमा यहां बैठा है राशि कोई भी हो
says: A husband or wife whose Moon is linked to the 7th and is good will be very close, and the one with the Moon in the 7th gets the partner's love for sure. This holds in any sign for the Moon seated in the 7th.
cells_derived_method: He says any sign, but this conflicts with the earlier claim that Aries or Scorpio gives sure divorce. The sign changes the flavour of the love.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a talkative, lively partner and love expressed through conversation.
Derived: Moon in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini) gives a principled, travelling partner who loves openly.

ambiguity: 'राशि कोई भी हो' conflicts with the earlier 1 and 8 rule; the order suggests 'in a good sign'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसमें एक छोटा सा पंगा क्या है जो पति-पत्नी के झगड़ा कराता है चंदा मामा का यहां डिफेक्ट है या यहां डिफेक्ट है
says: There is a small catch that makes husband and wife quarrel: the Moon having a defect in one seat or in the other seat he points to.
cells_derived_method: The two seats are read as the 7th and the 1st, from which the Moon looks at the 7th.
ambiguity: The seats are board pointers; the 7th and the 1st are my reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो एक्चुअली यहां बैठा चांद भी यहां देख रहा है और यहां पर तो बैठा ही है तो ये ना वी लोग होते हैं शक करेंगे और बेड कंफर्ट है सेक्स लाइफ होती है यहां से यहां वाला भी यहां देख रहा है
says: A Moon in the 7th looks at the 1st and also sits in the 7th, while a Moon in the 1st looks across at the 7th, so both seats influence the partnership. Such people turn suspicious, and the bed and sex life is involved.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's opposition aspect between the 1st and the 7th puts suspicion on the partnership axis. The sign of the Moon changes whether the suspicion is tender or harsh.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 1st (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 7th Taurus; the suspicion is deep, and the debilitated Moon feels hurt.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) looks at the 1st Capricorn; clinging worry, but mild.

ambiguity: 'ये ना वी लोग' is garbled; read as 'these people are wary'.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon's 7th aspect links the 1st and 7th; the sex-life remark is his.

hindi: यहां तो है ही तो अच्छा बैठा है तो प्यार प्यार से शक करेंगे बुरा बैठा तो बेड पर जाते ही कुत्ते खानी शुरू लड़ाई शुरू मुंह बना हुआ है मार मूर के कूट काट के झगड़े से बाद में बेड पर अलग अलग होते हैं लोग
says: If the Moon is well placed, the suspicion is affectionate, born of love. If it is badly placed, a fight starts as soon as they go to bed, with sulking and quarrels, and they end up sleeping apart.
cells_derived_method: Well-placed or badly placed follows the Moon's sign grade above: good in Cancer, Taurus, Libra; bad in Aries, Scorpio.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) is well placed; the jealousy is playful and quickly makes up.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is badly placed; bedtime quarrels and cold silence.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो जहां चंद्रमा का दोष यहां आ जाए वैसे प्रैक्टिकली किसी भी ग्रह का आ जाए राहु के तो मंगल बुध अगर खराब है तो नेगेटिव लेकिन यह शक होते हैं
says: When the Moon's fault falls on the 7th, suspicion results. In practice any bad planet there, such as Rahu, Mars or Mercury, gives negative results, but the suspicion habit is the Moon's mark.
ambiguity: The Rahu-Mars-Mercury clause is run together and partly garbled.
classical_check: Agrees that malefics in the 7th trouble marriage; suspicion as the Moon's signature is his own.

hindi: यह शक कर कर के सारे टाइम वहम डालता है फोन पर क्या है तेरा पासवर्ड क्या किसको मैसेज कर रहा था अच्छा बड़ी स्माइल कर करके
says: The Moon's fault spreads delusion: constant suspicion about whereabouts, phone passwords and who is being messaged.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mock quarrel: where were you, in the bedroom, in the bathroom, did you jump out of the window.

hindi: यह जितनी बातें हैं यह सारी चंद्रमा के दोष के कारण है ऐसे में पति-पत्नी शक करते हैं एक दूसरे पर
says: All these suspicion habits come from a Moon fault. In such cases husband and wife doubt each other.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mentions a homeopathic medicine, Pulsatilla, that removes a suspicious nature and jokes about giving it to wives; no dose given. Health remark only.
Quip that giving someone a sword without saying how to swing it is dangerous; he avoids giving more.

hindi: इसके लिए सबसे बढ़िया उपाय यह है कि सूर्य अस्त होने के बाद ... चंद्रमा के लिए आपको यह करना है कि सूर्य अस्त होने के बाद जो चंद्रमा का टाइम है सूर्यास्त जब चंदा मामा का टाइम है चाहे अमावस है
says: The best remedy for the Moon fault works after sunset, because that is the Moon's time, even on a new-moon night when the Moon is not visible.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that the Moon rules the night is classical.

gist: Joke that the mother is the lion at home once father leaves, so the Sun's time and Moon's time differ.

hindi: सूर्यस्त के बाद आपको वाइट चीज का इंटेक नहीं करना वाइट इंटेक चावल दूध और पानी ये तीन चीज वाइट है
says: After sunset take no white food: rice, milk and water are the three white things to stop.
ambiguity: Water is listed as white although it is clear; he counts it as a Moon item.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; Moon-linked items (rice, milk, water) match the usual Moon significations, but the sunset ban is his own.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में एक और आठ नंबर का चंद्रमा कहीं भी बैठा है तो भी यह बंद कर दो क्योंकि वो कहीं ना कहीं तो खराब इफेक्ट दे ही रहा है
says: Even if the problem is not in marriage, anyone with the Moon in sign 1 or 8 anywhere should also stop these three items after sunset, since the Moon gives some bad effect somewhere.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए सनसेट के बाद पति पत्नी में यदि शक आ रहा है झगड़ा हो ही रहा है सूरज अस्त होने के बाद कुछ समय के लिए चावल दूध पानी सूर्यस्त के बाद बंद कर दो
says: If the couple has suspicion and quarrels, stop rice, milk and water after sunset for some time. It is a temporary course, not a lifelong rule.
ambiguity: 'कुछ समय' is not given as a number of days.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चावल कैसे लेने हैं अब आप चावल लिए उसमें पीली दाल डाल दी ना तासीर वाइट ही है आप देख के चलेंगे
says: If you must eat rice, change its nature: adding yellow dal alters its quality, so it no longer counts as white. The nature (taseer) is what matters.
ambiguity: The caption 'ना तासीर वाइट ही है' is unclear; it could be a question, 'is it still white in nature?'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप इस सबब गोल को ठंडे से लो गर्म से लो दूध से लो सबका अलग इफेक्ट है तासीर बदल गई इसीलिए आपके चावल जो हैं उसकी तासीर बदलनी है आपके वाइट
says: Taking the same item cold, hot or with milk gives a different effect, because its nature changes. So the rice's nature must be changed so that the white effect is gone.
ambiguity: 'सबब गोल' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; the taseer idea comes from Ayurvedic and folk food rules.

hindi: चावल है लेकिन नमक वाले हैं जीरे वाले हैं पुलाव वाले हैं फर्स्ट क्लास है तासीर बदल चुकी है आपके चावल के अंदर आपने हल्दी डाल दी
says: Rice cooked with salt, cumin, as pulao or with turmeric has already changed its nature, so it is no longer the 'white' item he has asked to stop after sunset.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Jokes that he knows only how to eat, not cook, and sits down to scrub utensils.
Skit where a wife hits the pan and says 'when did you ever wash it', turned into a poem and a self-praise gag.
Quip to the men: you should be proud, you have cooked rice; the sentence is cut off by the audience laughter.

hindi: यह वाइट चावल नहीं है बस उसके अंदर कुछ भी जीरा तड़का कुछ लगाया आप सूर्यस्त के बाद खा सकते हैं वाइट बंद कर दो
says: Rice with any tempering such as cumin is not white rice and can be eaten after sunset. Only plain white rice is to be stopped.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: रोज रात को सोते हुए आपके मन में चंदा मामा मुन्ना आ कर के कहेगा भाई शक है मुझे पुरानी यादें लेकर आ रहा हूं मैं
says: If the remedy is not followed, every night as you lie down the Moon in the mind (Munna) will bring doubt and old memories. The Moon's night time activates past hurts.
classical_check: Silent; the Moon as mind and memory is classical.

hindi: ओल्ड में मेरी आपकी सारा मेमोरी का देवता मुन्ना है शनि होता ही है और चंदा मामा की तरह चंचल है गोलगोल
says: The inner Munna is the deity of all your memory, tied to the old and the past (a Saturn flavour), and like the Moon it is restless and round, moving in circles.
ambiguity: 'शनि होता ही है' is garbled; Saturn's link with the old and the past is my reading.
classical_check: Moon is the classical memory karaka; Saturn linked with old age matches, but the pairing here is loose.

hindi: सूरज अस्त होने के बाद इतना वहम शक क्लेश देता है कि भैया हाय तौबा मच गई कुत्ते खानी मच जाएगी लाइफ में यानी लड़ना है सिर्फ बात करने के लिए भी भोंक
says: After sunset the afflicted Moon gives so much delusion, suspicion and strife that life becomes a constant fight, where even ordinary talk turns into barking at each other.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चावल बंद दूध बंद दूध मींस सारे मिल्क प्रोडक्ट सफेद बर्फी नहीं खानी
says: After sunset, rice and milk are stopped, and 'milk' means all milk products. White milk sweets like barfi are not to be eaten.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke asking someone to send the barfi to him and wondering where she will go then.

hindi: काजू की बर्फी खा रहे रात को उस पर उल्टा चांदी का वर्क है चंदा मामा और जोर से बिल्कुल नहीं सारी पहुंचाओ
says: Cashew barfi at night is even worse because it carries a silver foil, which strengthens the Moon's fault; not at all. This links silver to the afflicted Moon.
ambiguity: The last words ('send it all along') are a joke.
classical_check: Silent; silver as a Moon metal is classical.

hindi: उसके बाद आप सफेद को नारियल की बर्फी खा सकते हैं कलर चेंज हो गया सफेद रसगुल्ला बिल्कुल नहीं खाना
says: Coconut barfi is allowed because its colour has changed, but white rasgulla must not be eaten at all.
ambiguity: Coconut barfi is white in practice; his logic is that the changed form or colour counts.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मोहन भोग खाए रबड़ी रसमलाई भी सफेद होती है एक हाथ भिजवा दे तो अच्छा गुलाब जामुन खा सकते हैं
says: Mohan bhog is allowed, but rabri and rasmalai are white and so avoided. Gulab jamun, being brown, is fine after sunset.
ambiguity: The mohan bhog line is garbled and could mean either 'may eat' or 'not'. I read it as allowed because it is coloured.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He says he does not want the sweets anyway, plenty has come, what more to do.

hindi: आपने वाइट दूध की बनी कोई चीज सफेद नहीं लेनी सनसेट के बाद दूध पीना है ओके नो प्रॉब्लम चाय लो कॉफी लो
says: After sunset take no white item made of milk. If you must have milk, take it in a changed form such as tea or coffee.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके अंदर आपने हल्दी डाल लेनी है आप कोई एसेंस डालो दो बूंद रूह अफजा डाल दिया कुछ भी डाल दिया उसकी तासीर बदल गई है
says: Milk becomes acceptable if you add turmeric, some essence or two drops of Rooh Afza; anything that changes its colour or nature counts.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पानी का लफड़ा बहुत बड़ा है पानी की कसम मत खाना क्योंकि जटिल है आप कहीं बाहर हो नहीं हो पारा चेंज कैसे करेंगे तो आपने पानी सादा पी लेना है कभी-कभी के लिए कोई फर्क नहीं
says: Water is the hardest part, since you may be outside and cannot alter it. Then drink plain water; if it is only occasional, it makes no difference.
ambiguity: 'पारा चेंज' is garbled; read as 'how will you change it'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बहुत मेजर तौर पर आपने यही करना है घर में दो लीटर की बोतल रख लो अपने लिए उसमें एक तुलसी का पत्ता डाल दिया इतने पानी में एक तुलसी का पत्ता दो सौंफ के दाने आधी टुकड़ी लौंग काफी है
says: The main practice: keep a 2-litre bottle at home with one tulsi leaf, two fennel seeds and half a piece of clove. That much is enough to change the water's nature.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own household practice.

hindi: लेकिन सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम क्या है ये गर्मी करते हैं तो आपके बॉयल मूवमेंट यानी जीआईटी ट्रैक्ट के अंदर आपको हो सकता है लूज मोशन करा दे कुछ करे बॉडी सूट नहीं कर रही तो आप चेंज करते रहे
says: These herbs are heating and may upset the bowels or cause loose motions. If your body does not suit it, keep changing the recipe. This is a body-response caution, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लौंग का पानी लगातार पिए जा रहे हैं स्किन फटने लगेगी एलर्जी हो जाएगी कहीं अंगूठी पहनी उसके नीचे स्किन में आपके एलर्जी हो के लाली आ जाएगी क्योंकि मंगल होता है लौंग गर्मी कर देगा
says: Clove is a Mars item, and clove water taken continuously heats the body, giving skin cracking, allergy or redness under a ring. This is a body-heat warning attached to Mars, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; clove as a Mars-hot item is a folk and Ayurvedic idea.

hindi: इसीलिए पहले के समय में पीतल के लोटे कांसे के लोटे तांबे के लोटे में पानी दिया जाता था वो सादा ही पानी है उसकी तासीर बदल चुकी है
says: In the old days water was served in brass, bronze or copper pots; it is plain water but the metal has already changed its nature. So that water counts as treated.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; the metal-vessel practice is Ayurvedic custom.

hindi: तो सूर्यस्त के बाद आप उसको भी इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं है आपको खुद देखना आपके पेट को क्या सेंसिटिविटी दे रहा है
says: After sunset you may use such metal-vessel water too, but watch what your own stomach is sensitive to.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि चंद्रमा के पास केतु के साथ मिलकर सारी स्किन है सारा लिंफ है सारी एलर्जी की प्रॉब्लम चंदा मामा के दोष से होती है
says: The Moon together with Ketu governs the skin and lymph, and all allergy problems come from a Moon fault. This is a karaka claim about body areas, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Moon governs fluids and lymph classically; Ketu with skin allergies is a modern association.

gist: Advises getting a food allergy test done; a medical suggestion, not an astrological rule.

hindi: होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन सारी चंदा मामा के पास है अगर आपका चंद्रमा दूषित है तो होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन काम ही नहीं करेगी और चंद्रमा अच्छा है तो होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन रॉकेट की तरह काम करेगी
says: Homeopathy belongs to the Moon. With an afflicted Moon homeopathic medicine will not work at all, and with a good Moon it works like a rocket. This is a Moon karaka claim about response to medicine, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent; homeopathy is modern, and the Moon link is his own.

hindi: इसलिए चंदा मामा को नेगेटिविटी रोकने के लिए वहम है शक है टेंशन है मन में ये कचड़ी हुई है सारे टाइम चिंता स्ट्रेस तनाव परेशानी कैंसर तक चंद्रमा मंगल और शनि के साथ मिक्स हो करके देता है
says: A faulty Moon brings doubt, suspicion, tension, clutter in the mind, constant worry and stress. He says that mixed with Mars and Saturn it can reach the most serious illnesses. This is a health claim only; no diagnosis is taken from it.
ambiguity: The wording 'cancer' is a medical statement; flagged and not used as a rule.
classical_check: Moon-Mars-Saturn affliction is a classical combination for mind and body trouble, but classical texts do not name specific diseases this way.

hindi: इसकी करेक्शन के लिए आपको यह तीन चीजें छोड़ देनी है कम से कम उन दिनों के लिए जब क्लेश है
says: To correct this, give up the three white items (rice, milk, water) at least for the days when there is discord.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक्स्ट्रा बात बच्चे पेपरों के टाइम डर रहे हैं डर चंदा मामा के पास है भाई भीत है पेपर कैसे होगा उसकी यह तीन चीजें बंद कर दो सनस के बाद थोड़े दिनों के लिए
says: Extra point: children frightened at exam time are in the Moon's area, since fear belongs to the Moon. For that too, stop the three items after sunset for a few days.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके बाद ठीक लोग अक्सर करते क्या है चांदी के बर्तन में ही पानी पी रहे हैं भाई शुद्ध होएगा अरे तुम्हें नहीं चाहिए
says: Many people drink water only from silver vessels thinking it is purer. He tells them they do not need it, which he explains in the next line.
classical_check: Silent; silver as the Moon's metal is classical.

hindi: अगर आप चांदी के बर्तन में पानी पी रहे हैं और बहुत बढ़िया महसूस कर रहे ट मीस चंद्रमा इ ओके दोषी है तो बिल्कुल नहीं चेंज कर दो
says: If drinking from silver feels very good, it means the Moon is fine. If the Moon is faulty, do not use silver at all; change it.
ambiguity: The fragment 'ट मीस चंद्रमा इ ओके' is read as 'that means the Moon is OK'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राजा महाराजा वाली फीलिंग मत लो आप राजा महाराजा हो नहीं हो आप कंगाल एक चांदी का गिलास खरीद के उसमें पानी पी रहे हो नुकसान हो रहा है पहले देखो आप राजा हो कि नहीं हो तब लो
says: Do not take on a royal feeling. If you are not a king and you buy a silver glass, it causes you harm. First see whether you are royal in the chart before using silver.
ambiguity: 'Royal' is not defined; likely a strong Moon or good wealth yoga.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चांदी के ही दिए में चांदी की ही प्लेट में भगवान के मंदिर में आरती पूजा हो रही है बर्बाद हो जाएगी जिंदगी
says: Doing aarti and puja with a silver lamp and a silver plate in the home temple will ruin life, in his view, if the Moon is faulty.
ambiguity: The condition 'if the Moon is faulty' is carried over from the earlier lines; the sentence itself is absolute.
classical_check: Differs from tradition, where silver lamps and plates are considered auspicious.

hindi: जहां जिस घर में चांदी के दीपक जलाए जाते हैं वहां इतनी बहस होती इतनी बहस होती है
says: In a home where silver lamps are lit there is endless arguing. He ties silver lamps to household quarrels.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Repeats 'so much arguing' for effect and says nobody has ever come back to say this was wrong.

hindi: यह चीजें टोटली अवॉइड करनी सारा चंद्रमा का दोष चांदी पर लगता है आपको चांदी रखने के स्थान भी इसमें कई चीज
says: Avoid silver items totally; the whole Moon fault is placed on silver. Where silver is stored also matters in this.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says that is enough on this for today, leaves silver storage aside and will take the next page.

hindi: चांद आपकी मम्मी भी होती है चंद्रमा मम्मी है सूर्य पापा है
says: The Moon is the mother and the Sun is the father in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the mother karaka and Sun the father karaka.

hindi: यदि आपकी माता जी का देह अवसान हो चुका है मृत्यु प्राप्त हो चुकी है तो चंद्रमा की नीचता के दोष भी उड़ जाएंगे अगर उच्च का चंद्रमा है और बहुत बढ़िया राशि का है और मां नहीं रही तो अच्छे फल भी डाउन हो जाएंगे
says: If the person's mother has already passed away, the Moon's weakness faults also go away. But if the Moon is exalted in a very good sign and the mother is no more, the good results also come down. In both cases the Moon's results fade with the mother's absence.
ambiguity: Records a stated principle about the mother's death reducing Moon results; no death timing is taken from it.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not say this.

hindi: इसलिए माता को प्रेम स्वास्थ्य देना अगर दोष है तो अपनी मां से सुख नहीं मिलता झगड़ा बहस चलता रहता है क्लेश रहता है या मां चिंता में रहेगी
says: So give the mother love and care. If the Moon has a fault, you do not get happiness from your mother: quarrels and arguments continue, or the mother stays anxious.
classical_check: Agrees: a weak or afflicted Moon is read as strain with the mother.

gist: Says the Moon's seat matters and works in many ways, but today only marriage is being discussed.

hindi: अब इसके साथ हमारा अगला आता है मंगल देवता मंगल महाराज के बहुत सारे लफड़े हैं मंगल का सबसे सीरियस लोचा उल्फत है मंगलिक या मांगलिक
says: The next planet is Mars, who has many troubles; the most serious problem he brings in marriage is being Manglik (Mangalik).
ambiguity: 'उल्फत' is likely a garbled word; the meaning 'serious problem' is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees: manglik dosha is the best-known Mars marriage issue.

hindi: अब मंगल महाराज के साथ इतना झंझट क्यों है यह क्योंकि मंगल जो है यह ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस चेतना के तल के ऊपर इसकी यदि बात करें तो यह हनुमान जी के द्वारा हम इसको लेकर चलते हैं
says: Why is Mars so troublesome? At the level of human consciousness Mars is carried through Hanuman, who stands for it.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete and continues into the navel-centre idea.
classical_check: Hanuman is the popular Mars deity; the consciousness model is his own.

hindi: यह हमारा नाभी केंद्र है नाभी ऑफ बॉडी है ऊपर और नीचे बॉडी उसी हिसाब से चलती है
says: Mars corresponds to the body's navel centre; the body above and below runs according to it.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars is often tied to the navel or abdomen in body-part lists, though it also rules blood and muscle.

gist: Repeats 'this is our god Mars' twice while pointing at the board.

hindi: धरती के बिल्कुल साथ में मंगल नाभी ये डायफास्फेट इफेक्ट देता है हमने पहले यहां देखा हुआ है न और 12 होते हैं
says: Mars sits right beside the Earth and corresponds to the navel, which gives a diaphragm-like effect (a central dividing role in the body). He says this was shown earlier on the board with twelve parts.
ambiguity: 'डायफास्फेट' is garbled; 'diaphragm' is a guess. The '12' refers to an earlier board.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as navel centre is his own model.

hindi: यहां ये बृहस्पति की राशि है ये केतु की राशि है केतु क्या है बादल धुएं का बादल आप देख के चलेंगे
says: On the board he points to a sign of Jupiter and a sign of Ketu. Ketu is described as a cloud, a cloud of smoke.
ambiguity: Which signs he points to is not in the caption. In his scheme Pisces is the sign shared by Jupiter and Ketu, so Pisces is a guess.
classical_check: Ketu as smoke is a classical image (dhumra); Ketu as lord of Scorpio or Pisces is a later scheme.

hindi: मंगल के ठीक बाद सारे के सारे जो प्लेनेट है गैसियस प्लेनेट है बृहस्पति गैस का गोला है शनि गैस का गोला है बहुत गैस है मतलब तूफान चलते हैं
says: Every planet after Mars (Jupiter, Saturn and beyond) is a gas planet, a ball of gas where storms rage.
classical_check: Astronomically true for Jupiter and Saturn; classical Jyotish has no such categorisation.

hindi: यहां ये केतु महाराज के नीचे के दैत्य इसलिए माने जाते हैं कि दानव है खतरनाक है भैया ये कत्ल मचा देंगे
says: The beings under Ketu's gaseous domain are treated as demons (daitya, danava) because they are dangerous and cause havoc.
ambiguity: 'केतु महाराज के नीचे के' is unclear; could mean outer planets or the group of gas bodies.
classical_check: Silent; asura association is classical for Rahu, Ketu and Venus's teacher line, not for gas planets.

hindi: मंगल ठोस है धरती का कजन कहा जाता है इसका व्यास भी वैसा ही है धरती जितना लगभग लगभग समय भी ये धरती के साथ ही रहता है हर समय
says: Mars is solid and called Earth's cousin; he says its diameter is nearly the same as Earth's and its day length is close to ours, so it is always tied to the Earth.
classical_check: Differs from astronomy: Mars's diameter is about half of Earth's, though its day length is similar. The cousin idea is his own.

hindi: इसलिए मंगल ग्रह विवाह के लिए बहुत जोरदार है बहुत पावरफुल आपके जीवन के अंदर प्रजनन कौन देगा
says: For this reason Mars is very strong and powerful for marriage. He sets up a question of who in life gives procreation, which the next line answers.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars strongly affects marriage via manglik dosha.

hindi: बृहस्पति आपको साथी कौन देगा शुक्र
says: Jupiter gives procreation (children) and Venus gives the life partner.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the child karaka and Venus the spouse karaka.

hindi: बृहस्पति पति स्वरूप हो गया मंगल पत्नी स्वरूप हो गया पति और पत्नी को बीच में मिलाने के लिए कौन आएंगे हनुमान जी
says: In his model Jupiter stands for the husband and Mars for the wife. Hanuman, who is Mars, is the one who comes in between to unite husband and wife.
ambiguity: Mars is called wife-form and also the connector (Hanuman); the two roles are not reconciled.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars is the husband karaka for a woman and the Jupiter husband karaka is for women, not a general husband stand-in.

hindi: पति और पत्नी को मिलाने के लिए बीच में आएंगे कौन हनुमान हनुमान की कृपा लेने के पश्चात में ही पति और पत्नी साथ आ सकते हैं
says: Husband and wife can come together only after taking Hanuman's grace, so a Mars remedy is the gateway to union.
classical_check: Hanuman worship for Mars and marriage is a common popular remedy; not a classical text rule.

hindi: अगर हनुमान की कृपा नहीं हो गई तो यह पति पत्नी को राम और सीता की तरह वनवास में डाल देते हैं
says: Without Hanuman's grace, Mars puts the couple into exile like Ram and Sita, meaning long separation and hardship.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी आपका मल बना नाभि के ठीक नीचे शक्ति बनी नाभि के ठीक नीचे भोजन खाया आपने नाभि के ठीक ऊपर नाभि है भाड़ में जाए
says: Waste and energy are produced just below the navel, and food enters just above it. The navel is therefore the central joint of the body, which is why Mars sits there.
ambiguity: The last words are a throwaway.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हनुमान कौन है ब्रह्मचारी आपका एक बहुत पावरफुल जोड़ है यहां पर सुषुम्ना नाड़ी एक्टिवेट होती है इदा नाड़ी और पिंगला नाड़ी
says: Hanuman is a celibate. The navel is a very powerful junction where the sushumna channel is activated, between the ida and pingala channels.
classical_check: Silent; the nadi names are yogic, not from Jyotish texts.

hindi: इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रोटॉन बीच में न्यूट्रॉन न्यूट्रॉन पहले इलेक्ट्रॉन पैदा करता है फिर उसके पश्चात प्रोटॉन इलेक्ट्रॉन पॉजिटन बन जाता है नेगेटिव इफेक्ट पॉजिटिव करने लगता है
says: By analogy: ida and pingala are electron and proton with a neutron in the middle. The neutron first makes an electron, then a proton, and an electron turns into a positron, so a negative effect starts acting as a positive one.
ambiguity: A loose physics analogy; the particle details are not accurate.
classical_check: Silent; not a Jyotish idea.

hindi: मुन्ना कहता है तेरा एक्सीडेंट कराऊंगा जिस इंसान ने चेतना के तल पर जाकर यह मेनिफेस्ट करना सीख लिया कि हां एक्सीडेंट तो होगा गाड़ी में होगा
says: The inner mind says an accident is coming. A person who learns at the consciousness level to manifest 'yes, the accident will happen to the car' can steer where the damage goes.
ambiguity: The accident is said to be 'written at 12', which could mean the 12th house or the 12 o'clock board position; not resolved.
classical_check: Silent; this is a manifestation idea, not a Jyotish technique.

hindi: लिखा तो 12 पर होगा तो मर्सडीज दिलाता है मुन्ना उसे पहले पॉजिटन बन के फिर मर्सडीज ठुकवा देता है उसका दरवाजा ठुक जाता है उसका बाजू बच जाता है
says: If the accident is written to happen, the inner mind first gets the person a Mercedes and then has it dented; the car door is hit and the arm is saved. The harm moves onto an object.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is unclear (12th house or board position).
classical_check: Silent; the substitution idea resembles the symbolic-payment idea from the Vishnu vivah remedy, but is not classical.

hindi: हेड ऑन कोलिजन होती है उसका सिर बच जाता है बैक पर चोट लगती है पीठ बच जाती है इस प्रकार से इफेक्ट्स आते हैं
says: Likewise, in a head-on collision the head is saved, and if the back is hit the spine is saved; the damage lands on the lesser part. This is how effects get diverted.
ambiguity: This is a claim about outcomes after manifestation practice and not a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो मंगल महाराज को खुश करना बहुत जरूरी है नहीं तो पति पत्नी के बीच ब्रह्मचर्य स्थापित कर देता है
says: It is necessary to please Mars; otherwise he establishes celibacy between husband and wife, a lack of physical relation.
classical_check: Mars is the planet of passion; an afflicted Mars is classically linked to marital discord, not specifically celibacy.

gist: Image of Hanuman sitting at the door, Sita waiting and Ram unable to enter the room.
Sindoor legend: Hanuman asks Sita why she wears red on her forehead, she says it is for Ram, and he smears his whole body with sindoor.

hindi: तो लाल रंग का ही मंगल ग्रह मंगल को लाल ग्रह कहा जाता है इसलिए मंगल को अग्नि भी माना जाता है
says: Mars is the red planet and so is considered fire as well.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is red and a fire planet.

hindi: और मंगल ही सूर्य का सेनापति है सूर्यकांत चंद्रकांता बुद्धि का यह जो फैमिली हमने बनाई थी इसमें मंगल जो वो सेनापति है पुत्र है
says: Mars is the Sun's commander. In the planet family he built earlier (Sun, Moon, Mercury as intellect), Mars is the commander and the son.
ambiguity: 'सूर्यकांत चंद्रकांता' is a joke on a TV serial title; the family structure is from an earlier lecture.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the army commander (senapati) in the classical planetary cabinet.

hindi: जब बेटा बीच में है पुत्र बीच में है तो माता-पिता साथ में दोस्त की तरह रहते हैं तो मंगल क्या करता है दोस्ती कराता है
says: When the son is in the middle, the parents live together like friends. So Mars, the son, creates friendship between husband and wife.
classical_check: Silent; family-model reasoning is his own.

hindi: मंगल छोटा बच्चा माना जाता है जिसका वीर्य नहीं बना 8 साल 10 साल के छोटे बालक को मंगल माना जाता है
says: Mars is taken as the small boy, 8 to 10 years old, whose semen has not formed, a pre-pubertal child.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is a young, kumara-aged planet in classical lists (the Moon is infant, Mars is youth).

hindi: जैसे लड़की कंजक होती है जो रजस्वला नहीं हुई देवी मानी जाती है पूजी जाती है उसके पैर छुए जाते हैं उसको माता के नौ दिनों में पूजा जाता है ऐसे एक लड़के को भी दिया जाता है
says: Just as a pre-pubertal girl (kanjak) is worshipped as the goddess during the nine days of Navratri, one boy is also included in the feast.
classical_check: Kanjak puja is a real custom; the inclusion of a boy (the langur or batuk) is common practice.

hindi: यह मंगल के लिए देते हैं ये प्रथा इस प्रकार की है कि लड़कियों को तो दिया ही दिया पूरी आलू छोले इत्यादि खीर एक लड़का उसको दिया जाता है वो मंगल होता है यानी मंगल की प्रसन्नता जरूरी है
says: The boy in the kanjak feast, served puri, potato, chickpeas and kheer, is there for Mars. So the custom shows that Mars's pleasure is necessary.
classical_check: Silent; the Mars link to the boy is his reading of the custom.

hindi: ये नाभी है सांस लिया नाभी से लिया खाना खाए फिर बोले मजा आ गया हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस पूर्ण रूप से सेट
says: The navel is where breath is taken and food is received; when you eat and say 'what joy', your Hanuman consciousness is fully set. Contentment of the navel is the sign of Mars being in order.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो यह हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस क्या करती है यही है जिसका केतु नीचे गैसियस प्लेनेट बना रहा पूछ तो हनुमान की पूछ ही आग लगाए रखती है
says: Hanuman consciousness is the Mars centre whose lower end, Ketu, is the gaseous tail; and Hanuman's tail keeps the fire burning.
ambiguity: 'पूछ' is read as 'tail' (puchh); the Ketu-tail mapping is inferred and the caption is broken.
classical_check: Ketu is called the tail or headless body in classical lore; the Hanuman-tail pairing is his own.

hindi: यानी यह मंगल अगर आपने सेट नहीं किया मंगलिक नॉन मंगलिक का विवाह कर दिया तो आपके तोते उड़ जाएंगे
says: If Mars is not set right and a manglik is married to a non-manglik, you will be shocked: it ends badly.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical matching rule that manglik should marry manglik, or the dosha should be cancelled.

hindi: मंगलिक दोष पति पत्नी में है तो शादी के चाहे 20 साल बाद तलाक कराएगा या सेपरेट कराएगा या अलग कराएगा या कहीं और अफेयर कराएगा वो कराएगा ही चाहे कुछ भी कर दो
says: If the manglik fault is in a spouse, even 20 years after the wedding it will cause divorce, separation or an affair elsewhere, whatever you do. This is his absolute claim and cannot be taken as measured.
cells_derived_method: Which houses the fault arises from is given in the later lines. The sign of Mars changes the strength: Mars in its own or exalted sign is the strong and self-contained case, in Cancer debilitated it is the harsh case.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) is the strongest marital trouble under his logic.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) is strong; a domestic firestorm, but a capable Mars.

ambiguity: The houses for this sentence are inferred from the next row; here he speaks in general.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which list cancellation rules; he says the dosha always fires.

hindi: मान लो कोई ऐसा सुनकर कहे कि नहीं हमारे बीच तो ऐसा नहीं है तो उनका फिजिकल लाइफ खराब कर देगा किसी भी हालत में करना तो इसने है
says: If someone hears this and says it is not like that between them, Mars will still spoil their physical life; he must do something to the couple.
ambiguity: The tail 'जाएगा तो है ही नहीं' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर कोई और विरला केस आ गया ऐसा नहीं है तो मंगल डिस्प्लेस है मंगल है ही नहीं अपने उन स्थानों में जहां से मंगलिक दोष बनाता है वो कुंडली में दिख रहा है घूमा हुआ है
says: In the rare case where none of this happens, Mars is displaced: it appears in the chart in a dosha house but is not truly there, because it has moved from those places. So the fault does not apply.
cells_derived_method: A Mars near the end of a house may count in the next house in a bhava-based view. Mars at the very end of the 12th shifts into the 1st, and at the end of the 3rd into the 4th, so the dosha picture can change either way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars at the end of Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) could count in the 4th in a bhava view, a dosha house, so a non-dosha chart can turn into a dosha one.
Derived: Mars at the end of Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo) could count in the 5th in a bhava view, removing the dosha.

ambiguity: 'घूमा हुआ' is read as moved by bhava division; he does not name the method.
classical_check: Agrees that bhava-chalit placement is checked before declaring dosha.

hindi: यह बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है ज्योतिषी झूठे हो सकते हैं ज्योतिष झूठा नहीं है किसी हालत में
says: This is very complicated: astrologers may be wrong or false, but astrology itself is not false under any circumstances.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह मंगल की करेक्शन तब तक संभव नहीं जब तलक आप अपने मंगलिक दोष को समझेंगे नहीं मंगलिक दोष की कहानी क्या आती है
says: Mars cannot be corrected until you understand your own manglik fault; he moves on to explain how manglik dosha arises.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Names the houses on the board: first, fourth, seventh, tenth, and six and eight, before giving the manglik placements.

hindi: अब मंगल महाराज मंगल यहां होता है यहां होता है यहां और यहां मंगल अगर मंगल की यहां पर बैठे हुए प्लेसमेंट है एक चार सात 8 12 तो वह व्यक्ति मंगलिक है
says: Mars placed in the 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house makes the person manglik. This is his definition of the manglik fault.
cells_derived_method: The house list is the same for every lagna, but Mars's sign in that house changes the force. Own or exalted signs make a strong Mars, a debilitated sign a harsh one, and the sign also tells which lagna it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) is in its own sign in the ascendant, manglik with a bold and aggressive nature.
Derived: Mars in its own Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) is manglik but strongly placed, and gives a hidden, intense bond.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) is manglik, at home in the loss house, with bed-pleasure and expense issues.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) is manglik with the sign of the Moon, the worst for spouse harmony.

ambiguity: The list in the caption is 'एक च सा 8 12', read as 1, 4, 7, 8, 12. The 2nd house is not stated.
classical_check: Differs slightly: the classical list is 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12; he leaves out the 2nd.

hindi: इसके दोष के रहते उसको पति या पत्नी ऐसा ही चाहिए
says: With this fault present, such a person needs a spouse of the same kind, that is, another manglik.
ambiguity: 'ऐसा ही' is not spelled out; read as another manglik.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule of matching manglik with manglik.

gist: Old belief: if the boy is manglik the girl would die or fall ill at delivery; in-laws did not care; he calls these old stories.
Condemns the old ill-treatment of women, including sati and burning of ill brides, as great cruelty.

hindi: अब वह कहानी के अंतर्गत अगर लड़की मंगलिक है तो उसकी शादी नहीं हो रही क्योंकि मंगलिक लड़का ढूंढने के लिए मर रहे हैं उससे कोई करता ही नहीं कहता ना मंगली है मार देगी
says: Because of that old belief, a manglik girl finds it hard to get married: families struggle to find a manglik boy, and others refuse her, saying she is manglik and will kill the husband.
ambiguity: This describes social practice and fear; he gives it as the reason for difficulty, not as a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह सत्य घटना है लड़की मंगली के है दोष है और पति सादा ले लिया वो बीमार रहेगा आजकल तो डॉक्टर मरने नहीं देते कायदे से वो मार देती है
says: He says a true incident supports it: with a manglik girl and an ordinary husband, the husband would be ill. Nowadays doctors do not let him die, but by the rule she would kill him. This records his claim only; it gives no timing.
ambiguity: The 'true incident' is not detailed. The line is a claim about spouse health and death risk; it is not a death date.
classical_check: Differs from careful classical reading; the texts speak of 'widowhood' risk, but not with this certainty.

hindi: वह तो सेवा कर रही है उसके ग्रह मार देते हैं क्योंकि लड़के का ग्रह भी लड़की को जान से मार रहा है ऐसा नहीं है कि नहीं मार रहा है
says: The wife is not the killer; she is serving him. It is her planets that do the harm, and the boy's own planets are also hurting the girl. So the fault acts on both sides, he says.
ambiguity: The last clause is double-negated and the caption is rough.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन मंगलिक दोष तब तक इग्नाइट नहीं होगा जब तक आप अग्नि के फेरे नहीं करते आप मंगली है नॉन मंगली है अग्नि के फेरे मत करो
says: The manglik fault stays dormant until the marriage rounds around the sacred fire are taken. A manglik and non-manglik couple should not take the fire rounds.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical rule, and unusual because it implies a non-Hindu or fire-less union avoids the fault.

gist: Imagined family dialogue: the children will not listen and insist on this marriage, so go and do what you like.

hindi: अग्नि के फेरे मत कराओ आप उन बच्चों को पार्टी मत दो दहेज मत दो आशीर्वाद दे दो भाई अग्नि के फेरे मत करो अग्नि इग्नाइट मत करो
says: If they insist, do not arrange the fire rounds, do not give them a party or dowry, only give blessings. The point is not to ignite the fire.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own advice.

hindi: अग्नि के फेरे होते ही मंगल बटन ऑन होएगा दोनों में से एक मंगली नहीं है एक है मौत पक्की है रिश्ते की मौत
says: The moment the fire rounds are done, the Mars switch turns on. If only one of the two is manglik, the death of the relationship is certain.
ambiguity: 'मौत' is read as the end of the marriage, not a person's death.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which give cancellation conditions.

hindi: पक्की है प्यार की मौत पक्की है या जिंदगी की मौत नहीं तो परमानेंट बीमार रहो इसलिए अग्नि के फेरे नहीं करने
says: For a Mars-afflicted (manglik) person he warns that a marriage done with the fire pheras ends in the death of love, or the death of life, or permanent sickness, and therefore says the fire pheras should not be done. This is a fear-based tradition claim about death and illness, recorded only as what he said.
cells_derived_method: Mars dosha is judged from houses 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 (some add 2). The marriage damage is strongest when Mars sits in 7th (partner) or 8th (longevity/continuity); sign changes severity: Mars in own/exalted sign is softer, in Cancer (debilitated) or in Mercury signs it is harsher in effect on speech and temper.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) is a manglik placement but with dignity, so the 'fire' is strong and disciplined; partner is forceful and driven.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 8th (lagna Virgo) puts the fire on joint life, in-laws and sudden events; the dosha is about continuity of the bond.
Derived: Mars in the 12th (lagna Capricorn) in a friendly sign points at bed-pleasure and expense strain in marriage rather than outright break.

ambiguity: Whether 'death' is literal or symbolic is not clear; he later uses the same framing for a husband-death remedy.
classical_check: Classical texts name Kuja dosha for houses 1,4,7,8,12 and prescribe matching or remedies, not skipping the pheras; skipping fire is his own extension.

hindi: मंगल से ही महूरत है भाई कोई मंगल कार्य करने जा रहे हैं तो भाई पंडित जी से पूछा यानी अग्नि स्थापना गणपति पूजन होगा क्या अग्नि स्थापना कर रहे हैं
says: He ties muhurat (auspicious timing) itself to Mars: before any auspicious function the pandit asks whether Ganapati puja and agni sthapana (establishing a fire) will be done, because the muhurat question exists for the fire element that Mars rules.
ambiguity: The wording 'muhurat is from Mars' is loose; it may mean muhurat matters mainly when fire is involved.
classical_check: Classical muhurta does not make Mars the owner of muhurat; it treats Mars as a fire/tithi-nakshatra-day factor. This is his framing.

hindi: अग्नि स्थापना क्या है दिया जलाया अग्नि स्थापना हो गई हवन किया वोह तो बहुत बड़ी अग्नि स्थापना हो गई फेरे कर रहे हैं वह सबसे बड़ी अग्नि स्थापना
says: He defines agni sthapana on a scale: lighting even a lamp counts as establishing fire, a havan is a much bigger establishment, and taking the pheras around the fire is the biggest of all.
classical_check: Silent in classical astrology; this is a ritual definition he uses to size the Mars trigger.

hindi: दिया भी नहीं जलाना धुआ बत्ती भी नहीं करनी
says: For the manglik person in a marriage ceremony he says do not even light a lamp or incense stick; any flame or smoke is treated as turning on the Mars trigger.
ambiguity: Unclear whether this is meant only for the wedding or in the couple's home life afterwards.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: सिख धर्म के अंदर संडे को शादी होती है हां उनके तो महूरत कोई देखता नहीं तो भाई वो आग लगाते ही नहीं अग्नि के फेरे है ही नहीं
says: He points out that Sikh weddings are held on Sundays, nobody checks muhurat, and there is no fire at all in their marriage rounds, offering this as evidence that the Mars-fire trigger is absent when no fire is used.
ambiguity: He does not say whether Sikh couples with manglik charts really fare better; it is an argument from custom, not data.
classical_check: Silent; the Sikh practice of rounds around the scripture instead of a fire is factual, the astrological inference is his own.

hindi: अच्छा चर्च में जाकर करी शादी इन्होंने तो बहुत सुखी है तो भाई अग्नि न ही नहीं करी उन्होने मंगल का दोष का मुद्दा ही नहीं है वो बटन ही ऑन नहीं किया
says: Couples who married in a church, with no fire, are described as very happy, and he concludes that the Mars dosha is not an issue for them because the 'button' of the planet was never switched on by a fire ritual.
ambiguity: Anecdotal; no count of couples is given.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; his own trigger theory (dosha activates only when fire is involved).

hindi: ऐसे ग्रह जो कहते हैं लिविन में रहो शादी मत करना
says: He says that charts with this kind of Mars affliction effectively 'tell' the native to stay in a live-in relationship and not formally marry. This is relationship advice from his theory and is not a validated prediction.
ambiguity: Which exact placements he means by 'such planets' is not stated; presumably manglik placements.
classical_check: No classical support; classical remedy is matching or ritual propitiation.

hindi: सुखी 15 साल लिविन में रहने के बाद जब शादी करी तलाक आपने ग्रह को बटन को ऑन कर दिया है
says: Anecdote offered as proof: a couple was happy for 15 years living together, but when they formally married with the rites they ended in divorce, because the ritual switched the planet's button on.
ambiguity: Single example, no chart given.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; one anecdote is not evidence.

hindi: तो मंगल दोष यदि है अग्नि के फेरे मत करो
says: Plain rule restated: if Mars dosha is present in the chart, do not take the pheras around the fire.
cells_derived_method: Applies to the classical manglik houses; severity differs with Mars's sign dignity (exalted/own softer, debilitated in Cancer harsher) and the partner's chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 4th (lagna Leo) is manglik by house but dignified, so by his theory the fire trigger is milder than for Mars in Cancer.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) is the hardest case; partner's temper and mismatch are expected to be sharp.

ambiguity: He does not list the houses here; the house set is the classical manglik set, added by me as the usual reading, not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical advice is Kuja-dosha matching and cancellations; avoiding fire pheras is not classical.

gist: Mimics a family saying 'my uncle will not agree, we are traditional, we will do the fire pheras anyway'.
Political analogy: families that always voted for one party and will keep doing so by habit.
Continues the voting analogy with a named politician losing, yet loyalists still say they will vote for him; asks people to understand why they act.
Says rivals call such loyalists blind followers of another leader, and asks why anyone votes the way they do.
Sums up that rigid traditionalists will insist 'it was never done differently in our village' and fear the gods will be angry.

hindi: तो उसके लिए क्या करें भाई लड़की के लिए कुंभ विवाह कराओ
says: If the family insists on the fire pheras, the remedy he gives for a manglik girl is to first perform a Kumbh Vivah, a symbolic marriage to a pot, before her real marriage.
ambiguity: He specifies the remedy for the girl; boys are dealt with separately later.
classical_check: Kumbh Vivah is a classical-tradition remedy for Kuja or Vishakanya-type doshas in women, so he agrees with tradition here.

hindi: यह क्या है यह मंगल है घड़ा है या पेट है इसमें घड़े में डालते रहो खाना खाते रहो सेट करो तो यह एक कुंभ है
says: He explains the symbolism: the pot stands for Mars, in the sense of the belly or a vessel into which you keep putting food, so Mars is shown as a kumbh (pot). Caption is partly garbled.
ambiguity: The caption is noisy ('या पेट है इसमें घड़े में डालते रहो'); the pot = Mars = belly link is my best reading.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts on pot=Mars; Mars rules the navel/abdominal fire in the kalapurusha body map, so belly is plausible.

hindi: यही इसी कुंभ को हम बृहस्पति से जोड़ के चल सकते हैं जो हमारा आजकल 12 वर्ष का महाकुंभ इत्यादि इत्यादि चल रहा है बहुत बड़ा सम्मेलन और संयोग चल रहा है बहुत सुंदर
says: He says this same Kumbh (pot) can also be linked with Jupiter, whose roughly 12-year cycle is behind the Maha Kumbh gathering that is currently going on, calling it a great assembly and coincidence.
ambiguity: Which Kumbh he means and which year is not stated.
classical_check: Kumbh Mela timing is indeed tied to Jupiter's roughly 12-year cycle through the zodiac, so this agrees with tradition.

hindi: कुंभ विवाह घड़े से शादी कर दी जाती है तो घड़े से विवाह करके क्या होता है लड़की सा घड़े घड़े को पति बनाते हैं मंगल के रूप में उसको मंत्र जाप के द्वारा
says: He defines Kumbh Vivah: the girl is married to a pot, the pot is treated as her husband in the form of Mars, and this is done with mantra chanting.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual description (pot or banana tree or Vishnu image as first husband).

hindi: फिर अग्नि के फेरे किए जाते हैं उसके साथ सूचक फेरे होते हैं मौली इत्यादि से कर दिए जाते हैं पंडित जी करेंगे आपको कोई लिन नहीं
says: In the ritual the fire pheras are then done with the pot, but only as symbolic rounds, using sacred thread, and the pandit will perform them so the family need not worry. Last words are garbled.
ambiguity: 'आपको कोई लिन नहीं' is likely 'no tension/no problem for you'; caption is garbled.
classical_check: Standard Kumbh Vivah has a full marriage rite; his 'symbolic' version is a simplification.

hindi: लड़की की शादी करा दी घड़े से शादी करा करू करके उस घड़े को फोड़ दिया कि ये पति मर ग गया तो उस लड़की के जीवन का सपना भी पूरा हो जाएगा
says: After the pot marriage the pot is smashed to represent that this first husband has died, so the Mars-demanded death of a husband is considered discharged in a symbolic way. He jokes it fulfils a girl's dream of ending the husband.
ambiguity: Mixes serious ritual meaning with a joke.
classical_check: Classical Kumbh Vivah also involves symbolic widowhood of the first husband; matches.

gist: Joke that after marriage the girl had wanted to smash her husband's head and has now 'done it' on day one, and so will be happy.
Joke that whenever she sees her husband's head later she can think of the broken pot.

hindi: तो आपके दूसरी शादी होगी जब होगी अगली बार तो प्रथम विवाह में ग्रह बलि ले चुका है बलि लेने के पश्चात वो क्रिया समाप्त हो गई है तो अब आपके पति की मृत्यु नहीं होगी गारंटी
says: He guarantees that at the next, real marriage the husband will not die, since the planet already took its offering in the first (pot) marriage and that action is finished. This is a death-related guarantee from tradition and must not be treated as a prediction.
ambiguity: 'Guarantee' is his word; no data is offered.
classical_check: Tradition holds the same idea (first symbolic marriage absorbs the dosha) but no classical text guarantees outcomes.

hindi: अब लड़का यदि ऐसा है तो उसके लिए ऐसा कोई घड़ा फोड़ने का मुद्दा ही नहीं है क्योंकि घड़ा तो उसी के पास है फूटना तो उसने है
says: For a manglik boy no pot-breaking remedy is needed, because the 'pot' is with him already and he is the one who would be broken; the wording is jokey and the exact meaning is unclear. Takeaway: the Kumbh Vivah is a remedy for girls, not boys.
ambiguity: Garbled and joking; the line 'the pot is with him, he is to break' is not clearly interpretable.
classical_check: Classical texts do have male remedies (e.g. Vishnu or peepal marriage for men), so 'no remedy for boys' differs.

hindi: लड़की को क्या करेंगे तो लड़की मंगली की ही ढूंढे
says: Matching rule: a manglik girl should look for a manglik partner only, so that both carry the same Mars fire.
cells_derived_method: Match is by manglik houses in both charts; strength comparison by sign dignity of each Mars would refine the match.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: girl with Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Libra) matched with a boy with Mars in the 1st or 8th is a typical 'manglik with manglik' match in his scheme.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) is a mild manglik; matching against a strong-Mars partner is easier than against a non-manglik.

ambiguity: The caption splits the sentence over two time stamps; the houses are classical, not stated here.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Kuja dosha cancellation by mutual manglik.

hindi: शादी हो और ग्रह क्रूर ना हो तो लड़ाई होती रहेगी
says: If the manglik girl is married to a partner who does not have a similarly cruel (fiery) planet, fights will keep going on in the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Mismatch effect depends on which house holds the unmatched Mars: 7th shows open quarrel with spouse, 4th shows household peace, 8th in-law and shared-resource conflict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Taurus) against a calm partner chart means constant heated argument.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 4th (lagna Libra) with a non-manglik spouse leans to domestic friction and a dominating style at home.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह क्रूर ना हो' could mean the partner has no malefic at all or no Mars specifically.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea that an unmatched Kuja brings discord.

hindi: मंगल का वह हाल है कि मंगल शनि को भी नहीं छोड़ता शनि भी जब उसके शनि के घर जाता है मंगल अग्नि तो शनि भी आसन छोड़ के कहता है प्रभु आप मेरे यहां बैठे हैं सबसे ऊंचा आसन ले
says: Mars is so strong that it does not spare even Saturn: when Mars goes into Saturn's house, Saturn himself vacates the seat and tells Mars to take the highest seat, meaning Mars dominates in a Saturn sign.
cells_derived_method: Mars in a Saturn sign takes charge; in Capricorn it is exalted and fully strong, in Aquarius it is merely friendly-neutral, so the 'takes the seat' effect is clearer in Capricorn. House changes the area: 10th gives career dominance, 4th home heat, 8th hidden pressure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives commanding career, authority and drive.
Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio) puts fire into home and mother's matters, but not in an exalted way.
Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 8th (lagna Cancer) is hidden, intense, abrupt events and research-type drive.

ambiguity: 'घर' means sign (Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's signs); I assume he means both.
classical_check: Classically only Capricorn is exalted for Mars; Aquarius is neutral, so 'highest seat' fits Capricorn only.

hindi: मंगल 10 नंबर 10 नंबर की जर्सी सबसे पॉपुलर सारे खिलाड़ी
says: He links Mars to the number 10: the 10th sign, Capricorn, is where Mars is exalted, just like the number 10 jersey is the most popular among players. So Mars's best seat is the 10th place.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn (sign 10) is exalted; the house changes where the strength shows: in the 10th it is career peak, in the 1st it is a very strong personality, in the 7th it is a forceful partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) gives a bold, athletic and decisive native.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) gives a strong-willed partner and business partnerships with drive.

ambiguity: Number 10 is the sign number here (Capricorn), not a house number; the football jersey is only an analogy.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, the 10th sign.

hindi: मंगल शनि के घर गया अग्नि पेट्रोल के पास गई पेट्रोल हाहाकार करता है कहता है बचाओ नाश कर दूंगा
says: Metaphor: Mars (fire) going into Saturn's house is fire going near petrol, so petrol (Saturn's sign and matters) cries out for help and Mars can destroy it; explosive, destructive potential.
cells_derived_method: Effect is explosive where Saturn's area is delicate: in houses ruled by Saturn matters (6th, 8th, 12th) the fire burns servants, accidents or expenses; in 1st/10th it burns through obstacles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 6th (lagna Virgo) is a fighter against enemies and debts, but with flare-ups at work.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) burns expense and foreign matters with intensity, explosive but controlled.

ambiguity: It is a vivid analogy; does not say if it is harmful to the native or to the Saturn matters.
classical_check: Mars-Saturn mutual relation is neutral in BPHS; the 'petrol and fire' picture is his own.

hindi: हनुमान जी रावण की अहंकार को नष्ट करने वाले ब्रह्मचारी मंगल आपको दूर दृष्टि देने वाला मंगल ज्ञानी हनुमान
says: He identifies Hanuman with Mars: destroyer of Ravana's ego, celibate (brahmachari), giver of far vision and wisdom. So Mars is the planet of courage, discipline and foresight, not only anger.
classical_check: Hanuman is a Mars deity in popular tradition; classical karakas of Mars are courage, brothers, land and fire. 'Far vision' and 'brahmachari' are his additions.

hindi: मंगल नाभी भाड़ में जाए
says: He places Mars at the navel (the manipura region of the body); the words 'bhaad mein jaaye' are a filler phrase, not meaning.
ambiguity: The 'let it go to hell' phrase is slang filler; the intended meaning is 'Mars is at the navel'.
classical_check: Kalapurusha body map gives Mars the abdomen/navel fire region, so it agrees broadly.

hindi: इसके नीचे के चक्र पर स्वाधिष्ठान छेन रहता है क्रोध क्लेश और उसके ठीक नीचे रहता है मुन्ना भय का देवता
says: Just below the navel centre sits the swadhisthana chakra, home of anger and conflict, and right below that sits the seat of fear (probably muladhara), all in the Mars zone of the body. Caption has a garbled word.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is garbled; likely 'muladhara'. 'स्वाधिष्ठान छेन' is also noisy.
classical_check: Chakra attribution is yogic, not in BPHS; he is blending yoga and jyotish.

hindi: आगे काम क्रोध लोभ मोह अहंकार ईर्षा
says: He lists the vices that lie further along this region: lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego and envy; read together with the previous lines, these are the Mars-chakra afflictions.
ambiguity: Unclear whether all six are assigned to Mars or just listed as the general set of vices.
classical_check: The six vices (shadripu) are a general Indian list, not specific to Mars in classical astrology.

hindi: मंगल की कृपा से ही आपका पितर भी सेट हो होते हैं कहते नाना पितर याद आ गए
says: By Mars's grace alone do your ancestors (pitars) get settled, he says, recalling the maternal grandfather and ancestors as he speaks. So appeasing the ancestral line goes through Mars.
ambiguity: 'सेट' is his slang for 'settled/in order'.
classical_check: Not classical; ancestors are normally tied to Sun, 9th house and Rahu. The Mars link is his.

hindi: राम को किसने बचाया मृत्यु से मृत्यु है ना प्लूटो जान से मार दिया
says: Asking who saved Rama from death, he states that death is Pluto: Pluto is the planet of death in his 12-planet scheme.
ambiguity: The end of the sentence is a story fragment.
classical_check: Pluto is outside the classical nine grahas; Yama/Pluto as death is his scheme.

gist: Mentions that Meghnad bound Rama in the serpent noose and says such stories are symbolic and beautiful.

hindi: कि राम मृत्यु शैया प है आपकी नाभी है ना सांस चल रही है राम की यानी एक शरीर के अंदर जीवित सांस चल रही है स्वयं काम कर रहा है
says: With Rama lying on the deathbed as a symbol, he says your navel is where the breath keeps running: a living breath goes on inside the body by itself, and that is the Mars (Hanuman) seat of life force.
ambiguity: Story and symbolism are mixed; the claim is that navel breath equals Mars life force.
classical_check: Not in classical texts.

hindi: वह ब्रेथ जो जन्म के समय थी और मृत्यु तक चलेगी यह सांस ना भी क्या हनुमान जी स्थापित है हां स्थापित है आपकी सांस चल रही है
says: The breath that began at birth and runs until death is where Hanuman (Mars) is established, so your ongoing breathing is itself the sign of Mars installed in you.
classical_check: Silent in classical astrology.

hindi: संजीवनी कौन लेकर आए वह भी राम लक्ष्मण के लिए हनुमान लेकर आए तो हनुमान ही
says: Who brought the Sanjeevani herb for Rama and Lakshmana? Hanuman did; so Mars is the planet that brings life-saving medicine and revival.
ambiguity: The sentence trails into the next one with 'so Hanuman only'.
classical_check: Mars as significator of medicine/surgery is classical; Sanjeevani story is mythological support.

hindi: राहु के साथ पितृ दोष लगता है राहु का राहु सूर्य को ग्रहण लगाता है
says: Pitru dosha arises with Rahu: Rahu eclipses the Sun (the father and ancestors significator), and that is the Rahu-Sun ancestral affliction.
cells_derived_method: Impact depends on the house where Rahu eclipses the Sun and the sign: 9th shows father/ancestor line, 5th shows children and past merit, 10th shows career and authority; in Leo (Sun's own sign) the eclipse hits the self-radiance, in Aries (Sun exalted) it is disguised strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Rahu in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) puts the ancestral and father-guru line under eclipse.
Derived: Sun exalted with Rahu in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) shows ancestors' unrest affecting children and creative merit.
Derived: Sun exalted with Rahu in the 10th (lagna Cancer) is an eclipse on career status and authority figures.

ambiguity: He says 'with Rahu' without saying conjunction versus aspect.
classical_check: Classical Pitru dosha indeed uses Sun-Rahu conjunction (grahan) among its forms; agrees.

gist: 'इसलिए राहु के आगे बम बम है' — caption unclear, probably a devotional exclamation about Rahu and Shiva.

hindi: हम कहते हैं देवता की पूजा मत करो भगवान की पूजा मत करो तुम्हारे लिए भगवान का दोष नहीं है तुम्हारा पित्रों का दोष है
says: For this affliction he tells people not to worship gods, because the fault is not from the gods but from ancestors; so the remedy is directed to the ancestors, not deities.
ambiguity: 'Do not worship gods' is probably 'not primarily' rather than a ban.
classical_check: Classical advice for pitru dosha is shraddha and tarpan to ancestors, so it agrees; the 'do not worship gods' part is his rhetoric.

hindi: भैया तुम पित की कृपा कर लो उसको भी दोष मुक्त
says: Remedy: win the favour of the pitars (ancestors) and the ancestral blemish gets cleared. Caption is clipped at the end.
ambiguity: 'पित' is a clipped 'pitar'.
classical_check: Agrees with shraddha/tarpan remedies.

hindi: राहु को करने के लिए मंगल लगता है
says: To make Rahu free of its fault (to correct the Rahu-based ancestral problem) Mars is needed; his working rule is that Mars strength is the cure for Rahu affliction.
cells_derived_method: Mars's ability to cure depends on its own dignity: strong in Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn; weak in Cancer. If Mars is in the same house as Rahu it either fights or burns it, depending on sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted (lagna Aries) can control Rahu in the 10th, so authority and career issues of ancestry are managed.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 4th (lagna Aries) is too weak to set Rahu right at home level.

ambiguity: Sentence is short, possibly clipped from the previous clause.
classical_check: Not in classical texts; Mars is treated there as an enemy of Rahu in some schemes.

hindi: जितने लोग सोशल मीडिया में पड़े जो राहु का कार्य कर रहे हैं उनको खूब गालियां पड़ती है तूने ये बोला तू घटिया है तू नीच है तू ये है
says: Social media is Rahu's work; people active there get abused heavily, called low and worthless. So Rahu rules social media and its public insult culture.
classical_check: Rahu as modern media and mass communication is a modern extension; not in classical texts.

hindi: अगर वो मंगल स्ट्रंग यानी बाहुबल मानसिक बल भाड़ में जाए और यह सोच के चलते हैं अरे छोड़ यार दफा कर क्या रखा है माफ कर और साफ कर
says: If Mars is strong, meaning physical and mental strength, the person simply thinks 'leave it, forget it, forgive and clear it out' about the abuse; a strong Mars gives the ability to let things go.
ambiguity: 'भाड़ में जाए' is slang filler again.
classical_check: Mars as mental courage is classical; the 'forgive' link is his addition.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति ने माफ कर दिया ना माफ करना वह हनुमान है उसने मंगल इग्नाइट कर दिया है पित्र भी उसको हाथ नहीं लगाते
says: A person who forgives is Hanuman: he has ignited his Mars, and even the ancestral afflictions do not touch him; forgiving is presented as a practical way to cleanse pitru dosha.
ambiguity: Metaphorical, not a ritual.
classical_check: Not classical, a behavioural remedy of his own.

hindi: चार भाई हैं एक को दोष लगा हुआ है दो को नहीं लगा हुआ भाई क्यों उन दो के चरित्र मानसिकता में भाड़ में जाए की फिलोसोफी है कि यार अब दफा कर यार इसको माफ कर इसको साफ कर
says: Example of four brothers where one is hit by the ancestral dosha and two are not; he explains the unaffected ones have a forgive-and-move-on mindset. Numbers do not add up in the caption (one, two out of four), so the example is loose.
ambiguity: Four brothers with 'one' and 'two' leaves one unexplained, probably a slip.
classical_check: Silent; classical view would look at each brother's own chart.

hindi: आपका मंगल सेट राहु सेट राहु सेट मतलब आपके पितृ सेट पितृ सेट मतलब पांचवा घर प्रजनन सेट
says: He gives a chain: Mars well-set makes Rahu well-set, which means ancestors are in order, which means the 5th house and reproduction are in order.
cells_derived_method: The chain works through the 5th house: the quality of Mars and Rahu in or aspecting the 5th, and the sign of the 5th lord, set the result; Mars in the 5th in a fire sign can be forceful on children, in water sign emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 5th (lagna Cancer) gives strong progeny drive, but with temper in dealing with children.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 5th (lagna Pisces) is the chain broken: weak Mars means ancestral and progeny matters need care.

ambiguity: 'सेट' means in good order; he does not define how to measure it.
classical_check: The 5th house as house of progeny and purva punya is classical; the Mars-Rahu-pitru chain is his.

hindi: यह सेट मतलब पति पत्नी में रोमांस रोमांस होता है यहां से रोमांस प्रेम प्रेम है तो आपका एग और स्पर्म दोनों फर्टाइल होंगे फर्टिलिटी यहां से होती है
says: When the 5th house is well set, romance and love between husband and wife flows from there, and then both egg and sperm are fertile; he ties romance and fertility to the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: Which side of fertility shows depends on the sign and planet in the 5th: Venus/Moon signs show love and feeling, Mars/Sun signs show vitality and drive, Saturn signs delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Taurus (lagna Capricorn) leans to sensual romance and steady fertility.
Derived: 5th house in Capricorn (lagna Virgo) shows delayed or restrained romance and conception timing.

ambiguity: Reproductive health is not a diagnosis here; it is his house significance claim.
classical_check: 5th house for progeny and romance is classical; agrees.

hindi: इसके दोष के लिए घर के अंदर ईटू के अंदर बीज रख दिए जाते हैं किसी प्रकार के भी अच्छे उपजाऊ बीज रख दीजिए पंचम भाव को भी बल मिलता है
says: Remedy for a 5th-house fault: keep good fertile seeds of any kind in a particular spot in the house (the caption word 'ईटू' is garbled), and the 5th house gains strength.
ambiguity: 'ईटू' is unclear; possibly a pot, an earthen container, or north-east (ईशान); I cannot tell.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a folk or vastu-style remedy.

hindi: यह आपका पितरों का स्थान सेट तो मंगल इसी को सेट करता है
says: The 5th place is the seat of ancestors; when this is in order, Mars is what puts it in order. Mars is the setter of the ancestral seat.
cells_derived_method: Mars in or aspecting the 5th changes the effect: in the 5th itself it acts directly; Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from where it sits, so it reaches the 5th from the 2nd (4th aspect), the 11th (7th aspect) or the 10th (8th aspect).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects the 5th by its 8th aspect, so it can set the ancestral/progeny place from outside with strength.
Derived: Mars in the 2nd (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th by its 4th aspect; family and speech-related inheritance affect the 5th.

ambiguity: 'पितरों का स्थान' as 5th house follows his own scheme, not the classical 9th.
classical_check: Classically the 9th is the house of ancestors and father; 5th is purva punya. His 5th house assignment differs partly.

hindi: आपको इंटूटिव पावर सारी मंगल अष्ट सिद्ध नौ निधि के दाता आपके मंगल के कारण होती है
says: Intuitive power and all the eight siddhis and nine nidhis (the powers Hanuman grants) come because of your Mars; Mars is the giver of intuition and spiritual powers.
classical_check: Mars as a source of siddhis is devotional (Hanuman); classical karaka lists do not include intuition.

hindi: इसलिए मंगल की पावर समझ लो यही आपको साइंटिस्ट पैदा करके देता है मंगल की स्ट्रेंथ के कारण ही डॉक्टर बनते हो आप
says: Therefore understand Mars's power: it produces scientists, and it is because of Mars strength that people become doctors.
cells_derived_method: Profession shows more when Mars is strong in a kendra or the 6th/10th: Mars in the 10th in Capricorn suits surgery and engineering; Mars in the 6th suits healing and defeating disease.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) points to surgeon, engineer, scientist style careers.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 6th (lagna Gemini) suits medicine, healing, or diagnostic work.

ambiguity: No condition given for how strong Mars must be.
classical_check: Mars as significator of surgeons and medical professions is classical; scientists is a modern extension.

hindi: मंगल के पास ही दवाइयों की सारी नॉलेज है फार्मेसिस्ट इंडस्ट्रियलिस्ट बहुत बड़ा प्रॉपर्टी का काम सब मंगल के पास है
says: All knowledge of medicines belongs to Mars, as do pharmacists, industrialists and big property business; Mars is the karaka for pharma, industry and real estate.
cells_derived_method: Property shows when Mars links the 4th (land); industry when Mars links the 10th; medicine when Mars links the 6th. Sign nature adds flavour: Aries/Scorpio direct force, Capricorn organised industry.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) points to land, property and real-estate dealings.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 10th (lagna Aquarius) points to chemical, pharma or heavy-industry type work.

classical_check: Mars as land, property, minerals and chemicals is classical; pharmacy is a modern add.

hindi: इसलिए मंगलिक दोष के लिए लड़की की पूजा करानी बहुत जरूरी है ताकि उसको प्रॉब्लम ना हो
says: Hence for the manglik dosha it is very important to get a puja done for the girl so that she does not face problems.
ambiguity: Which puja is meant is not said in this sentence; the Kumbh Vivah was named earlier.
classical_check: Classical tradition also prescribes Mangal puja, so he agrees.

hindi: यदि मंगल का दोष लड़की की कुंडली में आ जाता है और पति के साथ मिस मैचिंग है तो शादी के बाद उसके मंगल ने उसकी ओवरी पर अटैक करना है पीसीओडी की बीमारी मंगल देता है
says: If Mars dosha is in the girl's chart and it is mismatched with her husband's chart, then after marriage her Mars will attack her ovaries, and PCOD is given by Mars. This is a health claim from tradition, not a diagnosis, and not validated.
cells_derived_method: Reproductive-organ link would come through Mars in the 5th, 8th or 2nd and 7th area, or the sign Scorpio (reproductive organs); a water or earth sign changes how it appears.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 8th (lagna Aries) sits on the Scorpio body zone of reproductive organs, so by his theory a stronger medical link.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) with a mismatched partner is a trigger of the stress-driven form of his claim.

ambiguity: He gives no placement, only 'dosha plus mismatch'.
