classical_check: Silent in classical texts; Mars does rule blood and reproductive organs in a general way, but PCOD is a modern term.

hindi: जिस जिसको लड़की को पीसीओडी है आंख मूंद के हाथी दांत पहन ले हाथी दांत नाखून बराबर टुकड़ा गले में डाल लो किसी भी दिन किसी धातु जैसे मर्जी कर लो कड़े में पहन लो जेब में रख लो पर्स में रखो
says: For any girl with PCOD he says wear elephant ivory without hesitation: a nail-sized piece as a pendant, or in a bangle, pocket or purse, any day and in any metal. This is a medical remedy claim from tradition, and ivory is legally restricted in India, so I record it only as what he said.
ambiguity: Legality of ivory is not mentioned; no substitute is named.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; not a standard classical Mars remedy (red coral is).

hindi: वो होना चाहिए उनके शरीर के पास रहेगा पीसीओडी की प्रॉब्लम में रिलीफ देता है
says: The only requirement is that the ivory piece stays near the body; he claims it then gives relief in the PCOD problem. A health-relief claim by tradition, unvalidated.
ambiguity: No time period or evidence given.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Cut-off start of the next sentence ('we ... a class'); nothing readable.
Says it was already discussed that when the ovary stops doing its work a cyst forms; a physiology remark with no astrology content in itself.
Many girls with ovarian or period-date trouble get better after marriage when a regular sex life starts; a general health remark, no chart rule.
Body says it wants a physical life but is denied by social fear or suppression, so the body forms cysts; general commentary, the Mars link comes in the next sentence.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा मंगल हनुमान हाथी दांत सुधार करेगा उसमें इसी कंडीशन में अगर मंगल का दोष है अन्यथा नहीं
says: All of this will be corrected by Mars, Hanuman and the ivory remedy, but only under the condition that a Mars dosha is actually present in the chart; if not, the remedy does not apply.
ambiguity: The sentence says 'this condition' without defining the Mars dosha placements; presumably the manglik houses 1, 4, 7, 8, 12.
classical_check: Classical remedies are also prescribed only where the affliction is present; consistent.

hindi: अन्यथा नहीं आप एक्स्ट्रा बादाम खाएंगे छाले हो जाएंगे मुंह की स्किन फाड़ देता है पेट में गर्मी कर देता है
says: If there is no Mars dosha and you still use the Mars remedy, it backfires like eating extra almonds: mouth ulcers, torn mouth skin and heat in the stomach, because Mars is a heating planet. Presented as a warning; a health effect claim from tradition.
ambiguity: The almond comparison is an analogy for excess heat.
classical_check: Classical advice also warns against wearing a gem or remedy for a planet that is not troubling, so the caution agrees; the symptoms listed are his own.

hindi: ओवेरियन सिस्ट में आपका केतु और मंगल का दोष होता है
says: He says that in ovarian cysts a Ketu and Mars dosha is present. This is a medical-condition link from tradition and is not a diagnosis; treated only as his claim.
cells_derived_method: The Mars-Ketu pairing is judged by house and sign: in the 5th or 8th or in Scorpio the body-zone link is closest; Ketu in a Mars sign adds Mars-like cutting force, Mars in a Ketu-ruled sign (Scorpio or Pisces in his scheme) mixes the two.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars and Ketu together in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) is the closest match to his reproductive-organ claim.
Derived: Mars with Ketu in Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) would tie the claim to progeny and the lower abdomen through the 5th house.

ambiguity: Conjunction or aspect not specified; I assume either.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; classical Mars-Ketu conjunction is a sharp, accident and surgery combination, but not a named cyst yoga.

hindi: केतु मंगल की पूंछ है हनुमान जी के पास पूंछ है ना केतु धुए का बादल हनुमान जी ने आग लगा के नाश कर दिया था ना नीचे के रावण के पूरे किले को उस प्रकार
says: Ketu is the tail of Mars, like Hanuman's tail, and Ketu is the cloud of smoke: just as Hanuman set Ravana's fort on fire with his tail and left smoke, Ketu is the smoke that follows Mars's fire.
ambiguity: A symbolic identification, not a measurable rule.
classical_check: Classical tradition treats Ketu as Mars-like (Kuja-vat Ketu); this agrees in spirit.

hindi: इसलिए मंगली मंगल दोष के कारण या केतु दोष के कारण मंथ की डेट डिस्टर्ब होती है
says: Because of Mars dosha or Ketu dosha, menstrual dates get disturbed in women. A health-pattern claim from tradition, not a diagnosis or a validated link.
ambiguity: No placement is named for when this applies.
classical_check: Classically Mars is the karaka of menstruation (blood), so the Mars part is consistent; the Ketu part is his addition.

hindi: प्रोजेस्टेरोन हार्मोन एडोल डिस्टर्ब होता है यह सारा का सारा इसी वजह से क्योंकि इसके ठीक नीचे के चक्र का मामला खराब कर दिया
says: He says the progesterone hormone also gets disturbed, and all of this is because the chakra just below the navel centre (the one under Mars's seat) has been spoiled. A body-function claim; one word in the caption is garbled.
ambiguity: 'एडोल' is garbled; may be 'आदि' (and so on).
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; hormone language is modern and the chakra link is yogic.

hindi: इमीडिएट उस लड़की को मुख्य तौर पर उठके ऊपर आना भाड़ में जाए माफ करो साफ करो अगर य नहीं करोगे ठीक नहीं होगा
says: The immediate remedy is that the girl must rise above her resentment, say 'let it go', forgive and clear it out; without this she will not get well, whatever else is done.
ambiguity: Whether this is a condition for all remedies or only the health one is not stated.
classical_check: A behavioural remedy of his; not classical.

hindi: मंगल कौन है मंगल युवा है बृहस्पति वृद्ध है बूढ़ा जो है वो बृहस्पति क्योंकि गुरु है और मंगल कौन है युवा
says: Mars is the young one and Jupiter is the old one, because Jupiter is the guru; Mars represents youth, Jupiter represents elders and age.
classical_check: Classical BPHS gives Mars the age of a young man (kumara) and Jupiter the middle-aged to old teacher, so it broadly agrees.

hindi: एथलीट सारे मंगल बनाता है अगर आपकी एथलेटिक बॉडी है आपका मंगल बहुत पावरफुल है आपको जिम भेजेगा आप गेम्स खेलोगे ही खेलोगे
says: Mars makes all athletes: if you have an athletic body, your Mars is very powerful, and it will push you to the gym and make you play games no matter what.
cells_derived_method: Sports and body build show most when Mars is strong in the 1st, 3rd (effort), 6th (stamina) or 10th; sign gives style: Aries/Scorpio raw force, Capricorn disciplined endurance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 1st (lagna Aries) gives a naturally athletic, active body.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) gives courage, stamina and a taste for contact sport.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 6th (lagna Scorpio) gives competitive fitness and recovery strength.

ambiguity: 'Powerful' is not measured; no rule for how to judge it.
classical_check: Mars as strength and sport karaka is classical; agrees.

hindi: सारे टाइम छिछोरी हरकत करते रहोगे मस्त रहोगे छोटे बच्चे की तरह फुदक ग आपकी बॉडी में ऐसा जान रहेगा फुदक ही रहते हो कहते बच्चा फुदक जा रहा है उसका चरित्र बता रहा है
says: A person with strong Mars stays playful and mischievous all the time, jumps about like a small child because of bodily energy; this bouncing quality shows the person's character.
ambiguity: The caption has a cut word; the child-like energy meaning is clear.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mars is energy and boldness, the childlike playful reading is his.

hindi: यह होने से ही लड़कियों के लिए विश् स्तर पर लेक्चर हो रहा है य यहां का फैट लॉस होगा फिर वो बहने पतली दुबली हो के घूमेंगे जिसके लिए वो तड़पती रहती सारी जिंदगी
says: With strong Mars the belly fat will go (fat loss at the abdomen), and girls will then walk around slim and lean, the thing they long for all their lives; the opening words of the sentence are garbled.
ambiguity: First half is garbled ('विश् स्तर पर लेक्चर'); the slim-body claim is clear.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: मंगल ही आपको पतला करेगा मंगल ही एथलेटिक बॉडी देगा तभी आप स्वयं से प्यार करेंगे और कहेंगे हां अब मैं सुंदर लग रही हूं
says: Only Mars slims you and gives the athletic body; only then will a woman love herself and say she looks beautiful. So Mars is tied to body shape and self-image.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mars gives a lean muscular build, but not self-love.

gist: Aside that otherwise it does not happen that a woman finds herself beautiful on her own.
A woman does not feel beautiful until 448 people tell her so; mimics pleading 'sister, you are beautiful, please accept it'.

hindi: कुंभ विवाह कराने से आपके मंगल का दोष हटेगा
says: Performing the Kumbh Vivah removes the Mars dosha of the girl; stated as the remedy result.
ambiguity: No time limit or pre-conditions are given.
classical_check: Agrees with tradition that Kumbh Vivah is a standard remedy for Kuja dosha.

hindi: यदि इसी तरह की कुंडली में शनि महाराज इसी किसी स्थान में बैठे हुए हैं तो मंगल भंग हो गया सि बैठने से दृष्टि से नहीं बैठना दृष्टि से नहीं शनि महाराज यहां बैठे हुए हैं तो मंगली दोष भंग हो गया
says: If in such a chart Saturn is sitting in a certain place (he points to a house on the board), the Mars dosha is cancelled; it must be Saturn sitting there, not just aspecting it.
cells_derived_method: Classical form: Saturn placed in a manglik house (1, 4, 7, 8, 12) cancels the dosha; the effect is stronger when Saturn is in a friendly or own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius, Libra exalted) and weaker in Aries (debilitated).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the 7th (lagna Aries) cancels the Mars dosha strongly in his rule since it sits, not aspects.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) cancels in name but the cancelling planet is weak, so partial relief only.
Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 12th (lagna Pisces) cancels the dosha for 12th-house Mars with solid strength.

ambiguity: He points at a board position; which house is not audible in the caption ('किसी स्थान'). The houses in the cells are the classical set, assumed.
classical_check: Classical texts list Saturn in a Mars-dosha house among cancellations, so this agrees; his 'sit not aspect' emphasis is stricter.

hindi: यानी कि लड़की मंगलिक है और नॉन मंगलिक है अब इसकी शादी मंगलिक से भी हो सकती है नॉन मंगलिक से भी
says: So when the girl's dosha is cancelled she counts as both manglik and non-manglik, and she can then be married to a manglik or a non-manglik partner.
ambiguity: 'Manglik and non-manglik' means manglik by position but cancelled.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea that a cancelled dosha gives matching freedom.

hindi: लड़का मंगलिक भी है नॉन मंगलिक लेकिन इसकी शादी मंगलिक से भी हो सकती है नॉन मंगली से भी
says: The same freedom is given to a boy with a cancelled Mars dosha: he may marry a manglik or a non-manglik girl.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical symmetry between boy and girl for cancelled doshas.

hindi: लड़का होगा तो 27 की उम्र या 28 के बाद शादी कराएगा लड़की होगी तो 23 के बाद मतलब मंगली है
says: For a manglik, marriage should be timed late: a boy should marry at 27 or after 28, a girl after 23. These are age thresholds he gives for manglik charts.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled at 'जज या' (likely 'उम्र या'); 27 versus 28 is a bit unclear.
classical_check: Classical texts say Kuja dosha weakens after age 28; the boy's number agrees, the girl's 23 is his own figure.

hindi: अब आप बेकार में 18 साल में शादी 20 साल 21 साल में 22 साल में शादी ढूंढ रहे हो दुखी हो जाओगे
says: If a manglik looks for marriage at 18, 20, 21 or 22 years, it is a waste and you will become unhappy; marrying too early is the mistake.
ambiguity: Applies to manglik charts only, by context.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical delay advice for Kuja dosha.

hindi: खून के आंसू रो हो गए अब आपने रो पिट के किसी गलतफहमी में आगे पीछे खिसका हुआ है मंगल चलित में निर भाव में या फिर केपी में घूमा हुआ है
says: Warns that you will weep tears of blood if you go by a misunderstanding: Mars may have shifted forward or backward to another house in the bhava chalit, in a bhava system he calls 'nir-bhava', or in KP, so the plain rashi-chart house for Mars can be wrong when judging the dosha.
cells_derived_method: Mars near a house boundary can be in a different house in bhava chalit or KP than in the rashi chart; a Mars in the 2nd in D1 may move to the 1st (becoming manglik) or a Mars in the 4th may move to the 3rd (losing it).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the late part of the 2nd (lagna Aries) can shift to the 3rd in chalit and so changes dosha status.
Derived: Mars at the start of the 7th (lagna Aries) may fall in the 6th in bhava chalit, which would remove the 7th-house dosha.
Derived: Mars at the end of the 4th (lagna Pisces) may fall in the 5th in chalit and drop the manglik label.

ambiguity: 'निर भाव' is unclear: could be Sripati/Nirayana bhava or garbled; the caption start is garbled too.
classical_check: Bhava chalit shifting of planets is classical; applying it to manglik is accepted by many, matching his statement.

hindi: और आपने शादी कर ली 26 में तो 2 साल तक खूब जूत बजाई होगी लगेगा लड़का लड़की तलाक ही हो जाएगा घर ही आ जाएंगे वापस
says: If a manglik marries at 26 relying on a wrong reading, there will be about two years of heavy fighting and it will look like divorce is certain, with each spouse returning to the parents' home.
ambiguity: 'Two years' is a rough figure, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent on two-year phase; his own observation.

hindi: अगर उतने टाइम झगड़ा झुग करके निपटा लिया तो 27 28 क्रॉस होते ही सब ठीक हो जाएगा
says: If the couple gets through that fighting period, then once the age crosses 27 to 28 everything settles down; the manglik effect eases around that age.
ambiguity: Whose age (husband or wife) is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical belief that Kuja dosha reduces after 28.

hindi: फिर आप कहेंगे यार शुरू में तो बहुत झगड़ा था भाई अब बहुत सुखी है यार अब बहुत बढ़िया है तो थोड़ा-थोड़ा फेज आता है पति-पत्नी में
says: Later the couple will say that the early years were full of fights but now they are very happy, because marriage goes through phases between husband and wife.
ambiguity: A general comment, loosely tied to Mars.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: जब जब ब्रह्मचर्य यानी झगड़ा हो रहा है बेड प रूसे हुए हैं एक दूसरे से ... तो ऐसी स्थिति में मंगल का दोष आ चुका है
says: Whenever the couple is in 'celibacy', meaning a quarrel, and is sulking at each other in bed, he says a Mars dosha has arrived in that situation; he uses this as a behavioural sign of the dosha at work.
ambiguity: The middle of the sentence is a joke about Russia and America that I recorded separately.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a behavioural reading of the dosha.

gist: Pun that 'Russia has come (sulking) so America should come too': sulking in bed and the sex life gone cold, 'I will do it to everyone'.

hindi: और मंगल का दोष आने के साथ आपने माफ या साफ नहीं किया तो आपका मन को कुड़ता रहेगा आपका मन खींचता रहेगा कुड़ता रहेगा और आप दुखी द्रवित कुड़ते रहोगे
says: Along with the Mars dosha, if you do not forgive and clear things, your mind will keep fretting and pulling, you will keep brooding in sorrow; resentment feeds on itself.
ambiguity: 'कुड़ना' means to fret or seethe inwardly.
classical_check: Silent; a psychological extension of Mars's anger.

hindi: कुड़े आपके शरीर के अंदर स्किन ढीली हो जाएगी स्त्रियां डर के सोचे इस बारे में कि कहीं ऐसा ना हो मेरी स्किन प्रॉब्लम मेरी त्वचा से मेरी उम्र का पता नहीं चलता
says: Inner brooding makes the skin go loose, he says, so women should be afraid of this and think about it, so that their skin does not show their age. A cosmetic and health claim from tradition.
ambiguity: The caption merges two thoughts; the skin-ageing meaning is clear.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Quips that otherwise the woman would have to bathe again and again with a branded soap to keep her skin; a brand pun.

hindi: इसलिए इससे बचने के लिए अपनी स्किन खराब ना होने दे कुड़े ना कुड़े ना कोई भी बहन बेटी कोई ना कुड़े कुड़ना पाप है
says: To avoid that, do not let your skin go bad: no sister or daughter should brood; he calls brooding a sin. It is a behavioural prescription: do not hold resentment.
ambiguity: The sentence ends at the start of the next timestamp.
classical_check: Not classical; a moral directive.

gist: 'घर के नीचे सांप है' (a snake under the house): a stray line, context lost, probably an aside about hidden resentment.

hindi: मंगल की यहां से दृष्टि है यहां पर यहां से दृष्टि है यहां पर यहां से दृष्टि है यहां पर और कौन सा रह गया फोर्थ से भी हो गया एथ हो गई और सातवी भी हो गई चलो
says: Teaching on the board: he counts the aspects of Mars, which are the 4th, the 7th and the 8th from where Mars sits, showing which houses are hit from a given spot.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses counted from its own house; the sign hit depends on where Mars sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) aspects the 4th (Cancer), 7th (Libra) and 8th (Scorpio).
Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects the 1st (Aries), the 4th (Cancer) and the 5th (Leo).
Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 10th (Aries), the 1st (Cancer) and the 2nd (Leo).

ambiguity: The pointing on the board is lost; 'फोर्थ' is the 4th, and I take the three aspects as 4, 7 and 8.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Mars aspects: 4th, 7th, 8th from itself.

hindi: अगर मंगल की अगर यहां पर दृष्टि है और एक नंबर राशि है तो मंगल इज टू गुड टू गुड एक नंबर का मंगल है तो यह मंगल मंगल का ही राशि है लाजवाब काम करेगा
says: If Mars's aspect falls on a place where the sign is number 1 (Aries), Mars is 'too good': it is Mars's own sign, so the aspect works superbly there.
cells_derived_method: The aspect on Aries is strong in whichever house Aries falls; the house it lands on says which area benefits: Aries on the 4th gives home and property, on the 7th partner, on the 8th hidden resources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries as the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) aspected by Mars gives strong home and mother matters.
Derived: Aries as the 7th house (lagna Libra) aspected by Mars gives an energetic, forceful partner and partnership drive.
Derived: Aries as the 8th house (lagna Virgo) aspected by Mars gives strength in the transformations, inheritance and sudden events.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर राशि' is the sign number: Aries=1, confirmed in this series.
classical_check: A planet's aspect on its own sign is classically considered favourable; agrees.

hindi: यहां दो नंबर का मंगल है यह शुक्र की राशि है मंगल यहां भी अच्छा काम करेगा लेकिन शुक्र की पोजीशन देखनी पड़ेगी
says: When the aspected sign is number 2, Taurus, it is Venus's sign; Mars's aspect works well here too, but you have to look at Venus's position to judge it.
cells_derived_method: Result depends on Venus: if Venus is strong and well placed the Mars aspect on Taurus gives energy and enjoyment; if Venus is weak or afflicted the same aspect creates conflict in the Venus matters of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus as the 7th house (lagna Scorpio) aspected by Mars: partner is sensual and driven, but check Venus for harmony.
Derived: Taurus as the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) aspected by Mars: comfort and vehicles are energised, depending on Venus.

ambiguity: 'Position of Venus' not detailed, whether house or dignity.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical method of judging the aspected sign through its lord.

gist: Cross-talk with a student: 'you told us, we did not go by what you said, no sir I was saying'; classroom back-and-forth.
Teacher-student exchange about placing planets first and now taking signs; mentions sign 1 and sign 8 and stopping at number 4.

hindi: दो नंबर है फिर तीन नंबर है ये बुध की राशि है
says: Continuing the sign list he says number 2 is next and then number 3, which is Mercury's sign (Gemini), the sign Mars's aspect reaches next.
cells_derived_method: A Mars aspect on Gemini must be read through Mercury; the effect on the house Gemini occupies shows as quarrels in speech and trade if Mercury is weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini as the 3rd house (lagna Aries) aspected by Mars: sharp, bold communication, depends on Mercury.
Derived: Gemini as the 10th house (lagna Virgo) aspected by Mars: career in sales, media or trade with aggressive pace.

ambiguity: He assigns only Mercury as lord of sign 3; Gemini is Mercury-ruled in all schemes.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini is lorded by Mercury.

gist: Teaser that an important problem is coming that will end many households' fights and start some others; not yet content.

hindi: अब यहां पर हमारे पास चार नंबर है चार नंबर का मंगल नीच का होता है
says: Sign number 4 is Cancer, and Mars in sign 4 is debilitated, the weakest placement for Mars.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer weakens the matters of the house it sits in; 4th house (home), 7th (partner) and 10th (career) show it most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 4th (lagna Aries) gives restlessness at home and trouble with property or mother.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives conflict or lack of drive in partnerships.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 10th (lagna Libra) gives an unsettled career with emotional rather than decisive action.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: यहां से मंगल ने दृष्टि डाली यहां चार नंबर है यहां से डाली यहां चार रहा यहां बैठा ही है अब अगर तो मंगल यहां नीच का बैठा है
says: He shows that Mars can touch sign 4 (Cancer) in all its ways: by aspect from three different places, or by sitting there itself, in which case it is debilitated.
cells_derived_method: Mars reaches Cancer by its 4th aspect from Aries, 7th aspect from Capricorn and 8th aspect from Sagittarius, or by sitting in Cancer; which house this is in depends on the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects Cancer by its 7th aspect, hitting the 4th house with a strong, not weak, Mars.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 1st (lagna Aries) aspects Cancer by its 4th aspect, so the 4th house of home and mother is touched.

ambiguity: Which positions he pointed to is lost; the three source signs (Aries, Capricorn, Sagittarius) are my derivation from Mars's aspects 4, 7, 8.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard Mars aspect geometry.

hindi: हर ग्रह की राशि को समझ लो जब जब वो अपने नीच घर में होता है खुद बैठा है तो उसने वो सत्यानाश करके खत्म बर्बाद कर देना है
says: General rule for every planet: when a planet sits in its own debilitation sign it wrecks and ruins the matters of that house, destroying them completely.
cells_derived_method: Debilitation signs: Sun in Libra, Moon in Scorpio, Mars in Cancer, Mercury in Pisces, Jupiter in Capricorn, Venus in Virgo, Saturn in Aries. The destroyed matter is whatever the house holds and what the planet signifies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) ruins authority, status and father-linked career in his rule.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo) ruins children and education matters in his rule.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces) ruins marriage and partnership matters in his rule.

ambiguity: 'सत्यानाश' is strong wording; he may be exaggerating for effect, and Neecha-bhanga is not mentioned.
classical_check: Differs: classically a debilitated planet is weakened and can be rescued by Neecha-bhanga; it is not automatically a total ruin.

hindi: लेकिन वह खुद को नष्ट नहीं करता अगर उसकी दूर से दृष्टि है तो नष्ट कर देता है
says: A debilitated planet does not destroy the place where it sits itself, but if it casts its aspect from afar it destroys the place it aspects; the aspect is the deadlier action. The wording is ambiguous.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated planet's aspect destroys the matters of the aspected house; for Mars in Cancer the target is the 4th, 7th and 8th from it, so house effects differ by where Mars sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 1st (lagna Cancer) aspects the 4th (Libra), 7th (Capricorn) and 8th (Aquarius): home, partnership and longevity matters are hit.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 12th, 3rd and 4th houses: loss, effort and home matters are hit.

ambiguity: This contradicts his previous sentence, where a sitting debilitated planet destroys; 'खुद को' may mean 'its own house' or 'itself'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; differs from the idea that aspects of weak planets are weak.

hindi: मंगल ने यहां से तोप के द्वारा यहां तीन जगह से
says: Metaphor: Mars fires at the target like a cannon from three places, its three aspects at once; the sentence is cut off at the end of this slice.
ambiguity: Sentence is truncated at the batch end; the continuation is in the next slice.
classical_check: Consistent with Mars's three aspects (4, 7, 8).

hindi: तोप के द्वारा आग का गोला फेंका सातवां घर नष्ट
says: Continuing the cannon picture, a debilitated Mars aspecting the 7th house throws a fireball at it and the 7th house (marriage, partner) is destroyed in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars (in Cancer) reaches the 7th house by sitting in the 1st (7th aspect), the 4th (4th aspect) or the 12th (8th aspect); the sign of the 7th changes the form: Capricorn 7th is career-minded partner under fire, Libra 7th is a partner-relationship under fire.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 1st (lagna Cancer) aspects the 7th house Capricorn, so the spouse and business partners are harshly hit.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 4th (lagna Aries) aspects the 7th house Libra by its 4th aspect, harming the spouse through domestic strife.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 12th Cancer (lagna Leo) aspects the 7th Aquarius by its 8th aspect, with losses and distance in marriage.

ambiguity: 'सातवां घर' is taken from the board context; it follows the Mars-in-Cancer discussion from the previous slice.
classical_check: Classically a debilitated Mars aspecting the 7th harms marriage, but 'destroyed' is stronger than texts say.

hindi: ऑपरेशन होंगे एक तो सारे सर्जरी से बच्चे पैदा होंगे सी सेक्शन होगा
says: The result of this Mars affliction is operations: children will be born through surgery, meaning a C-section. This is a medical-event claim from tradition and is not a prediction to rely on.
ambiguity: Whether it needs the 7th, 5th or 8th house to be involved is not said; I only tie it to the 7th by context.
classical_check: Mars as surgery karaka is classical; C-section as a specific outcome is his modern application.

hindi: आपको पाइल्स दे देगा अगर मंगल यहां से कनेक्ट होता तो पाइल्स दे देगा एनल फिशर दे देगा कई किस्म की प्रॉब्लम्स देगा
says: If Mars connects to that spot it will give piles, anal fissure and several other problems; a health claim from tradition, not a diagnosis. Which house 'here' means is not clear in the caption.
ambiguity: 'यहां से' points at a board position; it is not clear which house or sign.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts as a named yoga; Mars in the 6th or 8th is traditionally linked to rectal and blood troubles.

hindi: लेकिन लड़की के पर्सपेक्टिव से क्या है कि उसको संतान जन्म करना है अब संतान जन्म के टाइम बेचारे क्या कि कर रहे कष्ट पाती है
says: From the girl's side the issue is that she has to give birth, and at childbirth she suffers pain; so a Mars problem in her chart matters because it touches childbirth.
ambiguity: No house is named here; 5th is the natural childbirth house, but he does not say it.
classical_check: Silent on this reasoning; classical texts tie childbirth to the 5th house and Mars to surgery.

hindi: तो मंगल इसलिए इतने इंपोर्टेंट है कि सारे ऑपरेशन उस स्त्री के इसी के पास है इसलिए बड़े ध्यान से शादी करें
says: This is why Mars is so important: all of a woman's operations are in its hands, so one should marry with great care about the Mars match.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of surgery is classical; the marriage-match emphasis is his.

hindi: लड़के के आते ही सबसे पहले उसका मंगल साफ करे कि साले तू ऑपरेशन कराएगा मेरे तेरी ऐसी की तैसी
says: When a boy's proposal arrives, first check and clear his Mars, to see whether he will bring operations to the girl; said in a joking and abusive tone, but it is a rule to check the boy's Mars first.
ambiguity: 'साफ करे' means check and clarify, not remedy.
classical_check: Checking both charts' Mars in matching is classical.

hindi: अब अगर उसका शरीर स्वस्थ रहा तो इसमें खासियत देखिए यदि उसका शरीर स्वस्थ है तभी बच्चों को एक अच्छी माता मिलेगी
says: If the woman's body stays healthy, then the children get a good mother; her health is the base of good motherhood, which is why her Mars condition matters.
ambiguity: A general statement, only loosely tied to Mars.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Jokes that a man is useless and would cry without a wife, asking who will give him water and bread.
Says he is telling his own story of how helpless a man's condition becomes without his wife.
Sets up a hypothetical example: 'suppose Mars sits here debilitated' (continues in the next slice).

hindi: अब इसमें 99 पर क्या 100 लेके चलो लेकिन 99 इसलिए क्योंकि कई कॉमिनेशन में यह चीज गलत हो जाती है
says: He says take this as 100 percent but he says 99, because in some combinations this result goes wrong; he admits a small exception rate to the rule.
ambiguity: The figure is rhetorical, not a measured accuracy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लोग कहेंगे हमारे तो है नहीं क्योंकि मंगल कभी यहां है कभी यहां हो सकता है चार नंबर राशि ही काम नहीं कर रही
says: People will object that this is not in their chart, because Mars can be in other houses or the sign number 4 may not even be operating there; he is pointing out that the pattern only applies when that exact placement exists. Last words are garbled.
ambiguity: 'चार नंबर राशि ही काम नहीं कर रही' is unclear; it may mean the sign is not the one acting in that chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस लड़की का पति जब तक अल्कोहल लेता रहेगा या कोई ना कोई द्रव्य का मादक द्रव्य का इस्तेमाल करेगा तब तक गृहस्थ बढिया चलेगी नहीं तो झगड़े
says: For the girl with Mars debilitated in sign 4 at the 7th place, he says her husband will use alcohol or some intoxicant, and as long as he does, the household runs well; otherwise quarrels start. This describes his claim only and is not advice to drink.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars in the 7th gives the spouse an intoxicant habit and a temper that needs it as an outlet; if Mars were exalted in Capricorn in the 7th the spouse would be forceful but not addicted; in Aries (own) it is energy without escape.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: this cell (Mars debilitated in the 7th, lagna Capricorn) is the one he is describing; husband has a habit, calm only while it continues.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) would give a driven and dominant spouse with no addiction link.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Taurus) gives an intense, secretive spouse with possible substance pull, less clearly than debilitation.

ambiguity: The house is inferred from 'the girl's husband' (7th) and the earlier sign-4 debilitation; the board position itself is not in the caption.
classical_check: Silent on this specific outcome; classical texts link Mars in the 7th to a hot-tempered spouse.

gist: Mimics families who complain 'we got a drunkard husband' and calls this a strange problem.

hindi: मंगल ग्रह पुरुष होता है पुरुष की कुंडली में मंगल ऐसा है तो शराबी पत्नी मिले ऐसा नहीं है उसके लिए शुक्र और इंद्र इत्यादि का कार्यक्रम देखना पड़ेगा
says: Mars is a male planet, so in a man's chart the same Mars does not mean he gets a drinking wife; for a wife with that habit you must look at Venus and Indra (Uranus) and so on.
cells_derived_method: For a man's chart the spouse is read through Venus (karaka) and the 7th house; Uranus affliction to Venus or the 7th shows unconventional or substance-prone spouse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for a male chart (lagna Aries) with Venus in own sign in the 7th, the wife is judged from Venus, not from Mars.
Derived: Uranus with the 7th in Aquarius (lagna Leo) would be his marker for an unconventional or habit-prone wife.

ambiguity: 'इंद्र' is Uranus in his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Venus as spouse karaka for men is classical; Uranus is outside the classical scheme.

gist: Mimics a wife saying 'where is our own drink, you wasted all the money on liquor, now give me some too'.

hindi: लेकिन मंगल यहां बैठा है तो उसके पति में व्यसन होना ही है और वह संभोग की क्रिया भी व्यसन के द्वारा या व्यसन के बाद ही करेगा ये अधिकतर अधिकतर चांस है अगर मंगल पूर्ण रूप से स्थापित है
says: If Mars sits there, the husband will definitely carry an addiction, and even intimacy happens through or after it; this is mostly likely when Mars is fully established (well formed in that position). A claim about a spouse's habits, labelled as tradition.
cells_derived_method: 'Fully established' reads as Mars strong in the placement by dignity and no cancelling planet; sign changes the habit form: fire signs smoking and alcohol, water signs drink and emotion-driven use.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn), alcohol-linked, emotional pattern.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Libra), a vigorous, habit-driven spouse in fire-type pattern.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is the 7th by context; 'fully established' is not defined.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Says families ask for a teetotaller boy, a saint-like one who never drinks or smokes, and calls this a big problem.
Story of a boy known to the whole world as a non-drinker and non-smoker who marries a lovely cultured girl, and starts drinking after the wedding.
Mother-in-law accuses the bride of teaching her son to drink; the bride replies she only does Gita recitation and it began after her arrival.

hindi: वो कहानी किसी की गलती की नहीं है वह मंगल देवता की कृपा है कई बार दृष्टि होने पर भी यहां करता है
says: The change in the husband is nobody's fault but the effect of Mars's grace; and it happens sometimes even when Mars only aspects the place and does not sit there.
cells_derived_method: Mars's aspect on the 7th (from the 1st, 4th or 12th) can bring the same drinking and quarrel pattern, weaker than sitting there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 1st Aries (lagna Aries) aspecting the 7th Libra by its 7th aspect gives the same habit effect in a milder form.
Derived: Mars in the 4th Libra (lagna Cancer) aspecting the 7th Capricorn by its 4th aspect gives the effect through home stress.

ambiguity: 'यहां करता है' means does this thing; the place is 7th by context.
classical_check: Silent; aspect effects of Mars on the 7th are classical, but the drinking outcome is his.

hindi: यही सेम काम शनि करता है वह भी जरूर दारू पिलाता है अब दारू पिलाना फाइट नहीं है व्यसन करा सकता है शनि तो जुआ भी खिला देता है
says: Saturn does the same job: it also makes one drink, but it does not cause fights, only addiction; Saturn can even make a person gamble. Recorded as his claim, not as advice.
ambiguity: Whether Saturn must sit in the 7th for this is not said.
classical_check: Saturn as a karaka of intoxicants is classical; gambling is more usually Rahu.

hindi: पर यहां मंगल की बात यह जो शराब का मुद्दा आता है और झगड़े होते हैं झगड़ा होते ही पति-पत्नी को छोटे-छोटे लेकर बैठ जाना चाहिए
says: For the Mars case where drink and quarrels arise, as soon as a quarrel starts the husband and wife should sit together with small drinks; his proposed way to calm the Mars fire.
ambiguity: He clarifies in the next sentence that this need not be alcohol.
classical_check: Not a classical remedy; his own practical tip.

hindi: अब आप कहेंगे जी मैं दारू के बारे में प्रोपेट कर रहा हूं दारू पियो नहीं आप दारू की लड़ाई नहीं है साथ में कोई भी ड्रिंक शेयर कर लो पेप्सी ले लो कोक ले लो आपको वो बहाना बनाना है दैट यू आर टेकिंग सम
says: He clarifies he is not promoting alcohol: the couple can share any drink, even a cola, as a pretext of sitting and taking something together; the point is the shared act, not liquor.
ambiguity: Sentence flows into the next slice ('some drink').
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: ड्रिंक उसके द्वारा मंगल लीफाई होगा
says: Through sharing that drink Mars gets pacified; the garbled word 'लीफाई' is probably 'pacify' or 'liquefy', meaning the Mars heat is cooled.
ambiguity: 'लीफाई' unclear (pacify/liquefy/pacify).
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: मंगल भी वो पावरफुल ग्रह है जो सिर्फ राहु के द्वारा सेट होता है और राहु क्या है राहु है चस्का व्यसन
says: Mars is such a powerful planet that it is set right only through Rahu, and Rahu is craving and addiction (chaska, vyasan); so Mars's heat is absorbed by a habit.
ambiguity: 'Only by Rahu' is strong wording.
classical_check: Rahu as addiction karaka is classical; 'Mars set only by Rahu' is his.

hindi: ज्योतिष में पड़ गए सब राहु का खेल है ये भी राहु राहु भी ज्योतिष भी ज्ञान जो है इसके अंतर्गत वो बृहस्पति है चस्का जो है ज्योतिष का लग गया यह राहु है
says: Getting hooked on astrology is Rahu's play too: the knowledge in it is Jupiter, but the craving that grabbed you for it is Rahu.
classical_check: Jupiter as knowledge is classical; Rahu as obsession for it is his gloss.

hindi: बोलू इस बारे में कैसे यह बुध है मन में कितनी क्लेरिटी है यह चंद्रमा है कितने फोर्स से बोलेंगे यह मंगल है कितना रस होगा बोलने में यह शुक्र
says: Breaking down speaking: how you speak is Mercury, how much clarity is in the mind is the Moon, how forcefully you speak is Mars, and how much sweetness there is in the speech is Venus.
ambiguity: I read the mapping as Mercury=manner, Moon=clarity of mind, Mars=force, Venus=sweetness; the caption has the questions before the planets and could be read slightly differently.
classical_check: Mercury for speech, Mars for force and Venus for sweetness are classical; Moon for mental clarity is partly his.

hindi: यह सारा का सारे साथ चलते हैं ऑल कॉम्बोस
says: All these planets work together in combination; he notes that every combination of them runs side by side, so one planet is never read alone.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical approach of reading planets in combination.

hindi: इसलिए अल्कोहल टाइप या कुछ भी व्यसन राहु को चाहिए राहु पढ़ने का व्यसन लगा देता है अगर कोई और व्यसन नहीं होगा तो किताबों में रहेगा किताब ही लिखता रहेगा
says: Rahu needs some addiction, alcohol or anything else; it can also give an addiction to reading, so a person with no other habit will be buried in books or keep writing books.
classical_check: Rahu's obsessive nature is classical; the reading and writing form is his.

hindi: कुछ और करेगा कुछ ना कुछ करेगा व्यसन चाहिए उसके पश्चात ही यह मंगल शांत होगा अन्यथा यह मंगल पति पत्नी में खराबी करता है झगड़े करा सकता है
says: A person with this Mars must have some addiction or occupation as an outlet; only after that does Mars become calm, otherwise Mars spoils the husband-wife relationship and causes quarrels.
ambiguity: 'व्यसन' used loosely for any absorbing habit.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: और पता लगा लड़की का ऑपरेशन नहीं हो तो ओवेरियन प्रॉब्लम दे दी गायनी प्रॉब्लम दे दी हार्मोनल प्रॉब्लम दे दी तो वो शरीर से तंग रहेगी बेचारी त्रस्त रहेगी
says: If no operation happens to the girl, Mars instead gives ovarian, gynaecological and hormonal problems, and she remains troubled in body. A health claim from tradition, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Which placement triggers this is not repeated in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent as a named condition; Mars rules blood and the reproductive tract in a general way.

gist: A student recalls that the teacher just explained manglik dosha for the houses 1, 4, 7, 8 and 12.
Student asks: if Mars is in a manglik house with sign 1 or 8 (its own signs), which is very good, is there still a Mars dosha.

hindi: नहीं मंगल दोष तो सिर्फ वहां बैठने से है मंगल की दृष्टि से नहीं
says: Answer: the Mars dosha arises only from Mars sitting in the manglik houses 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12, not from Mars's aspect on them.
cells_derived_method: Judge dosha by Mars's own house, in D1 and also in bhava chalit; aspect from other houses is not counted for the dosha label, though it still affects the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) is manglik since it sits in the 7th.
Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra) is manglik by sitting, even though the sign is Venus's.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 1st, 4th and 5th but is not manglik because it sits in the 10th.

ambiguity: The houses come from the student's question (1,4,7,8,12); the 2nd is not included.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule that Kuja dosha depends on position, though some texts include the 2nd house and some count aspects.

gist: Student clarifies he means aspect from those houses: if Mars sits in 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 then the aspect arises from there.
Student points out that the 8th house also gets Mars's aspect from the 2nd house, though Mars is not sitting in the 8th.

hindi: यह अच्छा प्रश्न है दूसरे घर का मंगल है दृष्टि तो आठवे प है लेकिन दृष्टि की बात नहीं बैठने की बात हो रही है
says: Good question: Mars in the 2nd house does aspect the 8th house, but the dosha is about sitting, not aspect, so Mars in the 2nd is not manglik in his rule even though it hits the 8th.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 2nd aspects the 5th (4th aspect), the 8th (7th aspect) and the 9th (8th aspect); the 8th gets the effect of Mars without a manglik label, so family, speech and wealth matters show Mars rather than marriage failure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) is not manglik in his rule but its aspect on the 8th (Scorpio) is strong.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) is non-manglik by label, but harsh speech and family friction are expected, with aspect on the 8th (Capricorn).

ambiguity: Whether he sees the 2nd as non-manglik is clear here, but it is stricter than some traditions.
classical_check: Differs from schools that include the 2nd house as a manglik house.

gist: Teacher and student talk past each other: aspect can come while also sitting, but if Mars sits there what aspect would it give to that same place.
Student gives a use case: Mars sitting in the 4th aspects the 7th, so the 7th gets the aspect and the manglik dosha both.

hindi: हां तो सेवंथ हाउस प किस राशि पर दृष्टि आई उस तरह से होगा दोष
says: Yes: when Mars aspects the 7th house, the effect of the dosha depends on which sign the aspect lands on in the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: A Mars aspect on the 7th acts differently by sign: on Mars's own signs (Aries, Scorpio) it is supportive but forceful; on Venus signs it brings heat to love matters; on Saturn signs it stalls the marriage; on Cancer it hurts the emotional bond.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 4th (lagna Aries) aspects the 7th Libra by its 4th aspect: Venus sign, so heat in love and partnership.
Derived: Mars in the 4th Scorpio (lagna Leo) aspects the 7th Aquarius: Saturn sign, so Mars's push meets delay and friction.
Derived: Mars in the 4th Aries (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 7th Cancer: emotional bond heated by the aspect.

classical_check: Reading an aspect through the sign it lands on is classical.

hindi: मंगली दोष तो है ही भले वो अपने घर में बैठा तब भी मंगली दोष है अगर बवे घर में एक नंबर राशि है तो सातव में आठ है दोनों ही अपने घर है वहां भी मंगलिक दोष है ही
says: Mars dosha is there even if Mars sits in its own sign: if the manglik house carries sign 1 (Aries) or 8 (Scorpio), both Mars's own signs, the dosha still exists there.
cells_derived_method: Own-sign Mars in a manglik house still counts; the house sets the area: 1st body temper, 4th home peace, 7th partner, 8th longevity and shared life, 12th bed and expenses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Libra) is manglik with a very forceful spouse and also a classical Ruchaka-type strength.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 4th (lagna Leo) is manglik, with intense home life and property disputes.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) is manglik, with intensity in bed and heavy expenditure.

ambiguity: 'बवे घर में' is garbled; I read it as 'in that house', and 'सातव में आठ' as the sign 8 in the 7th house. The 1,4,7,8,12 houses come from the student's question.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts that treat Mars in its own or exalted sign as cancelling the dosha.

hindi: और वो घमासान होगा सात घर प किसी दूसरे की दृष्टि हुई शनि मगर आज घुस गए तो मंगल तलाक होने नहीं देगा और शनि कहेगा मैं करा के छोडूंगा नर्क जैसी जिंदगी होगी
says: If another planet like Saturn also lands on the 7th with Mars there, Mars will not let the divorce happen while Saturn insists on it, so the marriage becomes hellish and stuck; the caption has a garbled word before Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Mars and Saturn together on the 7th: the sign decides who dominates; in Capricorn both are strong, in Libra Saturn is exalted and Mars is not, in Cancer Mars is debilitated and Saturn is hostile.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted and Saturn in own sign in the 7th (lagna Cancer), a long, rigid, quarrelsome marriage that does not break.
Derived: Saturn exalted with Mars in the 7th (lagna Aries): Saturn dominates, cold and drawn-out conflict.
Derived: Mars debilitated with Saturn in the 7th (lagna Capricorn): bitter, emotional stalemate.

ambiguity: 'मगर आज घुस गए' is garbled; I read it as 'if Saturn also enters/aspects'.
classical_check: Mars with Saturn in the 7th is classically a difficult marriage combination; agrees in direction.

hindi: बहुत बुरा हाल होता है तलाक नहीं हो रहे 20-20 साल लगे हुए हैं कुत्ते की बिल्ली की तरह लड़ रहे हैं बहुत बुरा हाल है ये बहुत-बहुत डेंजरस बात प्लेनेट है
says: He says the situation becomes very bad: divorces do not finish, cases drag on for 20 years, couples fight like cats and dogs, and this planet is very dangerous.
ambiguity: No count or data; an observation from his practice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके लिए अग्नि के फेरे मत करो और यह बात सनातन के विरुद्ध नहीं है हमारे सनातन में गंधर्व विवाह भी उपयुक्त कहा गया है
says: For this Mars case do not take the fire pheras, and he says this is not against Sanatan tradition because Gandharva vivah (marriage by mutual consent without rites) is also accepted as proper.
classical_check: Gandharva vivah is one of the eight classical forms of marriage in the dharma texts, so the claim is supported, though classical astrology does not prescribe it as a Mars remedy.

hindi: मंगल सेनापति है यदि सातवें घर में मंगल की दृष्टि है या बैठा है तो लड़की को जो पति मिलेगा या लड़के को जो पत्नी मिलेगी वह सेनापति होगी यानी जिस ऑर्गेनाइजेशन में काम करता
says: Mars is the commander (senapati): if Mars aspects or sits in the 7th house, the husband of the girl or the wife of the boy will be a commander type, someone who leads in whatever organisation he or she works in.
cells_derived_method: Command quality shows in the spouse's field by sign: Capricorn gives a structured, official hierarchy leader, Aries a frontline or military-type leader, Scorpio an investigative or technical head, Cancer a leader through care or domestic authority.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) gives a spouse in a senior official or corporate leadership role.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Libra) gives a spouse who leads from the front, sports, police or army style.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives a commanding but unsettled spouse, authority with emotional swings.

ambiguity: Sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Mars as significator of commanders and authority, and the 7th as spouse, are classical; agrees.

hindi: होगा या करती होगी वह सेकंड इन कमांड होगा राजा के नीचे सेनापति होता है लेकिन खुद भी राजा जैसा होता है
says: Continuing the commander picture of the 7th-house Mars: the spouse will be second in command, like a commander under a king, who is nevertheless kingly in his own domain.
cells_derived_method: The 'second in command' quality is stronger with Mars strong (own or exalted) and in a friendly sign; with Mars debilitated the spouse is a boss without a stable position.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Libra) gives a spouse who is a number two with real executive power.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives a spouse with a commanding manner but a shaky position or mood swings.

classical_check: Mars as commander and the 7th as the spouse is classical; the 'second in command' wording is his own.

hindi: तो सीधा बोलो तेरे को ऐसा पति मिलेगा जो सेनापति जैसा होगा अपने आप में बॉस होगा सिर्फ एक ही बॉस होगा उस परे तो उसके पास पूरा डिवीजन होगा अपने हेड करता होगा व अपनी एक डिवीजन को अपने पेरेंट कंपनी के अंदर यह मंगल की खासियत आती है
says: Said plainly: the girl will get a husband who is a commander and a boss in his own right, heading a whole division inside a parent company; this is the specialty Mars gives to the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: Which kind of division head depends on sign: Capricorn (exalted) corporate or government head, Aries line or operations head, Scorpio technical or investigative head.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 7th (lagna Cancer) is a division head in an established organisation.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is a head of a technical, research or investigation division.

ambiguity: The sentence is long and partly garbled; the division-head meaning is clear.
classical_check: Consistent with classical Mars in the 7th giving a spouse in authority.

hindi: फिर य 10 नंबर आ गया इंडस्ट्रियलिस्ट बना देता है
says: When Mars comes to number 10 (the 10th house, taken here with sign 10, Capricorn) it makes the person an industrialist; Mars in the career house gives factory and big-industry success.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 10th gives industry in any sign, but sign changes style: Capricorn (exalted) large organised industry, Aries own-sign entrepreneur on his own, Scorpio heavy or chemical industry, Cancer weak and unstable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) is a big industrialist with organised enterprises.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 10th (lagna Cancer) is a self-driven entrepreneur and manager.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 10th (lagna Libra) gives unsteady enterprises and many restarts.

ambiguity: '10 नंबर' could be house 10 or sign 10; the next sentence (counting 10, 11, 12, 1) points to the 10th house with Capricorn, so I assume both.
classical_check: Mars exalted in the 10th is the Ruchaka-type yoga, classical for leadership and industry; agrees.

hindi: 10 नंबर आने से एक नंबर राशि यहां आती है 10 11 12 एक
says: With Mars in the 10th, counting 10, 11, 12, 1 shows its 4th aspect falls on the 1st house, where sign number 1 (Aries) sits, Mars's own sign; so the aspect lands on its own sign and is strong.
cells_derived_method: The 4th aspect from the 10th lands on the 1st house; with Aries as lagna Mars strengthens the body, identity and leadership; with another lagna the same aspect lands on a different sign and the effect is judged by that sign's lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna with Mars exalted in the 10th aspects its own sign in the 1st, giving vigour, authority and drive.
Derived: Cancer lagna with Mars in Aries in the 10th aspects the lagna, giving a bold, restless personality (the aspect falls on a Moon sign, not its own).

ambiguity: He counts 'ten, eleven, twelve, one', so the aspect is the 4th from the 10th.
classical_check: Agrees with Mars's 4th aspect.

hindi: दसवें घर का मालिक अपने से दसवा डबल भाग्यशाली आग की तरह काम करता है और इसकी दृष्टि भी इस पर भयंकर इंडस्ट होता है साथ भयंकर प्लेयर होता है किसी चीज का रॉकेट की तरह चलेगा
says: He says the lord of the 10th house placed in the 10th from itself is doubly fortunate and works like fire, and its aspect on it too; the result is a ferocious industrialist and a ferocious player in whatever field, who moves like a rocket. The wording is unclear.
cells_derived_method: The 10th lord in the 10th (or the 10th from itself) strengthens career; with Mars as the planet the energy is fiery, so the effect is dynamic, fast and competitive in whichever sign it falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 10th (lagna Cancer) acts directly and fiercely in career.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 10th (lagna Aquarius) gives a persistent, intense, high-stakes career style.

ambiguity: 'अपने से दसवा' (tenth from itself) and 'दसवें घर का मालिक' are not reconciled; it may be a garble of 'Mars in the 10th'.
classical_check: Classically a 10th lord in the 10th is strong for career (Dig-bala applies to Mars here); roughly agrees.

gist: 'गवन गवन कराता है बड़ा खुश' is garbled; likely a remark that such a Mars is happy and gives gains.

hindi: ताकतवर मंगल दोष शादी ब्याह में सबसे बड़ा स्यापा सबसे बड़ा लफड़ा मंगल और शनि का है
says: Of all the troubles in marriage, the biggest mess is caused by Mars and Saturn doshas; these two are the main marriage troublemakers in his scheme.
ambiguity: 'ताकतवर मंगल' ('powerful Mars') attaches to the previous line; here the point is the Mars-Saturn dosha.
classical_check: Classically Mars and Saturn are the chief malefics for the 7th house; agrees.

hindi: आपके जीवन में इतने क्लेश होते अक्सर पति पत्नी में वो सारा मंगल का कहीं ना कहीं लेनदेन है
says: Most of the strife you see between husband and wife has some Mars connection somewhere; he treats Mars as the common thread in marital quarrels.
ambiguity: No measure of 'most'.
classical_check: Consistent with Mars as a classical cause of marital discord, but overstated as the main cause.

hindi: क्योंकि वो ब्रह्मचारी बना देता है
says: The reason is that Mars makes a person celibate-minded (brahmachari), so it pulls away from the married bond.
classical_check: Not classical; Mars as a sexual and martial planet is the usual view, so his reading differs.

hindi: चंद्रमा शकी बनाता है लेकिन ब्रह्मचारी नहीं
says: The Moon makes a person suspicious but does not make a person celibate; he contrasts the Moon's effect on marriage (doubt) with Mars's (detachment).
classical_check: Moon as a source of mental doubt is common in tradition; agrees in spirit.

hindi: बनाता लेकिन पति-पत्नी के संबंध को तोड़ देता है क्योंकि वह हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस प है
says: It does not make one celibate but it breaks the husband-wife relationship, because that planet (Mars) stands on Hanuman consciousness, a celibate and devotional state that has little room for conjugal life.
ambiguity: The subject is not named; the sentence begins mid-thought about the Moon and then switches to Mars; I read it as Mars.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: अगर मंगल य चार नंबर का है तो अपने पति के के साथ बैठ के मीठा ना खाएं उसको अपना झूठा मीठा ना दें लड़ाइयां होंगी झगड़े होंगे क्लेश होंगे
says: If Mars is in sign number 4 (Cancer, debilitated), the wife should not sit with her husband eating sweets and should not give him her leftover sweet, otherwise there will be fights, quarrels and strife.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer weakens the matters of the house it occupies; sweets (Moon/Venus things) fire up the debilitation; the tradition applies to a wife with such Mars, with 4th, 7th and 10th the sensitive houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) makes shared sweets a trigger for spousal quarrels in his rule.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 4th (lagna Aries) makes shared sweets a trigger for home strife.
Derived: Mars debilitated in the 10th (lagna Libra) links the sweet-sharing trigger to workplace friction.

ambiguity: 'Mars is sign 4' means Mars sitting in Cancer; this is a remedy, not a pure aspect case.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a food-based don't of his own.

hindi: ये इतनी सूक्ष्म बातें हैं भी ऐसा ही है अगर दृष्टि हैम चार नंबर मीठा तो मंगल मंगल एक्टिवेट हो रहा है चार नंबर नीच एक्टिवेट हो रहा है नीचता एक्टिवेट हो रही है
says: These are very subtle matters: the same holds if Mars only aspects sign 4. Sweet food activates Mars, the debilitated sign 4 gets activated and with it the base nature (neechta) of Mars wakes up.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspecting Cancer from Aries (4th aspect), Capricorn (7th) or Sagittarius (8th) can trigger the same sweet-food effect on the house that Cancer occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) aspecting the 4th house Cancer by its 4th aspect wakes the home-strife effect when sweets are shared.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) aspecting the 7th house Cancer by its 7th aspect ties the trigger to the partner.

ambiguity: The caption in the middle ('भी ऐसा ही है अगर दृष्टि हैम') is garbled; I take it as 'it is the same if it is by aspect'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Says they normally charge 1100 for the remedy but are telling it freely now.

hindi: चार नंबर को एक्टिवेट करने के लिए य बृहस्पति प्लेस कर दो और बृहस्पति का बहुत आदर करता है मंगल गुरु है ये तो बृहस्पति क्या करो पीली चीज मीठी ना हो
says: Remedy for the Mars-in-sign-4 problem: bring Jupiter in, because Mars respects Jupiter greatly as its guru; do this with a yellow item that is not sweet.
ambiguity: 'एक्टिवेट करने के लिए' is probably 'to handle/neutralise' sign 4, but the caption says activate.
classical_check: Classically Jupiter is a friend of Mars and a good remedy; yellow things for Jupiter agrees.

hindi: और सूर्य राजा को लेकर आओ यहां कैसी हो सूर्य बहुत स्लाइट सूर्य नमक है नमकीन
says: Also bring in the Sun, the king, as a second remedy: the Sun stands for salt, so something salty (a little) is used with the yellow item.
ambiguity: 'कैसी हो सूर्य बहुत स्लाइट' is garbled; 'slight' likely means a small amount.
classical_check: Salt is not classically a Sun item (it is more Moon or Venus), so this differs.

hindi: सब पत्नी अपने अपने पति का देख ले हिसाब किताब दारू की बोतल चाहिए यदि मंगल दोष है नहीं तो फिर पेप्सी की बोतल चाहिए
says: Every wife should look at her husband's chart: if there is a Mars dosha the couple needs a bottle of liquor to share, otherwise a bottle of cola will do. It records his claim about the shared-drink remedy and is not advice to drink.
ambiguity: Said half in jest; the shared-drink remedy continues in the next slice.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: वो झूठी करके एक साथ साथ पिए कोई फाइट नहीं है चाय पिए
says: The couple should share the drink, each taking from the other's leftover cup, and there will be no fight; tea can also be used for this.
ambiguity: 'झूठी' means leftover or tasted by another.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: राहु है केतु पिए सिगरेट की बात नहीं करेंगे हम सॉरी केतु नहीं कैंसिल आउट राहु के साथ कॉफी बोलनी थी मेरे को चाय या कॉफी पिए सिगरेट की बात नहीं हो रही
says: He ties Rahu to the stimulant drink habit: he first says Ketu, corrects himself to Rahu and says coffee was meant; tea or coffee is the habit to share, and smoking is not being recommended.
ambiguity: A self-correction mid-sentence: Ketu cancelled, Rahu kept.
classical_check: Rahu as a karaka of stimulants and habits is accepted in modern tradition.

hindi: तो यह आपका बृहस्पति है यह पीली चीज बेसन का नमकीन हलवा ले ले नमकीन बेसन के भुजिया ये झूठी खाएं चिप्स बेसन के चिप्स आते हैं केले के चिप्स आते हैं केले के चिप्स इज गुड आईडिया
says: The Jupiter part of the remedy is yellow food: salty besan halwa, besan bhujia, besan chips or banana chips, eaten by both from each other's leftover; banana chips are a good idea.
classical_check: Yellow food for Jupiter is classical; the 'salty' condition is his.

hindi: ये हमारा बुद्ध देवता है बुद्ध जो है ये ऐसा देवता है जब एक लड़के लड़की के बीच रोमांस चालू होता है और बुध के द्वारा सप्तम भाव इन्फ्लुएंस चाहे लगन से चाहे यहां
says: Turning to Mercury: when romance begins between a boy and a girl and the 7th house is influenced by Mercury, whether from the lagna or from elsewhere, a particular pattern appears (they only talk, described next).
cells_derived_method: Mercury influences the 7th by sitting in it or by aspect from the 1st; in Gemini or Virgo (its own signs) the talk is skilled and constant, in Pisces (debilitated) it is vague and misleading.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a witty, talkative partner and endless conversation.
Derived: Mercury exalted in the 7th (lagna Pisces) gives a precise, analytical partner who talks and plans well.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 7th (lagna Virgo) gives a vague, indecisive partner and talk with no result.

ambiguity: 'यहां' on the board is not clear.
classical_check: Mercury on the 7th as a talkative, youthful partner is classical.

hindi: तो ये दोनों बैठ कर के ना हां जानू और गप गप गप इजराइल में क्या हो रहा है अमेरिका में क्या हो रहा है केजरीवाल कितने वोट से हारा मोदी का अब क्या होगा बातें बातें बातें बातें करना धरना कुछ नहीं सिर्फ बातें
says: Under Mercury's influence the couple sit and just chat, endlessly, about world news and politics, all talk and no action: Mercury gives conversation without commitment.
ambiguity: The politics are only colour for the point.
classical_check: Consistent with Mercury as talk and communication karaka.

hindi: क्योंकि बुद्ध नपुंसक ग्रह है बेसिकली तो इसमें क्या करता है ये बातें करता रहता है
says: The reason is that Mercury is basically a eunuch (neuter) planet, so in a relationship it only keeps on talking and does not drive physical or committed action.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is classically a napumsaka (neuter) graha.

hindi: तो लड़के अक्सर कंफ्यूज रहते हैं यार ये बातें करती रहती है शादी की बात ही नहीं कर रही यार मिलती भी नहीं है यार बोले मैं बातें करते ली तुमसे जानू बात खत्म
says: So boys are often confused: the girl keeps talking on the phone but never brings up marriage and does not even meet; she says 'I enjoy talking to you, sweetheart', and that is where it ends.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; an applied pattern.

gist: Joke about a girl phoning a man called Mangeram, chatting 45 minutes as 'darling', then saying sorry, she meant to call someone else.
Sums up the Mercury situation again: talk, talk, nothing done, matter finished.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर यदि बुध 12 नंबर का हो तो ये डायवोर्स कराता है पति-पत्नी में सेपरेशन दे सकता है खराबी देता है क्योंकि पुसव खराब करता है पति पत्नी के बीच
says: In such a situation, if Mercury is in sign number 12 (Pisces, where it is debilitated) it brings divorce, can give separation between husband and wife and creates damage, because it spoils things between them. One word is garbled.
cells_derived_method: Mercury debilitated in Pisces damages the matters of the house it sits in; for marriage the 7th (and 2nd, 8th) matters most, and for a Virgo lagna Mercury is the lagna lord and the 10th lord and falls in the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 7th (lagna Virgo) is the clearest case: partner relationship breaks or drags.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius) spoils speech and family harmony, which then strains marriage.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 8th (lagna Leo) hides and distorts matters of intimacy and in-laws.

ambiguity: 'पुसव' is garbled; I read it as 'things/relationship'.
classical_check: Mercury debilitated in Pisces is classical; whether it leads to divorce is his claim, and Neecha-bhanga is not mentioned.

hindi: तो एक घसीटा फसा वाला रिश्ता है कि चलते रहो डाइवोर्स भी ले रहे हो नहीं ले रहे हो राम भरोसे है हवा में बातें हो रही है चल रहा है काम कट गया
says: The result is a dragging, stuck relationship that neither continues properly nor ends: they are 'taking a divorce' and 'not taking' it, left to fate and airy talk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे बुध के दोष में सारी बात छोड़ दो 12 नंबर राशि यहां पर है अपने पति या पत्नी को कोई भी हरी चीज हाथ से नहीं देनी ऐसे रख दो वह खुद ले ले
says: For this Mercury dosha with sign 12, drop all other detail: never hand any green thing to your husband or wife directly; place it down so he or she picks it up themselves.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next time stamp.
classical_check: Green is classically Mercury's colour; the hand-to-hand rule is his.

hindi: पत्नी यह भी कर सकती है यद पालक की सब्जी बनाई तो प्लेट फेंक के मारे अपने आप कैच कर ले भाई भाई हरा है इसम दोष के लिए ऐसा नहीं वो अपमान नहीं कर रही वो उसको बचा रही है नहीं तो मरेगा तो ले पकड़
says: The wife can even toss the plate if she has made spinach for him and let him catch it, saying it is green; she is not insulting him but protecting him, as otherwise he would be harmed. A half-joking illustration of the green-item rule.
ambiguity: 'मरेगा' is hyperbole, not a literal death prediction.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: तो कैश रुपया कि किसी किस्म का भी कागज अखबार तक कागज है वो भी हस्बैंड को हैंड टू हैंड नहीं दे बल्कि मैं तो कहता हूं दे ही ना कैश तो दे ही ना अपने आप कामा अकेला खा और हमें भी दे
says: Cash, rupee notes and any paper, even a newspaper, should not be handed to the husband hand-to-hand; better still, do not give cash at all: let him earn and feed himself and also give to the wife.
ambiguity: The last words are a joke about the husband earning and feeding the family.
classical_check: Notes and paper are Mercury things in tradition; the rule is his.

hindi: ये 12 नंबर राशि का कार्यक्रम है
says: He clarifies that these green-item and cash restrictions are the programme only for sign 12 (Pisces) Mercury, not for every Mercury placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: छह नंबर राशि यहां आ जाती है बुध की लाजवाब सिर्फ मीठी बातें नमकीन भी नहीं बहुत सुंदर हिसाब तो बुध उच्च हो जाने से बहुत बढ़िया है
says: When sign 6 (Virgo) comes, Mercury's own and exalted sign, the result is excellent: only sweet talk, not even salty remarks; Mercury being exalted makes it very good.
cells_derived_method: Mercury exalted in Virgo is strong in every house; the area it blesses changes: 7th partner and talk, 2nd speech and wealth, 10th career in communication.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in the 7th (lagna Pisces) gives a kind, skilled, communicative partner.
Derived: Mercury exalted in the 2nd (lagna Leo) gives sweet, convincing speech and earnings from words.
Derived: Mercury exalted in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius) gives a career in analysis, writing or trade.

ambiguity: Mercury is both own and exalted in Virgo; he calls it exalted.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is exalted in Virgo.

hindi: यहां बैठ के दृष्टि दे रहा है वो भी बहुत अच्छा
says: Whether Mercury sits in Virgo or casts its aspect on Virgo, that too is very good; the placement or aspect in sign 6 works well.
cells_derived_method: Mercury aspects the 7th from itself, so it hits Virgo from Pisces; the house that Virgo occupies receives skill, speech and analytical ability.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna with Mercury in the 1st gives a sharp, articulate nature.
Derived: Virgo as the 4th house (lagna Gemini) aspected by Mercury gives a well-organised home and learning.

ambiguity: It is not clear if 'यहां बैठ के दृष्टि' means the aspect from Mercury sitting in the opposite sign.
classical_check: A planet's aspect on a friendly or own sign is generally good; agrees.

hindi: खराब दे रहा है नुकसानदायक रुपया और हरी चीज बिल्कुल ना करें
says: Where Mercury gives the bad result (the sign 12 case) it is harmful, so strictly avoid cash and green things.
ambiguity: The sentence is clipped; I link 'खराब' to the sign 12 Mercury from the earlier lines.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: इसलिए अपने पति से आंवले के तेल से मालिश ना करवाए हरा हो जाएगा और नुकसान करेगा वो प्रॉब्लम होगी
says: Therefore do not have your husband massage you with amla oil, because it counts as green and will do harm; another case of the green-item prohibition for Mercury in sign 12.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: हां सरसों रसों का आप तो सरसों लगाते हो मेरे ख्याल से वो पैर की मालिश करते हो बह की तो ऐसे ही है वो वाला तेल इस्तेमाल
says: In a quick aside he says mustard oil is what is usually applied, thinking of foot massage, so that kind of oil can be used instead of amla oil. The caption is clipped and half-heard.
ambiguity: Part of a cross-talk with the audience; the exact advice is inferred.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: डॉलर भी नहीं दे
says: Dollars, too, should not be handed over to the spouse; foreign currency counts as cash and green paper in the same Mercury sign 12 restriction.
classical_check: Not classical.

gist: Quips that dollars are meant for 'here' and complains about dealing with greedy people, asking how long it will go on.
Jokes about parents who say they are unsettled since their son started earning dollars, waiting for 'that day' that never comes.

hindi: अब हमारे पास आता है गुरु ग्रह बृहस्पति बृहस्पति गुरु है गुरु कहते है ना भाई बड़ी गुरु चीज हो तुम यानी कि यार खोपड़ी से ब्रेन से ही रॉकेट बना देते हो सब कुछ
says: Moving to Jupiter: Jupiter is guru, which also means heavy or weighty; a person called 'guru' is one who builds a rocket from the brain alone, so Jupiter stands for weight of intellect and knowledge.
classical_check: Jupiter as guru and intellect is classical; the pun on 'heavy' is his.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति लड़की की कुंडली में पति का सूचक है शुक्र लड़के की कुंडली में पत्नी के लिए सूचक है
says: Jupiter is the indicator of the husband in a girl's chart, and Venus is the indicator of the wife in a boy's chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the husband karaka for women, Venus the wife karaka for men.

hindi: यानी लड़की की शादी देखनी है तो हमें बृहस्पति से मतलब है और लड़के की देखनी हो तो शुक्र से मतलब है
says: So to judge a girl's marriage he looks at Jupiter, and to judge a boy's marriage he looks at Venus; this is his working rule for choosing the marriage karaka by gender.
classical_check: Agrees with classical karaka selection for marriage.

gist: Lecture plan: the main discussion is for women, the man's case will follow separately, though a universal law will be given first.

hindi: लॉ यह है कि बृहस्पति की दृष्टि होती है पहली पांचवी सातवी और नौवी
says: The universal law he states is that Jupiter aspects the 1st, 5th, 7th and 9th, counted from itself; the 1st means its own place plus the classical 5th, 7th and 9th aspects.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's aspect houses from its seat are 5, 7 and 9 (and its own house); the sign hit depends on where Jupiter sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer) aspects Scorpio (5th), Capricorn (7th) and Pisces (9th).
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) aspects Aquarius (11th), Aries (1st) and Gemini (3rd).
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) aspects Cancer (1st), Virgo (3rd) and Scorpio (5th) by its 5th, 7th and 9th aspects.

ambiguity: 'पहली' as an aspect is nonstandard; it likely means the planet's own house.
classical_check: Classical Jupiter aspects are 5th, 7th and 9th; adding the 1st differs unless it means conjunction.

gist: Says that reading aspects chart by chart is intricate, and that we are learning life dimensions that must be accepted in one's mindset and in society, because it is not one's fault.

hindi: यह पहला गर है यह पांचवा है और यह नौवा यह त्रिकोण है यह जो ट्रायंगल है यही मुख्य धारा है सातवें घर पर इसकी दृष्टि है ही है
says: He marks the 1st, 5th and 9th as a triangle (trikona) and calls it the main stream, and says the 7th house is always under Jupiter's aspect in this picture.
cells_derived_method: The trine houses 1, 5, 9 are the Jupiter-friendly houses; Jupiter in any of them aspects the other two trines; for the 7th to be aspected Jupiter must be in the 1st, 3rd or 11th, so the 'always aspected' remark is a loose summary.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 1st in Gemini (lagna Gemini) aspects the 5th Libra, 7th Sagittarius and 9th Aquarius.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th (lagna Leo) aspects the 9th Aries, 11th Gemini and 1st Leo.

ambiguity: 'गर' is a garble of 'घर'. The claim that the 7th is always aspected does not hold from every trine position.
classical_check: Trikona as the best houses is classical; the 7th being aspected from all three is not strictly true.

hindi: तो अगर बृहस्पति ग्रह की इन चारों जगह में बैठना है तो आपकी जन्मपत्री के अंदर पक्की बात है कि असफल अफेयर कराएगा एक असफल फेयर कराएगा ही कराएगा
says: If Jupiter sits in any of these four places (1st, 5th, 7th, 9th) in the girl's birth chart, he says it is certain Jupiter will give a failed love affair, at least one, without fail. A strong claim stated as certain; treat as his claim only.
cells_derived_method: Sign changes the flavour: Jupiter exalted or own sign (Cancer, Sagittarius, Pisces) in these houses gives a sincere but failed attachment; Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn gives a harsher, more disappointing one; the 5th is the love-affair house so effect is most direct there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th (lagna Leo): a sincere, idealistic love affair that does not end in marriage, by his rule.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 7th (lagna Cancer): the affair or partner disappoints and an unrealistic expectation shows.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 9th (lagna Cancer): a spiritual or distant love that does not become a marriage.

ambiguity: He says 'sitting in these four places' but the exact houses are inferred from the 1st, 5th, 9th triangle plus the 7th. Gender (girl's chart) is inferred from context.
classical_check: Differs strongly: classically Jupiter in 1, 5, 7 or 9 is a benefic placement; Jupiter in the 7th is not a standard cause of failed affairs.

gist: Pointing at the board: Jupiter sitting here has its aspect here, sitting there has its aspect there; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.

hindi: बैठा है तो भी दृष्टि है यहां तो बैठा ही है तो बात पक्की पर जब बैठा है तो हो सकता फेर ना ही कराए
says: Continuing the board work on Jupiter: wherever Jupiter sits it also has its aspects on other places; if it sits in the key place the result is certain, but from some seats it may not give a failed affair after all. The exact seats are not audible.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's aspects from its seat fall on the 5th, 7th and 9th houses from itself, so the seat decides which of the 1, 5, 7, 9 love-marriage houses get touched.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 1st (lagna Pisces) aspects the 5th Cancer, 7th Virgo and 9th Scorpio, touching both love and partnership houses.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 3rd (lagna Gemini) aspects the 7th Sagittarius by its 5th aspect but does not sit in any of the four houses.

ambiguity: He points at board positions that the caption does not carry; the sentence is hedged ('may not give') and hard to pin down.
classical_check: Jupiter's 5th, 7th, 9th aspects are classical; the 'may or may not' point is his own.

hindi: लेकिन अगर यहां बैठा है तो लगन पर दृष्टि और यहां बैठा भी लगन पे है तो भी अफेयर कराएगा क्योंकि पंचम भाव भी प्रेम का है
says: If Jupiter sits in the 7th it aspects the lagna, and if it sits in the lagna itself it still gives an affair, because from the lagna it reaches the 5th house, which is also the house of love.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in the 1st aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th; Jupiter in the 7th aspects the 11th, 1st and 3rd; so each seat links the lagna to the love-house through aspect. The sign of the 5th or the 1st changes the type of love.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 1st (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th Scorpio, giving an intense, idealistic love affair by his rule.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 7th (lagna Gemini) aspects the lagna Gemini by its 7th aspect, giving a love attachment that defines the person's identity.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 1st (lagna Sagittarius) aspects the 5th Aries, linking the lagna with a bold, direct love affair.

ambiguity: 'यहां' on the board is read as the 7th; the 5th is named in the sentence.
classical_check: The 5th house as the house of love affairs is classical; the claim that Jupiter in these houses causes affairs is his own.

hindi: अब जितने लव मैरिज होती है और इंटरकास्ट होती है सारा बृहस्पति के कारण से होती है बृहस्पति लव मैरिज कराता है इंटरकास्ट मैरिज कराता है
says: All love marriages and inter-caste marriages happen because of Jupiter, he claims; Jupiter is the planet that produces love marriage and inter-caste marriage.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's link to the 5th and 7th houses (by seat or aspect) is the trigger; in fire signs the love marriage is bold and visible, in water signs emotional, in earth signs it comes with family friction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th (lagna Leo) is a typical love-marriage placement in his rule.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 7th (lagna Virgo) points to a partner chosen out of sympathy or idealism, possibly across community lines.

ambiguity: 'सारा' (all) is an overstatement; no counts.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts attach love marriage to Venus, Rahu and the 5th-7th links, and Jupiter is normally a conservative planet.

hindi: जिस जिसके बृहस्पति का यह संयोग है कुंडली में उसके अनसक्सेसफुल अफेयर होते हैं मजे की बात एक अनसक्सेसफुल अफेयर तो कराएगा ही फिर चाहे लव मैरिज करा दे
says: Anyone whose chart has this Jupiter combination has unsuccessful affairs, and at least one failed affair is guaranteed first, even if Jupiter later arranges a love marriage.
cells_derived_method: The failed-affair effect sits in the early life phase; the sign of Jupiter's house sets how it ends: in fire signs a break through pride, in water signs through emotion, in earth signs through family or status obstacles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 7th in Aries (lagna Libra) gives a sudden, passionate first affair that ends abruptly.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) gives a first affair that fails through insecurity or status issues.

ambiguity: 'यह संयोग' refers to the Jupiter seats in 1, 5, 7, 9 from the previous slice.
classical_check: Not classical; contradicts the normal benefic reading of Jupiter in these houses.

hindi: उस लव मैरिज में शनि बाधा है शनि का रोल यह है कि मैं चॉइस की लड़की से होने नहीं दूंगा तो यहां शनि को बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट देखना पड़ता है
says: In such a love marriage Saturn is the obstacle, because its role is to say 'I will not let it happen with the girl of your choice', so Saturn has to be examined very carefully in these charts.
cells_derived_method: Saturn blocks the chosen partner when it sits in or aspects the 5th or 7th (Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th, 10th from itself); its sign decides how: exalted in Libra it delays but finally holds firm, debilitated in Aries it causes frustration.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the 7th (lagna Aries) is a strong block: marriage is delayed and the partner of choice is denied, but a stable one follows.
Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 5th (lagna Libra) holds back the love affair and restricts the choice of partner.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 10th Aries (lagna Cancer) aspects the 7th house Capricorn by its 10th aspect, blocking the choice through career or status trouble.
