classical_check: Saturn as delaying and obstructing love marriage in the 5th and 7th is classical; agrees.

gist: Joke story of a lover who loved his Sohni so much he even changed his name to Mahiwal Khanna, yet never got her.

hindi: फिर वो फिल्म देखता है सोनी महिवाल फिर से पता चलता ले ये तो मिले ही नहीं थे इसलिए आपकी जिंदगी में सोनी महिवाल हीर रांझा की कहानी चलेगी अगर आपके बृहस्पति की यहां पर बैठा वट है या यहां यहां दृष्टियां है
says: After watching the Sohni-Mahiwal film he realises they never united; so a Sohni-Mahiwal or Heer-Ranjha story, a tragic love that does not end in union, will run in your life if Jupiter sits in the marked places or aspects them.
cells_derived_method: Same seats as before: Jupiter in or aspecting 1, 5, 7, 9; the tragic love is felt most when it is the 5th or 7th house that is touched.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio) gives a deeply romantic, spiritual love that does not end in union.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries) gives a love tied to ideals or a distant place that stays unfulfilled.

ambiguity: The caption garbles the seats ('बैठा वट है'); the sentence continues into the next slice with 'दृष्टियां है'.
classical_check: Not classical.

hindi: इसलिए आपके बच्चे आप स्वयं जब जब भटक जाते हैं जीवन में तो आपको यह देखना है कि आपने ऐसे कौन से कर्मा करने शुरू कर दिए ज जुपिटर डिस्टर्ब हो गया है
says: Whenever you or your children go astray in life, check what kind of karma you started that has disturbed Jupiter; a person going off-track signals a disturbed Jupiter caused by one's own actions.
ambiguity: The opening words ('इसलिए आपके बच्चे') are loose; he links the children to the 5th and Jupiter.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of children and dharma is classical; the karma-first advice is his.

hindi: बृहस्पति सत्य का देवता है शुक्र झूठ शुक्र राग रंग मस्ती
says: Jupiter is the god of truth, while Venus stands for falsehood and for pleasure, colour and fun; the two are opposite poles of honest versus indulgent.
ambiguity: Calling Venus 'falsehood' is his blunt shorthand, not a classical term.
classical_check: Jupiter as dharma and truth is classical; Venus as pleasure is classical; 'lies' is his own.

hindi: जब जब बृहस्पति के अंतर्गत झूठ आ गया तो बृहस्पति भटका के खराब कर देता है और गृहस्थ में आग लगा देता है
says: Whenever untruth enters under Jupiter, Jupiter misleads and ruins the person and sets the household on fire; a lying husband or a lying lapse in dharma damages the home.
ambiguity: 'अंतर्गत' means 'within the domain of Jupiter'.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; a moral extension of Jupiter's karakatva.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन है पुरुष यदि स्त्री में झूठ आ गया तो शुक्र बृहस्पति को नष्ट करता है उसका पति भी उसे छोड़ देता है
says: Jupiter stands for the male; if falsehood enters the woman, her Venus destroys Jupiter, and her husband leaves her.
ambiguity: The mechanism of 'Venus destroys Jupiter' is not described in chart terms.
classical_check: Silent; Venus and Jupiter are classically enemies, so a conflict reading is plausible.

hindi: अब बड़ी मजे की बात बृहस्पति है खसम खसम आ रहा था खसम गलती नहीं हुई जानबूझ के बोला था भाई जानबूझ के बोला था गलती से नहीं बोला था बृहस्पति है खसम शुक्र है सौंदर्य प्रेम
says: He says, with a deliberate slang word for husband (khasam), that Jupiter is the husband figure and Venus is beauty and love; he stresses the word was used on purpose.
ambiguity: The slang word is a joke register; the content is Jupiter=husband, Venus=beauty and love.
classical_check: Jupiter as husband karaka for women and Venus as love and beauty are classical.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति महाराज है शुक्र सौंदर्य अब होता क्या है बृहस्पति पति हो गया और पत्नी हो गई शुक्र
says: He sets up the couple model: Jupiter plays the husband and Venus plays the wife, and then asks what happens when one of them has a fault; the next lines work through it.
ambiguity: A setup sentence; the result follows in the next slice.
classical_check: Not a classical pairing for both genders; it uses Jupiter for the husband (female chart) and Venus for the wife (male chart) at once.

hindi: बृहस्पति में दोष आया बृहस्पति सत्य का देवता है झूठ बोलना शुरू हो गया किसी तरह से पति का तो वह खत्म हो गया
says: If a flaw comes into Jupiter, the husband, and he starts lying in some way, then that Jupiter role is finished: the husband's standing as truth-holder and guru in the marriage ends.
ambiguity: 'खत्म हो गया' means his Jupiter quality ends, not the marriage itself.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: अब शुक्र जो है पत्नी वह फिर नहीं छोड़ रही मजे की बात देखि बृहस्पति ज्ञान का देवता है साधु है शुक्र राग रंग का
says: Yet Venus, the wife, does not leave him; Jupiter is the god of knowledge and a sage, whereas Venus belongs to worldly colour and attachment, so she stays attached when he errs.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति पति ने कमीनापन किया भटका पत्नी साधु नहीं बन रही है पत्नी उसे फिर क्षमा करती है चाहे लड़ती है जो मर्जी करती है चाहे उसकी जिंदगी कहती है भैया भैया नहीं सॉरी प कसम तेरे को यहीं पर मैं मनाऊंगी तेरी रसम तो वो छोड़ती नहीं है उसे
says: When the Jupiter-husband misbehaves and strays, the Venus-wife does not turn ascetic; she may fight but forgives him again and holds on, not giving up the bond; the tail of the sentence is garbled.
ambiguity: The last clause is noisy and part colloquial pleading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए अक्सर बात आती कि पत्नी ने पति को माफ कर दिया अच्छा पति पत्नी को माफ नहीं कर रहा
says: Hence it is common to see the wife forgive the husband while the husband does not forgive the wife; an observed asymmetry he explains by Venus versus Jupiter nature.
ambiguity: 'अक्सर' is not quantified.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यदि शुक्र के अंदर ऐसी स्थिति बन गई तो शुक्र तो राग रंगे पत्नी भटक गई साधु बन जाता पुरुष
says: If the same flaw arises on the Venus side, meaning the wife strays into pleasures, then the man (Jupiter) turns into a sage, withdraws and renounces instead of staying.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Remarks that many great babas and big saints, whom he will not name, lie in jail over women.
Says in some of those cases a bad case was filed or an allegation was made, and in some they truly fell into dirt; the problem is common.

hindi: तो स्त्री माफ करती ही है अब वो माफ करती कि नहीं उसके शुक्र का दोष ही नहीं कि वो त्याग दे और बृहस्पति का है कि त्याग दिया तो अक्सर ऐसी स्थिति बनती है
says: A woman does forgive, and whether she forgives or not is not Venus's fault; renouncing is Jupiter's nature, not Venus's, so the usual situation is that the husband abandons rather than the wife.
ambiguity: The first clause is loose; I read the main point as 'Venus holds, Jupiter renounces'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पिटे हुए बृहस्पति या बृहस्पति की दृष्टि वाले सारे के सारे पुरुष यही रोते रहते हैं गर्लफ्रेंड मेरा कहना नहीं मान रही अब वो क्या कर रहे हैं भीख मांग रहे हैं वो लड़की उनको लात मार देती है
says: Men with a beaten (afflicted) Jupiter, or with Jupiter's aspect on the love places, keep complaining that the girlfriend does not listen, beg for her attention, and she rejects them harshly.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Jupiter means debilitated in Capricorn, with Rahu or Saturn, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th; in a man's chart the love houses 5th and 7th are the places where the beg-and-reject pattern shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 7th (lagna Cancer) in a man's chart gives a partner who does not respect or listen to him.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius), an unsettled, talkative Jupiter, gives a man who chases uncertain love.

ambiguity: 'पिटे हुए' (beaten) is not defined as a particular affliction.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: A generalisation that a woman never respects a man who presses her feet; a social opinion with no chart rule.
Anticipates listeners saying 'this is a one-sided story, we are being told to press feet', and says pressing or not pressing is fine.
Opinion that a woman does not see such a man as a man, and wants a masculine, spirited, lion-like partner, not just a handsome one.
Opinion that a woman loves the man who dominates her and would enjoy even being carried off by a proud, kingly man; he notes the words are wrong.

hindi: ये जितने ऐसे प्रकार के विवाह है वो बृहस्पति द्वारा मान्य
says: All such forms of marriage, including those of forceful abduction, are accepted or sanctioned by Jupiter; Jupiter as the dharma planet recognises the traditional forms of marriage.
ambiguity: Reads as a reference to the classical forms of marriage such as Rakshasa; 'accepted' is his word and not endorsement of forced marriage.
classical_check: Classical dharma texts list eight forms of marriage including abduction types; Jupiter as the dharma karaka is consistent.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहां है स्वाधिष्ठान इसी के पास प्रजनन क्षमता है यही संतान देता है यही ज्ञानी संतान देता है यही साइंटिस्ट देता है इसी के पास सारा हिसाब है
says: Jupiter's place in the body is the swadhisthana chakra; it holds fertility and gives children, wise children and scientist children, and holds the whole account of progeny.
ambiguity: This differs from his earlier statement that the swadhisthana chakra, just below the navel, is where anger and conflict sit; he now assigns the same chakra to Jupiter.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of children is classical; chakra assignment is yogic and his own, and it conflicts with the earlier line.

hindi: अब एक बड़ी विचित्र स्थिति होती है हमारे घर के अंदर नॉर्थ और ईस्ट की बेल्ट एक ऐसी बेल्ट है नॉर्थ ईस्टर्न बेल्ट यह बहुत ही इंपॉर्टेंट है नॉर्थ ईस्ट यह बेल्ट यह बृहस्पति का स्थान होता है
says: Vastu link: the north-east belt of the home is very important, and it is Jupiter's place in the house.
classical_check: Agrees with classical vastu: the north-east (Ishanya) belongs to Jupiter.

hindi: जैसे शनि का स्थान हमारा हमने कह दिया जी वेस्ट है ऐसे नॉर्थ वेस्ट होता है यह चंद्रमा का है इस प्रकार बृहस्पति का नॉर्थ ईस्ट होता है आपके घर का
says: Direction map: Saturn's place is the west, the north-west is the Moon's, and likewise Jupiter's is the north-east of your home.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical vastu directions: west Saturn, north-west Moon, north-east Jupiter.

hindi: बृहस्पति जहां आप रहते हैं कुंडली में चाहे कैसे मर्जी ग्रह हो लेकिन बृहस्पति है जो चलाएगा निभाएगा जो पति-पत्नी को जोड़ के रखेगा अन्यथा तोड़ देगा अगर बृहस्पति के अंदर दोष आ गया
says: However the other planets sit in the chart, it is Jupiter, the north-east of the house where you live, that runs and sustains the marriage, keeping husband and wife together, or breaking them apart if Jupiter gets a fault.
ambiguity: Mixes chart Jupiter and the house's north-east as one thing.
classical_check: Jupiter as marriage sustainer for a woman is classical; making the house direction override the chart is his.

hindi: यानी नॉर्थ ईस्टर्न बेल्ट के अंदर आपके घर के अंदर टॉयलेट आ गया या किचन आ गई तो सारे ग्रह जहां मर्जी जोसे मर्जी जो मर्जी करते हो
says: If a toilet or kitchen falls in the north-east belt of the house, then it does not matter where the other planets are or what they do in the chart, because the north-east fault outweighs them.
ambiguity: The sentence trails across the time stamp and implies the damage to Jupiter; the consequence is spelled out later.
classical_check: Vastu texts also warn against a toilet or kitchen in the north-east, so this agrees; overriding the birth chart is his addition.

hindi: बृहस्पति एक ऐसा ग्रह है जो खुद को भी नष्ट नहीं करता नीच का होके स्थान खा जाता है
says: Jupiter is a planet that does not destroy itself, but even when debilitated it eats up the place it sits in, meaning it damages the matters of that house.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn harms the house it occupies; in the 5th it hurts children and learning, in the 7th the spouse, in the 9th fortune and dharma.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 5th (lagna Virgo) eats into children and education.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 7th (lagna Cancer) eats into the partner and marriage.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th (lagna Taurus) eats into fortune, guru and father matters.

ambiguity: 'Does not destroy itself' is unclear: it probably means Jupiter stays intact but harms the house.
classical_check: Matches the classical idea that a karaka in the bhava it signifies harms it (karako bhava nashaya), and that debilitation weakens; consistent with his earlier debilitation rule.

hindi: यह जहां बैठ जाता है कुंडली में कहता है मेरी चलेगी भाई किसी की नहीं सुनता है ये क्योंकि ये गुरु है
says: Wherever Jupiter sits in the chart it says 'my will will run' and listens to nobody, because it is the guru; it takes charge of that house.
cells_derived_method: The house where Jupiter sits becomes self-willed and expansive: in the 7th the partner dominates, in the 4th home runs by one's own rule, in the 10th authority is unquestioned.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives a partner who advises and leads, unchallenged.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 10th (lagna Pisces) gives a career where the native's word is final.

classical_check: Silent as a rule; a personality reading of Jupiter as dominant teacher.

gist: Says a guru's seemingly wrong words often carry deep knowledge that you cannot read, as a signal.
Explains that 'follow the guru' is the idea, and that the gurudwara is the door of the guru, so go there and follow even if it looks like nonsense.
Story of a saint (Lahiri Mahasaya, Yukteshwar Giri or Mahata Baba, he is unsure) who struck his disciple with a stick near a fire to avert a death by burning.
Says you cannot know what a guru is doing; then begins asking who is the right guru.
Caption is garbled ('all are ... suppose, are you a disciple'); the point is that when you are a good disciple you bring out the guru in him.

hindi: इसीलिए शब्द कहे गए हैं ये बड़े सूचक है कि बेटा पति ही तुम्हारा गुरु है पति ही परमेश्वर है यह बृहस्पति है
says: That is why the traditional sayings tell a daughter that the husband is your guru and your god: the husband is Jupiter in a woman's chart.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition of Jupiter as the husband karaka for women.

gist: Joke that it does not mean stuffing him with straw, making him a stone idol and nailing him in the north-east to worship, while neither letting him live nor die.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति के टॉयलेट या किचन यहां हो जाने से आपकी गृहस्थ खराब होएगा ही पति-पत्नी लड़ेंगे ही
says: So with a toilet or kitchen in Jupiter's place, the north-east, your married household is bound to be spoiled and the husband and wife will certainly fight.
ambiguity: 'ही' (certainly) is his emphasis, not a measured rate.
classical_check: Vastu lore also holds that a toilet or kitchen in the north-east harms family harmony; agrees.

hindi: नॉर्थ ईस्ट में आपने मंदिर बना लिया और मंदिर बना के वहां आप धूप बत्ती कर रहे टना टन टना टना टन ओम गणम फम छाम डंग हो गया झगड़े शुरू घर में किस बात पर पति रुष्ट रहेगा झल्ला रहेगा भह भह करता रहेगा चिल्लाता रहेगा पत्नी कहेगी मुझे
says: Even if you build a temple in the north-east and do incense and bell worship there, quarrels start at home: the husband stays irritable, snaps and shouts, and the wife complains; a puja corner in the north-east is claimed to have the same harmful effect on Jupiter. The sentence is cut off.
ambiguity: Cut at the end of the slice; the wife's complaint is not completed. It is unclear if the incense or the temple itself is the cause.
classical_check: Differs: classical vastu treats the north-east as the ideal place for a puja room.

gist: Garbled audience remark about how to keep this man happy; no astrology content.

hindi: यह वो जो बृहस्पति का मंदिर लगा के रखा है वहां पर आपने बृहस्पति यह नहीं कह रहा कि आप मूर्ति पूजा करो यह ज्ञान का देवता है
says: Jupiter's place is where people put the home temple, but he says Jupiter is not asking for idol worship; Jupiter is the deity of knowledge, so the Jupiter area is about taking in wisdom, not about a statue.
ambiguity: The first words of the sentence are garbled, so which place or direction he means by the 'Jupiter temple' is inferred from the later North-East talk.
classical_check: Jupiter as guru and knowledge karaka agrees with Parashara; the claim that Jupiter does not ask for idol worship is his own view, as classical remedies do include Jupiter puja.

hindi: यह कहता है कि आपको ज्ञान लेना है अपने अंदर अंतर मन में आपने इको जो करी वही वेस्ट से मेनिफेस्ट होकर आपके पास प्रतिध्वनि हो रही है
says: Jupiter's message is to take knowledge inward into the subconscious; whatever you send out as an echo comes back manifested from the west direction as a returning sound. So Jupiter works like an echo of your own inner state.
ambiguity: 'West' (वेस्ट) may be the direction west or the English word 'waste'; the next sentence about mountains and echo suggests direction.
classical_check: Silent; the echo and manifestation idea is modern New-Age framing, not found in classical texts.

hindi: आप शब्दों से बोल रहे हैं व्यर्थ है आपको अंतर मन से मेनिफेस्ट करना है चिजी को भी वह भी आपका वेस्ट डायरेक्शन देगा यानी कि पहाड़ों का इलाका जहां से इको गुंजायमान हो जाए
says: Speaking wishes in words is useless; things must be manifested from the inner mind. He ties this to a direction (heard as west) described as a mountain-like area where an echo rings out, so the Jupiter-linked space should be high, open and resonant.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; 'चिजी' is unclear and the direction word 'वेस्ट' may be a misheard 'waste' or 'vast'. Meaning of the mountain-echo image is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; classical Vastu gives Jupiter the North-East, and a west-for-Jupiter claim would differ, if that is what he said.

hindi: इसलिए यह आपको विशेष ध्यान रखना है घर में मंदिर नॉर्थ ईस्ट में नहीं होना चाहिए घर में मंदिर होना ही नहीं चाहिए
says: Special care for Jupiter: he says the home temple should not be in the North-East, and goes further that a home should have no temple at all; worship space is better outside the house.
ambiguity: Unclear whether 'no temple at all' is a hard rule or a strong opinion given in the same breath.
classical_check: Differs from classical Vastu, which places the puja room in the North-East (Ishan); Parashari Jyotish is silent on Vastu.

hindi: किचन तो क्या कर बंद कर दो उठा दो वहा किचन अप्लायंस तक मत रखना बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब रहेगा
says: If a kitchen sits in the North-East, shut it and shift it; do not even keep kitchen appliances there, because Jupiter's area stays disturbed.
ambiguity: The caption starts mid-phrase ('थ में किचन' later); North-East is taken from the previous sentence and the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Vastu that a kitchen in the North-East (Ishan) is a fault; Jyotish texts are silent.

hindi: आप किचन लगा रहे अग्नि है मंगल पति पत्नी को बेड पर लड़ाई होगी बेड पर उनके बीच संबंध खत्म या पति भाग जाएगा बाहर
says: Putting a kitchen in Jupiter's North-East puts fire, which is Mars, in the place of Jupiter; he says the couple will fight on the bed, intimacy between them ends, or the husband will run off outside.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk ('या पत्नी'); here it only reads that the husband runs away.
classical_check: Fire as Mars-linked is classical; the kitchen-in-North-East marriage result is a Vastu claim not found in Parashara.

hindi: पत्नी फिर कहेंगे तूने अफेर कर लिया यह बड़ी गहरी बात है फिर दोष देते रहो किसी को भी तुमने पाप किया
says: Completing the same warning, either spouse may stray, and then each blames the other for the affair and for sin; he calls it a deep point that the real cause was the space, not the person.
ambiguity: 'पत्नी' at the start continues the earlier sentence, so it means the wife may also leave.
classical_check: Silent; this is a Vastu-causal claim, not a classical Jyotish rule.

gist: Audience says yes and he agrees that it goes wrong in homes; a conversational reply.
He claims homes have temples so that Hindus cannot gather at one outside temple; a social opinion.
If people met at a temple they would form a gathering; they fight now, Sharma ji against Verma ji, so they stay apart.

hindi: सब एक जत मंदिर में जाकर मिल रहे हैं मिलने से मिरर नूरन जन सुप्रीम कॉन्शसनेस के पास वहां तो एकजुट होंगे आपस में लड़ेंगे लेकिन साथ इसलिए बाहर मंदिर पर जाओ
says: Remedy: go to a public temple outside instead of keeping one at home, because people meeting there come together before supreme consciousness; they may quarrel but will stay together.
ambiguity: Words 'मिरर नूरन जन' are garbled; the sense of gathering before the supreme is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jupiter remedies include temple visits and guru worship, so going to a public temple is consistent.

gist: A listener says he does not want to move his temple; he replies keep it here and it is finished.
Asks why the word Bhagwan and puja-path are needed, and says to drop the word Bhagwan and keep Ishwar; a philosophy aside.

hindi: पेरेंट्स नहीं मानेंगे उनसे अपने मानसिक धागा तोड़ दो सेवा करो ड्यूटी निभाओ नए पेरेंट्स गोद
says: If parents will not agree to shifting the temple, he advises cutting the mental thread of dependence on them while still serving them and doing duty; he even says adopt new parents (continues next chunk).
ambiguity: Linking this to Jupiter as the guru and elder karaka is inferred; he does not name Jupiter here.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter-guru as the father-like authority is classical but detachment from parents is his own teaching.

hindi: लो यह बहुत गहरी बातें हैं ऐसे ही कोई उठा नहीं है यह सारे भगवान जो उठे इन्होने अपने पेरेंट्स को पूछा है
says: Finishing the 'adopt new parents' line, he says this is deep and that every great figure who rose did so by questioning the authority of their own parents, not by simple obedience.
ambiguity: 'पूछा है' may mean questioned or left; meaning is taken from the Ram example that follows.
classical_check: Silent; philosophical opinion, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Ram left Dashrath; Dashrath told him to take bow and arrow and rule, and Bharat would do nothing; a Ramayana illustration.
A man rises only by leaving the parental 'hari om' fuss; parents bind both ways with do and do-not duality, as Buddha and Krishna broke it.

hindi: हम नहीं कर पा रहे मेडिटेशन तो हो सकती है नॉर्थ ईस्ट मेडिटेशन नॉर्थ ईस्ट में ही करनी है वो बहुत अच्छा एरिया है करो वो बैठ के चुप कुछ नहीं करने का एरिया है
says: If you cannot manage meditation, the North-East is the place: meditation should be done in the North-East only, a very good area meant for sitting quietly and doing nothing, not for cooking or toilet use.
ambiguity: He earlier said no temple in the North-East; here he allows meditation there, so the area is kept for silent sitting, not a deity shrine.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Vastu that the North-East is best for meditation and prayer.

gist: He tells a listener it is done, fine, your Jupiter is saved; a conversational reply.

hindi: आपके नॉर्थ ईस्ट के टॉयलेट किचन ये आपको ध्यान देना है ये मोस्ट इंपॉर्टेंट है और ये अनसक्सेसफुल अफेयर देगा ही देगा
says: Watch for a toilet or kitchen in the North-East; this is most important, and he says it will surely produce an unsuccessful love affair, since Jupiter's space is fouled.
ambiguity: Whether the failed affair refers to the resident's own life or to any grown family member is not clear.
classical_check: Classical Vastu forbids toilet and kitchen in the North-East, but the unsuccessful-affair result is his own addition.

gist: Repeats that it will give an unsuccessful affair for sure; a repetition of the previous point.

hindi: इसलिए अगर एक अनसक्सेसफुल अफेयर हुआ है आपका दिल टूटा है तो परमात्मा की कृपा मानो आपकी यह सही जगह विवाह कराएगा
says: If you have had an unsuccessful affair and a broken heart, count it as God's grace, because it will lead you to marriage at the right place.
ambiguity: This is consolation advice, not a chart rule; no planet or house is named.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives this reassurance.

hindi: अनसक्सेसफुल अफेयर होही इसी लिए रहा है कहीं ना कहीं झूठ आ गया रिश्ते के अंदर पति-पत्नी के रिश्ते में झूठ आ जाने से ऐसा हो जाता है
says: A failed affair happens because falsehood has entered the relationship somewhere; lying inside a couple's bond is what produces such breaks.
ambiguity: The cause is moral (lies), not an astrological placement; the link to Jupiter as truth karaka is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as dharma and truth is classical but this specific causal claim is not.

hindi: पर टेंशन का विषय यह है कि प्रेम ना खराब हो इसमें ध्यान रखना इस बात का है कि बृहस्पति के पास ही प्रजनन की क्षमता है
says: The worry is that love should not spoil, and the point to remember is that only Jupiter holds the capacity for procreation; so Jupiter is the planet of reproductive power.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the putra (children) karaka; calling it the only planet of reproductive capacity is stronger than classical texts.

hindi: तो पुरुष और स्त्री लंबे टाइम लड़ाई करेंगे तो पुरुष की पत्नी के साथ सेक्सुअल क्षमता डेड हो जाएगी
says: Because Jupiter governs procreation, if a couple fights for a long time he says the man's sexual capacity with his wife dies off. This is his claim about Jupiter damaged by conflict, not a medical statement and not to be used as diagnosis.
ambiguity: No chart condition is given; he speaks generally of long conflict.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Jupiter and Venus to marital and sexual life but give no such rule.

hindi: और अगर वह संत बना हुआ है कि नहीं मैं बाहर कहीं नहीं जाऊंगा तो उसका जीवन पत्नी के साथ एक साधु की तरह बीतना शुरू हो जाएगा
says: If the man stays a saint and refuses to go outside, his life with his wife slides into that of a monk, with no marital intimacy.
ambiguity: It follows from the previous point on dead capacity; the sentence is a consequence, not a separate planetary rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Men often stray; he jokes that men will say this gives an escape route since he also speaks as a man.

hindi: पुरुष की समस्या यह बन जाती है कि उसकी बॉडी में स्पर्म बनने बंद ही नहीं होते ये कीड़े तंग करते हैं आदमी भटक जाता है बाहर यह सबसे बड़ा क्लेश है
says: A man's body keeps producing sperm without stopping, which he says troubles him and pushes him to stray outside, making this the biggest source of strife. A physical claim by the speaker, not medical advice.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; it is a biological explanation of straying.
classical_check: Silent; not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: और स्त्री भी कहती है कब तक जान मारे इसका यही काम रह गया है यह वासना है ये शुक्र पे बात होगी हमारी
says: The woman complains that he keeps pressing her and that this is only lust; he says lust belongs to Venus and will be taken up when Venus is discussed.
ambiguity: The sentence begins at the end of the previous chunk ('और स्त्री भी').
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the karaka of desire and sexual life.

hindi: इसलिए जुपिटर के फॉल्स अफेयर से कोई टेंशन नहीं अगर जुपिटर वक्री हो गया है
says: He says there is no tension about a false affair from Jupiter, and then turns to the case where Jupiter has gone retrograde; the sentence is cut and the 'no tension' part is hard to place.
ambiguity: 'फॉल्स अफेयर' may be a mishearing; it can mean a false affair or just a fall in the relation. The reading is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो आपको शादी के बाद पति-पत्नी में जवानी भैस कराएगा ही कराएगा
says: A retrograde Jupiter, he says, will surely bring a clash between husband and wife after marriage; the word 'जवानी भैस' is garbled, but the sense is strife in the couple.
ambiguity: 'जवानी भैस' is unclear; could be a garbled word for quarrel or for boredom. The sense of marital friction is inferred.
classical_check: Retrograde Jupiter giving marital trouble is not stated by Parashara, who treats vakri planets as strong; this is a later or personal claim.

hindi: जिस लड़की के सातवें घर के अंदर बृहस्पति लड़की क्या लड़के के भी सातवें घर में बृहस्पति बैठा है नी राशि फल तो उस राशि के हिसाब से चलेगा
says: For a girl, or equally a boy, with Jupiter in the seventh house, the result follows the sign Jupiter occupies; the sign decides how Jupiter's spouse results turn out.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in the 7th gives the spouse theme; the sign changes its strength and flavour. Exalted Cancer or own Sagittarius and Pisces give the good result; debilitated Capricorn weakens it; other signs give mixed outcomes by the lord's nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) would be taken as the strongest form, a supportive spouse.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 7th (lagna Cancer) would be the weakest form of the same rule.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 7th (lagna Gemini) gives a steady, wise partner.
Derived: Jupiter in Mercury's sign in the 7th (lagna Pisces) gives a mixed, analytical partner.

ambiguity: 'नी राशि' may be 'नीच राशि' (debilitated sign) or a garbled 'whatever sign'; the next words, 'by that sign', favour the general reading.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter in the 7th is judged by sign and dignity.

hindi: उसको तेज जवान का साथी मिलेगा ही मिलेगा मिलना ही है कुछ भी कर लो
says: With Jupiter in the 7th, he says the person will certainly get a sharp, energetic, young partner, whatever they do; it is fixed.
cells_derived_method: A Jupiter-7th partner is energetic and young by his reading; the sign shifts the nature, fire signs more forceful, earth signs more practical, water signs more emotional, air signs more talkative.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) points to a fiery, assertive young partner.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) points to a steady, comfort-loving partner.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo) points to a gentle, spiritual partner.

ambiguity: 'तेज जवान' may mean sharp-minded or fast and young; both are possible.
classical_check: Classical texts give a learned, wise, often older-in-mind spouse for Jupiter in the 7th, which differs from 'young and sharp'.

hindi: इसके लिए जरूरी है कि आप यह एरिया अपना दृढ़ करें नॉर्थ ईस्ट का इलाका सेट रखें आपके पति का भटकाव नहीं होगा
says: For this, keep the North-East area firm and in order; then the husband will not stray. This is a Vastu remedy for Jupiter-linked marriage trouble.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; Vastu supports a clean North-East but not this marital result.

hindi: यह बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी बात है इतनी कुंजी से ही ठीक हो जाएगा अन्यथा परेशानी बैठेगी
says: He calls this the single key point: setting the North-East right alone will fix the matter, otherwise trouble will settle in.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Moves on: next planet is Venus, 'Shukra Maharaj'; a topic transition.

hindi: य स्त्री के लिए सूचक है बेसिकली और पुरुष के लिए और स्त्री के लिए सेक्सुअल पावर यानी कितना रोमांस
says: Venus is basically the indicator of the wife for a man, and for both man and woman it shows sexual power, meaning how much romance there is.
ambiguity: Caption mixes 'स्त्री के लिए' and 'पुरुष के लिए'; he likely means Venus is the wife karaka for men and the sexual-power indicator for both.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka for wife, romance and sexual life in classical texts.

hindi: शुक्र सारा भोजन साज श्रृंगार सब कुछ यही है अपने जीवन के अंदर
says: Venus covers all food, makeup and adornment; in life, all of this belongs to Venus.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus signifies adornment, enjoyments and pleasures; food is partly Venus and partly Moon in classical lists.

hindi: आपका शुक्र घर का साउथ ईस्ट का इलाका पकड़ के चलता है
says: Venus holds the South-East area of the house, so the South-East of the home is Venus's space.
classical_check: Agrees with Vastu, which gives the South-East to Venus (Agni corner, ruled by Venus).

hindi: किसी स्त्री को पति से प्रेम चाहिए उसके साथ सगा रहे और उसका हमेशा प्रेम चिंता करें घर के अंदर साउथ ईस्ट में किचन मोस्ट मोस्ट मोस्ट आइडियल
says: A woman who wants her husband's love and care should have the kitchen in the South-East of the home; he calls this the most ideal place.
classical_check: Agrees with Vastu, which puts the kitchen in the South-East.

hindi: पर घरों में नहीं बन पाती कई बार ये एक अलग कहानी होती है तो साउथ में कर सकते हैं साउथ साउथ ईस्ट में कर सकते हैं
says: A South-East kitchen is often not possible; then the South or the South-South-East can be used instead.
classical_check: Classical Vastu allows South-East first and North-West as a fallback; the South is not usually listed for a kitchen.

gist: He says he is only giving rough points; going deep would take a full class on each point.

hindi: ये स्त्री के लिए ऐसी स्थिति में स्त्री के पास पुरुष हमेशा जुड़ा रहता है
says: With the kitchen set properly in Venus's direction, the husband stays attached to the wife; this is the stated benefit of a South-East kitchen for her.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; a Vastu claim.

hindi: किचन ओनली किचन किचन नहीं है भोजन का सामान रखो भोजन का सामान साज श्रृंगार महंगे कपड़े बलान डिमका जितनी चीजें आपको चाहिए ब्यूटी आइटम्स
says: If a kitchen is not possible there, at least keep food stock in that area, along with makeup, costly clothes and beauty items; whatever Venus things you want should be kept there.
ambiguity: 'किचन ओनली किचन' reads as 'not only the kitchen'; the sense is that other Venus items work too.
classical_check: Silent; Vastu gives similar substitution advice.

hindi: यह सब चीजें साउथ ईस्ट कारिया मजबूत करने से स्त्री के
says: All these Venus things strengthen the South-East area, and that in turn gives the woman the upper hand (sentence completes in the next chunk).
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge and finishes with 'कब्जे में रहता है पति'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कब्जे में रहता है पति पति को कब्ज हो जाती है लेकिन व उसके कब्जे में रहता है उसके कब्जे ढीले नहीं हो पाते
says: Result of the strong South-East: the husband stays in the wife's grip and cannot slip away; the word play on constipation is a joke, and the point is that her hold on him does not loosen.
ambiguity: The word play on 'कब्जा' (grip) and 'कब्ज' (constipation) is a joke and has no chart meaning.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke that husbands keep their screws tight with a screwdriver, so the wife's hold never loosens.

hindi: साउथ ईस्ट में किचन होगी व स्त्री अपने आप ही पतली होनी शुरू हो जाएगी पता नहीं कैसे हो जाएगी क्योंकि सौंदर्य का देवता है
says: With a South-East kitchen the woman will, he says, start getting slim by herself, because Venus is the god of beauty; he admits not knowing exactly how. Body-shape claim, not health advice.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as beauty is classical but a slimming effect from kitchen placement is not.

hindi: भोजन घर में बनने लगेगा बच्चे घर के अंदर अच्छे से एंजॉय करके खाने लगेंगे
says: Food will begin to be cooked at home and children will enjoy eating at home; so a Venus-strong kitchen improves home dining.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये हम केस स्पेसिफिक बात कर रहे हैं कि एक साउथ साउथ ईस्ट भी है साउथ भी है धन तो आएगा ही यानी खर्चे सब पूरे होंगे
says: Speaking case by case, if the kitchen sits in South-South-East or South, money will certainly come and all expenses will be met, so Venus's area also brings wealth.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as a wealth significator is classical, but no kitchen link is given.

hindi: हो सकता है कोई और कारण कर बड़ हो उसकी वजह से दिक्कत हो जाए
says: He adds a caveat: some other cause may still create a problem despite the right setup, so the Vastu fix does not guarantee the result.
ambiguity: The words 'कर बड़' are garbled; the sense of some other cause is inferred.
classical_check: Consistent with classical caution that no single factor decides a result.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में आपके जीवन के अंदर आप दोनों एक दूसरे के साथ झूठा भोजन खाएं सातवां घर ही जो जो परमिट करता है तो प्रेम और रोमांस बना रहेगा
says: Remedy: husband and wife should eat from each other's plate, sharing jootha food, as far as the seventh house permits; this keeps love and romance alive.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house is the partnership house; the sign on it decides how much closeness the bond allows, so shared plates suit warm signs more than reserved ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Libra 7th (lagna Aries) is a Venus-ruled partnership house, so shared food fits well.
Derived: a Capricorn 7th (lagna Cancer) is more reserved, so the habit would need effort.

ambiguity: 'सातवां घर ही जो जो परमिट करता है' is garbled; it may mean the 7th house in the chart or the marriage bond.
classical_check: Silent; shared meals as a marriage remedy is a folk practice.

hindi: पहले के समय की बड़ी गजब की प्रथा थी पति ने खाना खाया वो इतना सा झूठा छोड़ेगा बीवी खाएगी
says: He recalls an old custom where the husband left a little of his food and the wife ate it; this is the practice he is explaining.
ambiguity: He first praises the custom as wonderful, then questions it in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; a social custom.

gist: Objects that a wife should not eat leftovers, as she is not kept to be fed jootha; calls it a wrong act.
Mothers also ate the child's leftover food; now he calls the custom the biggest oppression of the woman.

hindi: यह वशीकरण है स्त्री ने वशीकरण कर दिया है उस वशीकरण
says: Eating the husband's leftover food is, he says, a form of vashikaran: the wife binds the husband to herself by it (sentence continues in the next chunk).
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge; 'वशीकरण' here is meant as a hold on the partner.
classical_check: Silent; vashikaran is a tantra practice, not Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: वाले व्यक्ति पे उसको यह पता ही नहीं यह प्रथा बता बनाई उसके रिस्क के लिए
says: Finishing the vashikaran line: the person who is bound by the jootha-food custom does not even know it, and he adds that the custom was made for the wife's own protection against risk.
ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-phrase from the previous chunk; 'risk' (रिस्क) is spoken in English and may refer to her health or her safety.
classical_check: Silent; this is a social-custom rationale, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: मंथ की डेट में कहते थे तीन दिन बहन तू बैठी रह कुछ मत काम कर तेरा रसोई में आना वर्जित है उसकी बॉडी को आराम दे रहे हैं
says: In the old custom, during the monthly period the woman was told to sit for three days, do no work and stay out of the kitchen; he says this was to give her body rest, not a sign of impurity.
ambiguity: No planet is named; the link to Venus is only that he is explaining women's customs while on Venus.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; menstrual seclusion appears in dharmashastra texts, not in Parashara.

gist: Today women fight saying they are called impure; he says men were fooled, and otherwise a man will make her work like a horse making tea and samosas.

hindi: इसलिए यह जो कारण बने हैं यह जितनी प्रथाएं यह उसकी रक्षा के लिए क्योंकि उसका शरीर सौष्ठव शरीर सही रहने से अंत समय तक पति के साथ जीवन के सुख दुख के अंदर काम आएगी
says: All such customs were made to protect the woman: if her body stays in good shape she remains useful to her husband in the joys and sorrows of life till the end.
ambiguity: He says 'for information' in the middle of the sentence, which is a caption slip; the meaning is the protective purpose of the customs.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A woman's long and tearful story is rising in him but he will not tell it, as it would be too long.
Crying banter with the audience, then moves on to ask what Venus's position is.

hindi: शुक्र की स्थिति क्या है शुक्र का यहां या शुक्र का यहां आ जाना यह आपके जीवन के अंदर जिंग रोमांस बढ़ा देता है
says: Introducing Venus placement: Venus coming into certain spots (he points at the chart without naming them) raises zing and romance in your life.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture at the board; the houses or signs are not in the caption, so no cells can be stated.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as the romance karaka is classical, but the spots are not named.

hindi: अब अगर शुक्र की स्थितियां नीच की है तो यह नष्ट करता है इस घर को
says: If Venus is in a debilitated state, it ruins the house (here the marital home or romantic life) in which it sits; the debilitation turns Venus's gifts into destruction.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus in Virgo harms whichever house it occupies by that house's topic. In the 7th it hurts marriage; in the 2nd family and food; in the 10th the work of beauty or arts; in the 4th the home comfort.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus in the 7th (lagna Pisces) would weaken the marriage house.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 2nd (lagna Leo) would weaken family harmony and speech.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius) would weaken work tied to beauty and luxury.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 4th (lagna Gemini) would reduce comfort and peace at home.

ambiguity: 'इस घर' may mean the house of the chart or the household; both readings give the same direction.
classical_check: Agrees that a debilitated Venus weakens its significations, though classical texts allow cancellation of debilitation.

hindi: इसी के साथ तीन नंबर की है तीन और छ नंबर दोनों बुध के हैं और छ नंबर राहु के दे रखा है इसने
says: Along with the debilitated case, signs 3 and 6, Gemini and Virgo, are both Mercury's, and in his scheme Virgo is also given to Rahu, so the Mercury and Rahu signs are the ones that pull Venus down.
ambiguity: 'नंबर' here means sign numbers (Gemini 3, Virgo 6) from the sense; 'दे रखा है इसने' means he has assigned Virgo to Rahu as well.
classical_check: Gemini and Virgo being Mercury's agrees with Parashara; giving Virgo to Rahu is his own scheme, not classical.

hindi: तो राहु और ये दोनों आ जाते हैं तो शुक्र नीच तुल्य काम करता है नीच तुल्य काम का मतलब यह अपने जो कर्म करता है उसको डाउन कर देगा
says: When Rahu and these two Mercury signs come together, Venus works like a debilitated planet (neecha-tulya): whatever Venus normally does it pulls down.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Gemini or Virgo gets the debilitation-like effect; the house tells which area is pulled down. In the 7th it hits marriage, in the 5th romance and children, in the 11th gains from friends.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) acts like a weakened Venus for marriage.
Derived: Venus in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) is truly debilitated and drags down romance and children.
Derived: Venus in Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo) acts down on gains from friends and social life.

ambiguity: It is unclear whether Rahu must be conjunct Venus or whether Rahu simply being a lord of Virgo is enough.
classical_check: Virgo debilitation of Venus is classical; calling Gemini 'neecha-tulya' is his own scheme.

hindi: शुक्र क्या करता है मौज पार्टी खाओ उड़ाओ बढ़िया है रोमांस है यह उसको तोड़ देगा तो पति पत्नी में कैसा होगा दुराव
says: Venus normally gives fun, parties, eating, spending and romance; when pulled down it breaks all this, and between husband and wife there will be distance.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus signifies pleasure and enjoyment; a weak Venus reducing these is classical.

hindi: शुक्र का नीच होना क्या है अच्छी बात है तो यह नीच तो कर्म तो बुरा ही करेगा यानी कि यहां पर रोमंस और जिंक जो है पार्टी मस्ती वो खत्म और तलाक भी कराएगा
says: A debilitated Venus is not a good thing; it will do its work badly, so romance, zing and party fun end, and it can also bring divorce.
cells_derived_method: The divorce risk is read through the house: strongest when Venus sits in the 7th or 2nd; weak when in 6th or 12th as he explains next.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus in the 7th (lagna Pisces) is the clearest picture for marital break.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 12th (lagna Libra) would drain bed pleasures and may not give a legal break.

ambiguity: He says it 'also causes divorce' and then immediately limits this for the 6th, so the divorce part is conditional.
classical_check: A debilitated Venus giving marital strain is classical, but divorce is not stated outright by Parashara.

hindi: लेकिन छ सातव घर नीच शुक्र तलाक नहीं कराएगा बजाय इसके अगर यह दो नंबर का हुआ सात नंबर का हुआ 12 नंबर हुआ दो और सात नंबर में 100%
says: A debilitated Venus in sign 6 will not cause divorce; instead the divorce danger comes when Venus is in sign 2 or 7, and in 2 and 7 he says it is a hundred percent.
cells_derived_method: Venus in its own signs Taurus or Libra gives the divorce result; the house shapes the area it strikes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) is the case he treats as certain divorce.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) is read the same way.
Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) puts the break in family and speech.

ambiguity: 'छ सातव घर' is garbled; the sense is that a debilitated Venus in sign 6 does not cause divorce. The numbers 2, 7, 6, 12 are sign numbers (Taurus, Libra, Virgo, Pisces), as the next chunk confirms by naming the lords Jupiter and Ketu for 12.
classical_check: Contradicts the previous row, where debilitation also causes divorce; Parashara never gives 100 percent divorce for Venus in own sign, where it is usually good.

hindi: डाइवोर्स है छ में शायद ना कराए 12 में शायद ना कराए और करा भी सकता है क्योंकि छ नंबर राशि भी बदल जाती है अपने स्थान से
says: Divorce is certain in 2 and 7, but in sign 6 it perhaps will not cause it, and in sign 12 it perhaps will not, though it can; he says the sign-6 position also changes from its place.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Virgo (debilitated) or Pisces (exalted) gives only a maybe on divorce, depending on other factors; the house decides how strong the maybe is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 7th (lagna Virgo) is more likely to hold the marriage than break it.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 6th (lagna Aries) strains service and health relations before marriage.

ambiguity: 'राशि भी बदल जाती है अपने स्थान से' is unclear; may refer to the sign shifting in the divisional or bhava chart.
classical_check: Silent on divorce percentages; exalted Venus in the 7th is normally favourable in classical texts.

hindi: लेकिन यह अपने ही घर का जब होता है दो और सात तो डाइवोर्स करा देता है शुक्र क्या कहता है पार्टी करेंगे ना खाना पीना है मल्टीपल पार्टनर्स के साथ रहना है सेक्सुअल लाइफ एंजॉय करनी है
says: When Venus is in its own home, Taurus or Libra (signs 2 and 7), it causes divorce, because Venus's wish is party, food and drink, multiple partners and a free sexual life.
cells_derived_method: Venus in own sign makes its desire for pleasure strong; in the 7th this works against a single partner, in the 5th against steady romance, in the 2nd against family life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives the strongest pull to outside partners.
Derived: Venus in Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini) leans towards romances rather than one lasting bond.
Derived: Venus in Libra in the 2nd (lagna Virgo) gives pleasure-seeking in family and speech.

classical_check: Differs from classical views, where Venus in own sign in the 7th is a good placement and often called happy marriage.

hindi: अब ये जब अपने घर का बैठ गया तो क्या हुआ चरित्रहीन कर दिया इसने एक प्रकार से
says: When Venus sits in its own home it makes the person, in a way, without moral restraint (charitraheen).
ambiguity: Whether he applies this to the native or only to the spouse is not clear.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which treat Venus in own sign as strength; any lax conduct is read from other factors.

hindi: 12 में नहीं होगा सरसा 12 में भी होगा लेकिन ये बृहस्पति देखना पड़ेगा इसमें केतु देखना पड़ेगा क्योंकि इसका मालिक केतु और बृहस्पति है ये तो खुद ही मालिक है इन दोनों का तो
says: In sign 12, Pisces, the divorce result may not happen, or may; for that you must examine Jupiter and Ketu, who are the lords of Pisces in his scheme, and Venus here sits in the home of those two.
cells_derived_method: Judge Venus in Pisces by the strength of Jupiter and Ketu: strong Jupiter keeps the marriage, a weak Jupiter or a spoiled Ketu lets the divorce effect come.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in the 7th (lagna Virgo); the marriage result then rests on Jupiter and Ketu's condition.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 12th (lagna Aries) is judged by Jupiter and Ketu's strength for bed pleasures and foreign matters.

ambiguity: The caption start is garbled ('सरसा'); the sense is a maybe for sign 12.
classical_check: Jupiter as lord of Pisces is classical; naming Ketu as co-lord is his own scheme.

hindi: अभी मैंने बोल दिया जैसे सूरे शनी झगड़ा कराएंगे लोग कहेंगे हमारा तो नहीं ब पापा से झगड़ा होता
says: Recalling an earlier line, he says Sun with Saturn will cause quarrel, and people object that their own father does not fight with them; the Sun-Saturn clash is the father-conflict rule.
ambiguity: It is a recap, and 'सूरे शनी' is read as Sun and Saturn; the conjunction or aspect is not specified.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun-Saturn is an inimical combination and strains the father relation.

gist: He says this became a point with depth and now it is universal; a remark about how the rule generalizes.

hindi: ये यूनिवर्सल हो गया दो और सात नंबर है ना भाई तलाक होएगा बाय द बुक तो तलाक होएगा ही जब तक दो और सात नंबर डिस्प्लेस नहीं हुई मतलब
says: The rule is universal: with Venus in signs 2 and 7 divorce will happen by the book, unless those signs are displaced (shifted by the house cusps).
cells_derived_method: If Venus's sign changes house by displacement, as in bhava chalit, the result is cancelled, so the rule is checked in both the rashi chart and the bhava chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) in the rashi chart would trigger the rule unless bhava chalit moves it to the 6th or 8th.
Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) would trigger the rule unless bhava chalit shifts it.

ambiguity: 'डिस्प्लेस' is garbled; it may mean displaced by chalit, or simply moved out of the 2 and 7 signs.
classical_check: Silent on a fixed divorce rule; the bhava chalit check is classical.

hindi: वो होनी चाहिए हां ये सा होनी चाहिए तुम्हारा तलाक कराएगा य पति पत्नी का
says: Completing the point, those signs need to be displaced; if not, the Venus will bring about the divorce of the husband and wife.
ambiguity: The caption is broken ('ये सा होनी चाहिए'); the condition of displacement is inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि यह कह रहा है मैं अपने घर का हूं मेरे को बाहर जाना है सेक्स करने मुझे बाहर जाना है भटकने और यह इसका प्रिंसिपल है
says: Venus in its own home says, in his image, 'I am at home, I want to go out for sex and to roam'; this wandering is the principle of Venus in its own sign, and the reason couples part.
classical_check: Differs from classical views; Venus in own sign is normally seen as strong and content.

hindi: तो अगर यही काम यह करेगा तो कौन सा पति पत्नी साथ रहेंगे वो तलाकी कराएंगे क्योंकि एक प्रकार से चरित्र का जो साथ जोड़ चाहिए वो टूट गया ना खराब कर देता है
says: If Venus does this, no couple can stay together; it breaks the shared trust of character that a marriage needs, and so brings divorce.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this is a very big problem; a bridging remark before the remedy.

hindi: इसके लिए विष्णु विवाह कराओ जब जब किसी भी ग्रह का दोष आ रहा है लड़की की कुंडली के अंदर विष्णु जी से विवाह एक सैक्रिफिशियल मैरिज
says: Remedy for the girl's chart: perform a Vishnu marriage, a symbolic sacrificial marriage with Vishnu, whenever a planetary fault comes in her horoscope.
ambiguity: The caption says 'any planet's fault', but he uses it here for the Venus-in-2-and-7 problem.
classical_check: Agrees in form with the classical Vishnu-vivah (Kumbh vivah) remedy for marital delay or mangal dosha.

hindi: बृहस्पति विष्णु है भगवान है तो उनके विष्णु से मल्टीपल मैरिज कराई जा सकती है ग्रह की बलि ले लेते हैं
says: Jupiter is Vishnu, so the Vishnu marriage is a marriage to Jupiter's deity; many such marriages can be done, and in it the planet's affliction is taken as the sacrifice.
ambiguity: Jupiter as Vishnu is his link; classically Jupiter's deity is Brahma or Indra by some lists and Vishnu for the Dashavatara scheme of other planets.
classical_check: Differs from the Dashavatara scheme, in which Jupiter's avatar is Vamana; Vishnu as Jupiter's deity is not universal.

gist: Krishna as an avatar of Vishnu and complete man; all others are women, so he had 16,000 queens named by him.

hindi: तो जो बलि देनी है वो यहां दे दी जाए सारी की सारी यह काम की जाए शुक्र के दोष के लिए
says: So the sacrifice that has to be offered should be given through this Vishnu marriage, and all of it should be done for the Venus fault.
classical_check: Silent on this exact link between the sacrifice and Venus faults.

hindi: यह करने के पश्चात ही योग खुलेगा क्योंकि ऐसी स्थिति में क्या होगा यदि बृहस्पति का सपोर्ट नहीं मिला तो शुक्र क्या करेगा भटका आता रहेगा शादी नहीं होने देगा
