cells_derived_method: Every house and sign reading in D1 has to be repeated in D9, where each house is again touched by 2 or 3 signs.
classical_check: Agrees that navamsha is the most important divisional chart, though not above the rashi chart in Parashara.

hindi: मेरे ख्याल अपन तो पता नहीं 10 12 कुंडलिया घुमाते हैं एक बार में सब कुछ देखने के लिए
says: He says he rotates ten to twelve charts at a time, to see everything at once, so the divisional charts are read together with the main chart.
ambiguity: The caption is partly garbled ('अपन तो पता नहीं'); the idea of reading ten to twelve charts together is clear.
classical_check: Agrees with the Shodashavarga practice of reading many divisional charts, up to sixteen.

hindi: नवांश कुंडली लेनी ही पड़ेगी नवांश शादी के बाद अगर आपकी कुंडली कह रही है लाजवाब शादी होगी और नवांश कह रहा है सत्यानाश तो सत्यानाश हर हालत में
says: The navamsha chart must always be taken: if the main chart promises a wonderful marriage but the navamsha says ruin, the result is ruin in every case.
cells_derived_method: For a marriage, compare the 7th house and Venus in D1 with the same in D9; if D9 contradicts D1, D9 wins by his rule.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a good D1 Libra 7th (lagna Aries) is overruled if D9 shows Venus or the 7th weak.
Derived: a hard D1 Scorpio 7th (lagna Taurus) can still rise if D9 is strong, by the mirror of his rule.

ambiguity: He says D9 overrides D1 for marriage; he does not say whether this applies to other topics.
classical_check: Agrees that D9 shows the real strength of planets and marriage; overruling D1 completely is stronger than classical statements.

hindi: य शादी की कुंडली शादी से पहले ही एक्टिवेटेड होती है बचपन से ही
says: The marriage chart, the navamsha, is active before marriage, from childhood, not only from the wedding day.
classical_check: Agrees that navamsha shows planetary strength throughout life, not only after marriage.

hindi: लेकिन शादी के बाद अगर लिखा है कि आपकी जिंदगी में अरबपति बनोगे और नवांश अच्छा है तो ही बनोगे नवांश खराब है तो बहुत पैसे वाले से भी कंग हो जाओगे
says: After marriage, if the main chart says you will become a billionaire, you will become one only if the navamsha is good; with a bad navamsha even a very rich person turns pauper.
cells_derived_method: Wealth promise in D1 (2nd and 11th houses and their lords) must be confirmed in D9; if D9 is weak the same houses fail to deliver.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Capricorn 11th (lagna Pisces) wealth promise needs Saturn well placed in D9.
Derived: a Taurus 2nd (lagna Aries) wealth promise needs Venus well placed in D9.

ambiguity: He mentions billionaire and bankruptcy as illustrations; no investment advice is given and none is taken.
classical_check: Agrees that D9 confirms or denies D1 promises; the dramatic reversal is his emphasis.

hindi: नवांश यह काम करता है डिट्टो कुंडली की तरह काम करेगा तो शादी के बाद के लिए आपको नवांश भी ठीक करना है
says: Navamsha works exactly like the main kundli, so for life after marriage you must also set the navamsha right, not only the main chart.
ambiguity: The first words ('नवांश यह काम करता है') are the end of the previous chunk's sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that D9 is read like a full chart; remedies for D9 as such are not classical.

hindi: इसीलिए दशांश हमें गुरुद्वारे में देकर आए मंदिर में देकर आए
says: For this reason, give a tenth share (dashansh) of your earnings at a gurudwara or temple; a tithe as the remedy that fixes the navamsha.
ambiguity: 'दशांश' may mean a tenth part of income, or be a slip for navamsha or the D10 dashamsha chart; he calls it a slip of the tongue right after.
classical_check: Silent on the link; tithing as dana is a general tradition.

gist: Says no, it was a slip of the tongue, and then that it was done on purpose.
Audience question: if both boy and girl have divorce in the chart and the boy divorces, will a second wife with no divorce yoga also be divorced.

hindi: तो हो तो चुका एक डाइवोर्स उसका तो वो एग्जॉस्ट हो गया एग्जॉस्ट हो गया वो काम खत्म
says: A divorce yoga in a man's chart is used up once the first divorce has happened; it is exhausted and the work is finished, so a second wife without such a yoga is not divorced.
ambiguity: He says this about a case where the boy carries a divorce yoga and the second girl does not; he does not name the yoga.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not say a yoga is exhausted after one result, they often allow repeats.

hindi: यही तो हम करते हैं डाइवोर्स करते हैं ना घड़ा लिया तोड़ दिया
says: This is what the remedies do: a ritual marriage with a pot is arranged and the pot is broken, which acts as a divorce in the symbolic sense.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Kumbh vivah, in which a clay pot is married and then broken.

hindi: पौधा लिया छोड़ दिया शालिग्राम से विवाह किया नमस्ते एक शादी हो गई कट गया
says: Likewise a plant is married and left, and a marriage with Shaligram is performed; one marriage is thus done and the divorce yoga is cut away.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Arka and Vishnu (Shaligram) vivah remedies.

gist: Says that when Saturn comes up in the class he will explain this part.

hindi: मल्टीपल मैरिज कराते हैं हम एक ही लड़के लड़की के आपस में कि तुम तो कई बार शादी कर लो आपस में वो ग्रह उसको स्ट्रेंथ देता है
says: He has the same boy and girl marry each other several times; that repeated marriage gives strength to the planet, so repeated weddings are a remedy.
ambiguity: The planet is not named here; the next clause points to Mars and Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; repeating a wedding between the same pair is not a classical remedy.

hindi: नहीं तो मंग शनि फिर भूल जाता है थोड़े दिनों में हेलो एम आई मैरिड उसकी फिर शादी कराओ
says: Otherwise Mars or Saturn forgets in a few days, as if asking 'am I married?', so the wedding has to be repeated.
ambiguity: 'मंग शनि' is read as Mars and Saturn; it could also be Mangal-Shani as a pair.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this is a problem that has not been discussed in the class, namely what binds it; it will come later.
Audience asks whether a high manglik and a low manglik can marry, as discussed in the manglik talk.

hindi: भाई घोर मंगली है और लेस मंगली है इस पचड़े में ना पड़े उनकी शादी हो सकती है लेकिन मंगली मंगली होता है
says: A severe manglik and a mild manglik can marry; do not get into degrees, because a manglik is a manglik.
ambiguity: He says two manglik partners can marry, but also that there is no grade; it is unclear whether he says a manglik with a non-manglik is acceptable.
classical_check: Agrees that two mangliks cancel each other; ignoring degrees differs from texts that weigh the strength of the dosha.

hindi: चंद्र मंगली का कोई लफड़ा नहीं है लोग चंद्र मंगली ठोक देते अच्छा चंद्रमा से मंगल चौथा आठवा वो इससे मैच नहीं करेगा
says: There is no such thing as chandra-mangli; people wrongly declare it, counting Mars in the 4th or 8th from the Moon, and that does not match the real manglik rule.
ambiguity: He names the 4th and 8th from the Moon only as examples; the full list of houses from the Moon is not given.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, in which Mars is also counted from the Moon and from Venus.

hindi: उसका इससे एक धले का लेना देना नहीं है यह लग्न कुंडली पर ही चलेगा
says: The Moon-based count has nothing to do with the real dosha; the manglik rule works only on the lagna kundli.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, which also counts manglik from the Moon and Venus.

gist: The lagna kundli manglik rule is wide; he will take two minutes if time allows, though it might be twenty.
Tail of the manglik answer: says yes that topic is very long, as he knows.
Audience says Kumbh vivah was discussed but Arka and Vishnu vivah were not, and asks what they involve.
Housekeeping: asks someone to send the sheet and photos, says the question will be packed and added later.
Audience question: what if the lords of the 5th and 7th houses, such as Jupiter or Saturn, interchange or aspect each other, and does it give love marriage.

hindi: पंचमेश सप्तम में और सप्तमेश पंचम कॉमिनेशन बैठ जाए अगर इन दो शानदार लवली लवली पत्नी के आते ही रॉकेट की तरह उठता है आदमी
says: If the 5th lord sits in the 7th and the 7th lord sits in the 5th, a mutual exchange, the man gets a lovely wife and rises like a rocket as soon as she arrives.
cells_derived_method: The exchange can only occur for certain lagnas; the signs on the 5th and 7th decide which two planets swap, and the strength of that pair decides how big the rise is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries the 5th lord Sun sits in Libra in the 7th and the 7th lord Venus sits in Leo in the 5th; the Sun in Libra is weak (its fall sign), so the rise is mixed.
Derived: for lagna Taurus the 5th lord Mercury sits in Scorpio in the 7th and the 7th lord Mars sits in Virgo in the 5th; a restless pair with a sharp partner.
Derived: for lagna Cancer the 5th lord Mars sits in Capricorn in the 7th (exalted) and the 7th lord Saturn sits in Scorpio in the 5th; strong Mars gives a forceful rise.
Derived: for lagna Aries the 7th lord Venus in Leo in the 5th is the other half of the Sun-Venus exchange.

ambiguity: He says 'combination sitting' (कॉमिनेशन बैठ जाए), meaning the 5th and 7th lords sitting in each other's houses; the earlier audience mention of aspect is not part of his answer.
classical_check: Agrees that a parivartana between the 5th and 7th lords is a love-marriage and fortunate-spouse yoga.

hindi: ऐसे योग होते हैं सातवें और अ दव और चौथे घर के पत्नी के आने के बाद आदमी पांच गुना कमाता है दो गुना तीन गुना नहीं पांच
says: There are yogas involving the 7th house, another garbled house and the 4th house where, after the wife comes, a man earns five times as much, not two or three times.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 7th and 4th decides which planets carry the wealth rise; for example Venus signs on the 7th point to income through the spouse's taste and comfort, Mercury signs through trade.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 7th (lagna Scorpio) would tie the wife's arrival to comfort, luxury and Venus-type income.
Derived: Gemini on the 4th (lagna Pisces) would tie home life and gains to Mercury-type work and writing.

ambiguity: 'अ दव' is garbled and might be the 11th or 8th house; the fivefold figure is also loose and may be a manner of speaking.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 7th, 4th and 11th houses and the spouse's arrival are linked with fortune; the fivefold income figure is not classical.

gist: A trailing remark that all these things will come up; the sentence trails off.
Says listeners must be wishing the wife would come soon, now itself.
Three questions are not about love and marriage, but he will take them; one is on Kumbh.
Question: if a friend brings Triveni Sangam water home and you bathe with it, do you get the same benefit as going there in person.
Asks what the benefit is, and says it is only greed, desire and maya again.

hindi: अरे भाई कुंभ हमारे यहां बहुत बड़ी एस्टेरॉइड बेल्ट है यार है प्रश्न बहुत भारी
says: Kumbh, in his image, corresponds to the asteroid belt of the solar system, which is also found in the body; he calls the question a heavy one that needs explaining through this belt.
ambiguity: The caption is loose; 'कुंभ' here may mean the Kumbh festival or the Kumbha pot; the next lines show he means the festival tied to Jupiter and the belt.
classical_check: Silent; the asteroid belt is not part of classical Jyotish, and he is making his own body-solar analogy.

hindi: यह धरती माता है हमारी यह धरती मैया यहां पर हम रहते हैं यह हमारी नाभी है
says: In his solar-system-as-body picture, the Earth, where we live, is the navel of the body.
ambiguity: A later line seems to give the navel to Mars and the diaphragm to the Earth, so this mapping is not stable in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts map the body to the zodiac signs, not to the planetary orbits.

hindi: यहां गुरु है बृहस्पति ग्रह बृहस्पति ने चक्कर लगाया बृहस्पति ने चक्कर लगाया सूरज का
says: Here sits the guru Jupiter, who goes around the Sun in a circle; the orbit of Jupiter is the basis of the Kumbh timing.
ambiguity: The words 'यहां गुरु है' point at a diagram, so the position in the body picture is not captured.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the guru; the heliocentric orbit is astronomy, not part of classical Jyotish.

hindi: 12 साल लिए इसके चक्कर लगाने के 12 इयर्स और फिर लौट कर के आया यह 12 साल में बृहस्पति ने चक्कर लगाया प्रमेट 11 पॉइंट कुछ होता है लेकिन 12 साल
says: Jupiter takes about twelve Earth years to go round the Sun and return to the same point; he notes the exact figure is eleven point something, but uses twelve.
ambiguity: 'प्रमेट' is garbled, probably 'precisely' or 'approximately'.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's sidereal period is about 11.86 years; Jyotish uses roughly one sign per year.

hindi: इस नाभी के नीचे हमारा सेक्स चक्र है वाटर चक्र जहां हमारा सुसु बनता है इसके नीचे हमारा पोटी का चक्र हो गया कोलन जहां हमारा शनि महाराज है मूलाधार
says: Below the navel is the sex or water chakra where urine forms, and below that is the excretion chakra of the colon, where Saturn sits; this is the muladhara. A body map claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: He places the muladhara at the colon; yogic texts place it at the base of the spine near the perineum.
classical_check: Differs from classical karakas; Saturn is linked with the colon and bones in some texts, but the muladhara is yogic and not Jyotish.

hindi: अब यह ना भी मंगल यह मंगल है यह धरती धरती डाय फ्रा है इसके ऊपर हृदय ये हृदय हमारा वीनस
says: In the body-orbit map, Mars sits at the navel level, the earth region is the diaphragm, and above it is the heart, which is Venus.
ambiguity: The caption is broken ('ना भी मंगल', 'डाय फ्रा'); it clashes with his earlier line that Earth is the navel, so the mapping is uncertain.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts: Venus is not the heart karaka (the Sun is) and Mars is blood and energy, not the navel.

hindi: हमारी नाभी और इसके बीच में ना ऊपर एक बेल्ट एस्टेरॉइड बेल्ट वहां सेरेस नाम का एक बहुत बड़ा एस्टेरॉइड है
says: Between the navel and the heart region lies a belt, the asteroid belt, in which a very large asteroid named Ceres sits.
ambiguity: The 'between' refers to the body diagram; the belt's body location is the upper abdomen on his reading.
classical_check: Silent; Ceres and the asteroid belt are not part of classical Jyotish.

hindi: ये यहां पर वो इतना बड़ा है उसको भी सेरेस कहा जाता है नाम देते वो भी इफेक्ट देता है उसके नाम पे वर्ड बने
says: Ceres is so large that it is counted as a body in its own right, a name is given to it and it too gives effects; words in language were formed after its name.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk, where the word is given as 'cereal'.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text uses Ceres.

hindi: सीरियल दालें भारी दाले पचती नहीं बहुत गैस बनता है लोग सारा दिन परेशान रहते हैं दर्द कर रहा है दर्द कर रहा है
says: The word cereal comes from Ceres and stands for grains and heavy lentils that do not digest well; he links the Ceres area to gas and a day of pain. A body claim in his scheme, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: The repeated 'दर्द कर रहा है' is the voice of the sufferers, not a separate claim.
classical_check: Silent; Ceres is not in classical Jyotish and the etymology of cereal from the Roman goddess Ceres is ordinary word history.

hindi: तो जुपिटर क्या कर रहा है जुपिटर जो घूम रहा है ना ये एस्टेरॉइड बेल्ट के ये ऊपर को जाते हैं धरती पे आएंगे एस्टेरॉइड समझ ले
says: Jupiter, going round, keeps the asteroids of the belt from reaching Earth; he asks us to understand the asteroid threat so that Jupiter's role becomes clear.
ambiguity: The caption is rough: 'ऊपर को जाते हैं धरती पे आएंगे' mixes the belt and the Earth threat.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of Jupiter as a shield is astronomical and modern, though Jupiter as protector is classical.

gist: An asteroid wiped out the dinosaurs on Earth and we too could die in space; an astronomy aside.

hindi: हमारे को जब उल्टी आती है और वो दाल का दाना फस जाता है नीचे नहीं उतर का इंटेस्टाइन में नहीं जाता तो हमें उल्टी आती है और लगता है मर जाएंगे भयंकर बाहर आता है खाना अटक गया
says: When a lentil grain is stuck and does not move down into the intestine, vomiting comes and one feels one is dying; he uses this as a picture of food stuck in the body belt. A bodily claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: This is an illustration; the planet link is made in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो इसलिए क्योंकि हमारा जुपिटर यहां झाड़ू फेरता है वैक्यूम क्लीनर है ये यह खींचता है यहां से इस गुच नीचे गुच नीचे
says: Food gets stuck because Jupiter's sweeping fails; in the body picture Jupiter is the vacuum cleaner or broom that pulls food from here steadily downwards.
ambiguity: 'गुच नीचे' is a garbled gulp sound.
classical_check: Differs from classical karakas, which link Jupiter with the liver and fat; digestion as a sweeping function is his own image.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति चक्र लगाता है पूरा धरती का प्रोटेक्शन सारे बेल्ट को पकड़ के रखता तुम धरती को नष्ट नहीं होने दूंगा तो इसलिए बृहस्पति गुरु है प्रोटेक्टर है यह बचाता है
says: Jupiter circles and holds the whole belt in check, protecting the Earth from destruction; that is why Jupiter is the guru and the protector who saves.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the guru and protector; the astronomical shield image is a modern link.

hindi: इसी तरह स्त्री के लिए पति पुरुष प्रोटेक्टर है बचाता है लेकिन वो उसे पति माने तो सही नहीं तो उसे बचाएगा नहीं
says: Likewise for a woman, her husband is the protector who saves her, but only if she accepts him as husband; otherwise he will not protect her (sentence completes next chunk).
ambiguity: He applies the Jupiter-protector idea to the husband, which fits Jupiter as husband karaka in a woman's chart.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the husband karaka for a woman.

hindi: वो उसको चबाए यह उसका सबसे बड़ा समस्या है
says: If she does not accept him as husband, he will chew on her; that is her biggest problem.
ambiguity: 'वो उसको चबाए' is read as a figure of speech meaning he will harass her, not a literal act.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह जुपिटर 12 साल में एक बार घूमता है और घूम के वापस यहां आता है यह कुंभ के पास घड़ा य कुंडलिनी का कुंभ है य हमारा मंगल का कुंभ यह महाकुंभ है
says: Jupiter goes round once in twelve years and returns to the same place; this return is the Kumbh, the pot of the kundalini and of Mars in his image, and the great Mahakumbh.
ambiguity: 'मंगल का कुंभ' ties the pot to Mars, which is odd; may mean the navel centre he assigned to Mars earlier.
classical_check: Agrees that the Kumbh Mela timing follows Jupiter's twelve-year cycle; the kundalini and Mars link is his own.

hindi: 12 साल में पूरे साफ करके वैक्यूम क्लीनर आकाश गंगा में धरती को बचाता है तो हम कहां बचे मेरा हृदय बच गया मेरी नाभि बच गई कब जब जुपिटर सही है
says: In twelve years Jupiter, like a vacuum cleaner, clears the sky and protects the Earth; in us the heart and the navel are saved only when Jupiter is in good order.
ambiguity: Whether 'saved' means health or general protection is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees that a strong Jupiter protects; the heart and navel link is his own scheme.

hindi: जुपिटर क्या उसूल फैसला जायज फैसला आप गलत हो तो आप गलत हो यह मानने वाला व्यक्ति अपने जुपिटर को सेट रखता है उसकी नाभि कभी खराब ही नहीं होगी
says: Jupiter stands for principle and fair judgment; a person who admits 'I am wrong' when wrong keeps his Jupiter in order, and his navel will never go bad. The health side is his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter signifies dharma and just judgement; the claim about the navel is not classical.

hindi: इसलिए जब महाकुंभ में आप जाते हो तो सूचक है कि भैया वहां जाओ वहां संगम है त्रिवेणी त्रिवेणी क्या होती है इदा पिंगला और सुसुम
says: Going to the Mahakumbh is a sign to go to the Sangam, the Triveni, which he explains as Ida, Pingala and Sushumna, the three channels of the body.
ambiguity: 'सुसुम' is read as Sushumna.
classical_check: Agrees with yogic texts that Triveni as Ganga, Yamuna and Saraswati is read as Ida, Pingala and Sushumna.

hindi: उस स्थान के ऊपर लोंगिट्यूड लटटू में इस तरह से है कि उज्जैन से लेकर के सीधी चली हुई बेल्ट जो ग्रीनविच मेरिडियन टाइम जीरो डिग्री लेकर चलता है ब्रिटेन के अंदर हमारे यहां का जो सेंटर 82.30
says: The place lies on a straight belt of longitude and latitude running from Ujjain; he contrasts Greenwich as zero degrees in Britain with India's own centre at about 82.30 degrees east.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled and the link between Ujjain, the 82.30 figure and the Sangam is not clear.
classical_check: Ujjain was the classical prime meridian of Indian astronomy at about 75.8 degrees east; India's standard meridian is 82.5 degrees east, and Prayagraj is near 81.9 degrees east, so the figures do not line up exactly.

hindi: 12 12 वर्ष के बाद यह माना जाता है कि जुपिटर ने हम पर कृपा कर दी तो यह उस महा त्रिवेणी को समझने का खेल है
says: After every twelve years it is believed that Jupiter has shown grace on us, and the Mahakumbh is a way of understanding the great Triveni.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter's return is a favourable cycle in tradition, though the Kumbh itself depends on Jupiter's sign.

hindi: मास बॉडी से समझना है तो बॉडी को लेकर चले जाओ कुंभ में अंदर समझना है बॉडी को ले जाने की जरूरत नहीं अंदर वह क्रिया चल रही है
says: To understand it through the physical body, take the body to the Kumbh; to understand it within, the body need not travel because the process is already running inside.
ambiguity: 'मास बॉडी' may mean 'mass body' or 'as body'; the sense is physical travel against inner understanding.
classical_check: Silent; a philosophy point on pilgrimage.

gist: Asks what fruit you want; if only profit or to beg for benefit, go and earn merit.
Says earning merit would need a separate class.

hindi: ये अभी आएंगे जो य यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो आएंगे ना यही एंगे कुंडली जागरण का भी इससे कनेक्शन है ना
says: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto will come up later, and these three are connected with kundalini awakening, which is also tied to this belt-and-channel picture.
ambiguity: Caption is rough ('एंगे'); it reads as a forward reference, not a full rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jyotish does not use the outer planets.

gist: Garbled lines about reaching there and the three channels moving; no clear meaning.

hindi: ये यहां पर जाकर के बृहस्पति का कारण है ना जिस वजह से हमारा सारा का सारा कार्यक्रम सही चलता है ये वैक्यूम क्लीनर है बॉडी को
says: Jupiter is the reason our whole programme runs right; it is the vacuum cleaner of the body, which pulls out (sentence continues next chunk).
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter signifies order and protection; the vacuum cleaner image is his own.

hindi: खींच लेता है सारे एस्टेरॉइड सारे जो खाना पच नहीं रहा जो बातें बातें नहीं पच रही अगर आपका पेट खराब है आपसे बातें नहीं पच रही
says: Jupiter pulls out all asteroids and everything that is not digested, both food and things said to you; if your stomach is upset you also cannot digest talk.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not link Jupiter with digesting speech.

hindi: खाना नहीं पच रहा वो उल्टी करेगा या लूज मोशन लगेंगे 100% बातें नहीं पच रही आपसे
says: When food does not digest, he says the body will vomit or have loose motions, and with the same certainty you cannot digest what is said to you. This is a claim about the body, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The '100 percent' refers to the link between food and speech not being digested.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled words about a spinning gossip and that he did not hear the question.
Next question: a class was held on the pot of sin and merit, and why women do not stop quarrelling.

hindi: केतु पे आएगी इसकी बात जब हम केतु की करेंगे कि जबान से क्यों लेडी इतना लड़ती है क्यों इतना बोलती है
says: The question of why women fight so much with the tongue and speak so much will be answered under Ketu, so he links tongue and speech quarrels to Ketu.
ambiguity: This is only a forward pointer to Ketu; the actual rule is not given in this chunk.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link the 2nd house and Mercury with speech, not Ketu with a woman's speech.

gist: A man cannot cope with a woman's talk, says he has lost, turns to violence and hurts her body.
Repeats that this will come up under Ketu.
Audience question begins: whoever does not have love marriage written but believes only in love and wants to marry.

hindi: 12 पर में तो वही लिखा है कि प्रेम विवाह नहीं होगा तो व ऐसा क्या करे कि 12 पर में नहीं है जो उसको कैसे मेनिफेस्ट करे नहीं कर पाएगा जो 12 पर में नहीं है वो नहीं कर पाएगा
says: If the fixed twelve-percent part of the chart says there will be no love marriage, the person cannot manifest it; whatever is not in that fixed part cannot be done by manifesting.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is most likely '12 percent', the fixed horoscope share he spoke of earlier in the series; it could also be misheard 'twelve places', so the figure is uncertain.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical idea of fixed prarabdha karma that effort cannot alter, but the twelve percent figure is not classical.

gist: Asks why the big manifestation gurus did not become Prime Minister themselves, and why Kejriwal did not go there; they cannot do it for themselves, so they cannot do it for you.
If the great scholars and astrologers could change fate, why do they not contest elections and become Prime Minister.

hindi: 12 पर नहीं बदलेगा जो नहीं है 12 पर में उसको लोन लेकर भी नहीं किया जा सकता 12 पर बदलेगा नहीं बदलना वो टस्ट हो सकता है बदलेगा कभी नहीं बदल ही नहीं सकता
says: The fixed twelve-percent part will not change; what is not in it cannot be had even by taking a loan from somewhere, and it can never be changed.
ambiguity: 'वो टस्ट हो सकता है' is garbled and might be 'it can be trust' or 'it can be a bust'; the claim of no change is clear.
classical_check: Differs from classical Jyotish, which allows remedies to soften fixed results; he allows change only through a guru in the next line.

hindi: इसलिए यह सोचना यह लड़ना जिंदगी बदल देंगे मेनिफेस्ट कर देंगे नहीं आपको खुद एक गुरु रखना पड़ेगा जो बदलना जानता है वो बदल देगा
says: So thinking you will change life by manifesting does not work; you need to keep a guru who knows how to bring change, and he will do it.
ambiguity: This seems to conflict with his previous line that nothing can change the fixed part; the guru is the exception he allows.
classical_check: Agrees that a guru is central in classical remedy practice; Jupiter is the guru karaka.

hindi: जो जान जाता है वो बदलना ही नहीं चाहता उसको लगता है य मूर्खता है क्योंकि दूसरा एक और चैनल खुल जाएगा और वहां से वह समस्या किसी और रूप में लाएगा
says: The person who truly knows does not want to change anything, thinking it foolish, because another channel will open and the same problem will come back in some other form.
classical_check: Silent; a philosophical view that fate is conserved, not a classical rule.

hindi: यह ज्ञान हो जाने के बाद आपको लगता लीला है बढ़िया तो चल रहा
says: After this knowledge arrives, you see life as a leela, a divine play, and feel that all is running well (the sentence continues next chunk).
ambiguity: The sentence ends at 'चल रहा' and finishes in the next chunk with 'है'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this is Varuna (Neptune) and that the matter will come up when Varuna is taken up.

hindi: प्लूटो देता है ज्ञान सारे ऑ कल्ट की धुलाई प्लूटो के पास है
says: Pluto gives knowledge, and the washing or cleansing of all occult matters is with Pluto.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jyotish has no Pluto, and modern Western astrology links Pluto with the occult and transformation.

hindi: सारे ल्ट पति पत्नी इकट्ठा बैठक योगा करते हैं प्लूटो वाले चलो देखेंगे हां बहुत प्यारा रिलेशनशिप है उसका बताओ
says: People with a strong Pluto, he says, are couples who sit and practise yoga together, and their relationship is very lovely; he says he will explain it later.
ambiguity: The first word is garbled ('सारे ल्ट'); the link of yoga-practising couples with Pluto is read from context.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says the last two questions are here, and the audience asks about a debilitated planet in the 9th house and ishta devta by sign.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस में नीच का ग्रह है इसका मतलब वो व्यक्ति किसी हालत में ना पंडित प जोशी प किसी के बिलीव ही नहीं करता अगर उसका स्वभाव है तो फिक्स्ड है
says: A debilitated planet in the 9th house means the person will not believe in any pandit, astrologer or anyone else, whatever the case; this is a fixed trait of his nature.
cells_derived_method: Applies to any planet in its debilitation sign in the 9th house; the planet decides the flavour of the disbelief. Saturn gives hard doubt, the Sun contempt for authority, Jupiter rejects teachers, the Moon becomes moody and faithless.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) rejects gurus and dharma teachers.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) gives stern disbelief and distrust of authority.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces) gives faith that swings with mood.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) weakens respect for father, guru and tradition.

ambiguity: It is assumed that 'नीच का ग्रह' means a planet in its sign of debilitation; the 9th house is read by its sign for Parashari dignity.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which see a weak 9th as bad luck or weak dharma, not necessarily disbelief.

gist: Says that person will just say he does not believe, and his own matter is straight.
When he sees this planet in a child's chart he asks the parents why they came, since they do not believe; the client says he has exposed him.

hindi: ऐसे में इष्ट इट का कोई लेनदेन नहीं है पूजा पाठ ना करे वो
says: For such a person there is no dealing with an ishta devata at all; he should not do puja and ritual worship.
cells_derived_method: The ban applies to any debilitated planet in the 9th; the sign of that planet would normally name his ishta, but here it is not used.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) no Jupiter-linked puja should be done.
Derived: for Sun debilitated in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) no Sun worship should be done.

classical_check: Differs from classical practice, which prescribes worship of the debilitated planet's deity as a remedy.

hindi: अच्छा उसमें राशि लिंक नहीं हो नहीं वो नास्तिक बना
says: In answer to the audience, the sign is not linked here, so the ishta cannot be read from the sign; such a person becomes an atheist.
ambiguity: 'वो नास्तिक बना' may mean he is made an atheist or he is born one; the sense is that he is an atheist.
classical_check: Differs from the classical way of reading the ishta devata from the 9th or the atmakaraka, which does not stop for a debilitated planet.

hindi: क्योंकि जैसे ही वो पूजा पाठ का वो इग्नाइट करेगा उसी टाइम नाइंथ हाउस की
says: The reason: the moment he starts puja, at that time the 9th house's (debilitation) is switched on (sentence continues next chunk).
ambiguity: The sentence continues in the next chunk with 'नीचता ऑन हो जाएगी'.
classical_check: Silent; this activation idea is his own.

hindi: नीचता ऑन हो जाएगी आपने नाइंथ हाउस का कर्म करना शुरू कर दिया पूजा पाठ और वहां कुंडली कह रही है करके दिखा तेरे नास पीट देंगे उसी टाइम उसके भाग्य भानी
says: The 9th house debilitation switches on because puja is 9th-house karma; the chart says 'do it and we will ruin you', and at that moment his fortune suffers.
cells_derived_method: Any debilitated planet in the 9th gives this backlash to worship or religious action, harming fortune, father and guru matters, in the area of the planet's nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th (lagna Taurus) would hit fortune and teachers when puja begins.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 9th (lagna Leo) would hit fortune through delay and distance when ritual begins.

ambiguity: 'भाग्य भानी' is read as 'भाग्य हानि', loss of fortune.
classical_check: Silent; the 9th house is the house of dharma and puja in classical texts, but a backlash rule is not found.

hindi: ये वो लोग है जो माता वैष्णो देवी से जब भी आते हैं घर आते बीमार पड़ जाते हैं धर्म स्थान से आए और पता लगा
says: These are the people who fall ill each time they return from Mata Vaishno Devi or any holy place; he gives this as the sign of the debilitated 9th. His claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Illness is his example; the sentence continues with theft and evil eye.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नजर लग गई चोरी हो ग चोरी हो गई घर में भगवान ने क्यों नहीं प्रोटेक्शन करी
says: After a pilgrimage the evil eye strikes or there is a theft at home, and the person asks why God did not protect the house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भगवान कह रहा तुम समझो तो सही यार तुम्हें यह वाला नहीं चाहिए तुम क्यों गलत कर रहे हो
says: God's answer, he says, is that this kind of worship is not meant for such a person, and he is doing wrong by forcing it.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Doctor analogy: you keep taking medicine yourself without asking; you did not ask because the doctor's fee is high.
Last question: the Ho'oponopono prayer he taught, whether to do it daily and for each problem separately.

hindi: रोज कर लो यार 10 बार कर लो तो अंदर हृदय में जितना आप स्वयं को माफ माफ और साफ करते ही बृहस्पति सेट होता है
says: Do the Ho'oponopono prayer daily, ten times; as much as you forgive and clean yourself in the heart, to that extent Jupiter gets set.
classical_check: Silent; Ho'oponopono is a Hawaiian practice and has no place in classical Jyotish remedies.

hindi: और बृहस्पति ही सब भगवान है बृहस्पति सब सेट है अगर वह सेट है तो सब सेट है
says: Jupiter is all the gods in one; if Jupiter is set right then everything is set right.
classical_check: Overstates the classical view, where Jupiter is the chief benefic but other planets still carry their own results.

gist: Man's ego is terrible, he even breaks heads with his own father; a social remark.
A woman cleverly says sorry, the man says she is his queen who satisfied his ego, and brings garlands, rabri and jalebi.
What things come out of his mouth; says it is the deep Kali Yuga and deep Sat Yuga.

hindi: बल्की इसका यह स्थिति बनती है कि आप स्वयं को कितना संभाल सकते हैं कितना बेहतर कर सकते हैं
says: What decides the situation is how well you can manage yourself and how much you can improve yourself.
classical_check: Silent; a self-effort teaching, consistent with purushartha.

hindi: पहला वशीकरण स्वयं पर करो याद रखो आप खुद को तो काबू नहीं पा रहे अब आप कहते हो अपनी पत्नी को काबू करोगे अपने बच्चे को काबू करोगे पति को काबू करोगे
says: Do the first vashikaran on yourself; you cannot control yourself, yet you say you will control your wife, your child or your husband.
ambiguity: This reverses his earlier line that the wife binds the husband by jootha food; here vashikaran is turned to self-mastery.
classical_check: Silent; vashikaran as self-control is his own meaning of the word.

hindi: सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम आप दूसरे को काबू करना चाहते हो खुद को काबू करके दिखाओ पहले पूरे ब्रह्मांड को काबू कर लोगे
says: The biggest problem is that you try to control others; show control of yourself first, and then you will control the whole universe.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि यत पिंडे तत् ब्रह्मांडे तत्वम असी आपको जीवन में खुद को काबू करना सीखना है पूरी दुनिया आपके हिसाब से चलेगी
says: He cites the Vedic sayings 'I am Brahman', 'as in the body so in the cosmos' and 'that thou art', and says that if you learn self-control the whole world will run according to you.
ambiguity: The quote 'यत पिंडे तत् ब्रह्मांडे' is usually 'यथा पिंडे तथा ब्रह्मांडे'; the caption is a spoken form.
classical_check: The three phrases come from the Upanishads and yogic texts, not from Parashara; the claim that the world will then follow you is his addition.

hindi: इसलिए इतने बड़े कमांड माल के कुत्ते बनो आपको पता हो मेरे को कब भोकना है कैसे भोकना है कितना भोकना है
says: Be like a dog trained with great command, who knows exactly when to bark, how to bark and how much; he means self-restraint over speech and reaction.
ambiguity: 'कमांड माल के' is garbled; read as 'well-commanded' or 'under command'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको क्रोध करना है कब करना है कितना करना है किस पर करना है यह साक्षी भाव है आपका
says: In the same way, you should choose when to be angry, how much and at whom; this controlled anger is your witness attitude, sakshi bhava.
ambiguity: He does not name Mars; the link to Mars as anger is inferred, and the sentence runs on into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; the sakshi bhava is a Vedantic idea, not a Jyotish one.

hindi: छेन भी आपके लिए काम करेगा बॉडी हीलिंग पर जाएगी सारी हीलिंग पांचवें घर से होती है
says: The universe or channel will then work for you and the body will go into healing; he states that all healing comes from the 5th house. A claim about healing, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house sign shows what heals: a fire sign through energy and sun, an earth sign through food and herbs, an air sign through breath and study, a water sign through feeling and water.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) points to healing through energy, exercise and heat.
Derived: Taurus on the 5th (lagna Capricorn) points to healing through food, comfort and touch.
Derived: Gemini on the 5th (lagna Aquarius) points to healing through breath, speech and study.
Derived: Cancer on the 5th (lagna Pisces) points to healing through water, emotion and the mother.

ambiguity: 'छेन' is garbled; read as 'channel' or 'chain'. The healing claim is a belief, not a medical rule.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which link health to the 1st, 6th and 8th houses; the 5th is for mind, children and merit.

gist: Garbled words after 'the 5th house's owner' and a question of what he is telling and why.

hindi: पांचवे घर की राशि के स्थान पे अगर आप कोई वो चीज रख दोगे जो उस घर की चीज है तो बंदे को वही हैबिट पड़ जाएगी पांचवा घर हीलिंग और हैबिट का है
says: If you place in the spot of the home linked with the sign of the 5th house some object belonging to that house's themes, the person picks up that same habit; the 5th house governs healing and habits.
cells_derived_method: Each sign on the 5th house has its own area of the home and its own habit-giving objects; the thing placed must match the sign's nature, with fire signs giving drive, earth signs comfort, air signs study, water signs feeling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 5th (lagna Taurus) places order, study and health items to set habits of discipline.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th (lagna Cancer) places intense or secretive items that set habits of obsession.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th (lagna Scorpio) places devotional or intoxicating items to set escape or devotion habits.

ambiguity: 'राशि के स्थान' means the home direction tied to that sign; the sign-to-direction table is not given in this chunk.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; this link of a house sign to a place in the home is a Vastu-style idea.

hindi: अगर शराब की बोतल भी रख दिया आपने पांचवे घर के राशि के स्थान पर घर में बंदा शराबी बन जाएगा वही हैबिट पड़ जाएगी
says: If you place a liquor bottle at the spot of the 5th-house sign in the home, the person becomes a drinker and takes on that habit. This is his illustration, not advice to place one.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किताबें रख ली किताबी कीड़ा बन जाएगा प्रेम सुगंध रख ली प्रेम की आदत पड़ जाएगी
says: Place books there and the person becomes a bookworm; place love-linked fragrance there and he forms the habit of love.
ambiguity: The planets are inferred from books for Mercury and fragrance for Venus; he names none.
